-- ============================================================================
-- [LURNA FIX #1] Root / Lv / Energy bị cache MỘT LẦN ở block trên.
-- Sau khi chết & hồi sinh, Root trỏ vào HumanoidRootPart đã bị Destroy nên mọi
-- phép đo khoảng cách dùng Root (Attack.Dist, Attack.DistH, Auto Farm Boss :5132)
-- sai vĩnh viễn. Dưới đây làm mới chúng mỗi lần CharacterAdded + watchdog 1s.
-- ============================================================================
LurnaRefreshChar = function(char)
    char = char or plr.Character
    if not char then return end
    local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not hrp then hrp = char:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart", 10) end
    if hrp then Root = hrp end
    pcall(function() Energy = char.Energy.Value end)
end

plr.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(char)
    task.wait(0.35)
    pcall(LurnaRefreshChar, char)
end)

task.spawn(function()
    while task.wait(1) do
        pcall(function()
            if not Root or not Root.Parent then LurnaRefreshChar() end
            Lv = plr.Data.Level.Value
        end)
    end
end)

-- Helper dùng chung: luôn trả về HumanoidRootPart HIỆN TẠI, không dùng biến cache.
LurnaHRP = function()
    local char = plr.Character
    return char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or nil
end

-- ============================================================================
-- [LURNA FIX #41] LOP BOC AN TOAN CHO 418 LENH GOI REMOTE
-- Truoc day toan bo file goi TRUC TIEP: LurnaCommF(...)
-- Ba van de:
--   (1) Index truc tiep .Remotes.CommF_ NEM LOI neu folder chua replicate xong
--       hoac bi rename -> loi lam chet ca thread farm (nhieu cho khong co pcall).
--   (2) InvokeServer la ham YIELD. Goi trong vong farm moi frame vua treo vong lap
--       vua spam server (getInventory bi goi 3-4 lan/tick qua GetM/GetIn/GetWP).
--   (3) Khong co cho nao biet lenh goi that bai -> "API ko on" ma khong ro tai sao.
-- Nay moi lenh di qua LurnaCommF / LurnaCommE:
--   - resolve remote 1 lan roi cache, co WaitForChild du phong
--   - luon pcall, tra ve nil khi loi (thay vi nem loi)
--   - cache ket qua cho action CHI DOC (getInventory, GetFruits...) trong TTL
--   - bo qua lenh goi TRUNG LAP y nguyen trong cung tick voi action dieu huong
--   - dem ok/fail/drop + luu loi cuoi cung de hien thi len UI
-- Chu y: KHONG dedupe cac action mua/craft vi co cho co y goi lap (Bones Buy).
-- ============================================================================
_G.__LurnaRemote = _G.__LurnaRemote or {
    obj = {}, read = {}, last = {},
    ok = 0, fail = 0, drop = 0, err = "", errAct = "", errAt = 0
}

LurnaReadCacheTTL = {
    getInventory = 0.5, getInventoryFruits = 0.5, GetFruits = 0.5,
    GetUnlockables = 1, getTitles = 2, InfoLeviathan = 0.5, PossibleHardcode = 2,
}
LurnaDedupeAction = {
    requestEntrance = 0.35, StartQuest = 0.35, AbandonQuest = 0.35,
    TravelMain = 3, TravelDressrosa = 3, TravelZou = 3,
    SetTeam = 3, SetSpawnPoint = 1, EnablePvp = 3,
}

function LurnaGetRemote(name)
    local R = _G.__LurnaRemote
    local o = R.obj[name]
    if o and o.Parent then return o end
    local rs = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
    local folder = rs:FindFirstChild("Remotes")
    if not folder then pcall(function() folder = rs:WaitForChild("Remotes", 5) end) end
    if not folder then return nil end
    o = folder:FindFirstChild(name)
    if not o then pcall(function() o = folder:WaitForChild(name, 5) end) end
    R.obj[name] = o
    return o
end

function LurnaArgKey(...)
    local n = select("#", ...)
    local t = {}
    for i = 1, n do
        local v = select(i, ...)
        if typeof(v) == "Vector3" then
            t[i] = string.format("%d,%d,%d", v.X, v.Y, v.Z)
        else
            t[i] = tostring(v)
        end
    end
    return table.concat(t, "\1")
end

function LurnaRemoteNote(action, msg)
    local R = _G.__LurnaRemote
    R.fail = R.fail + 1
    R.err = tostring(msg)
    R.errAct = tostring(action)
    R.errAt = tick()
end

function LurnaCommF(...)
    local R = _G.__LurnaRemote
    local action = select(1, ...)
    local ttl = (type(action) == "string") and LurnaReadCacheTTL[action] or nil
    local key = nil
    if ttl or (type(action) == "string" and LurnaDedupeAction[action]) then
        key = LurnaArgKey(...)
    end
    if ttl and key then
        local c = R.read[key]
        if c and (tick() - c.t) < ttl then return c.v end
    end
    local dd = (type(action) == "string") and LurnaDedupeAction[action] or nil
    if dd and key then
        local l = R.last[key]
        if l and (tick() - l) < dd then
            R.drop = R.drop + 1
            return nil
        end
        R.last[key] = tick()
    end
    local remote = LurnaGetRemote("CommF_")
    if not remote then
        LurnaRemoteNote(action, "Remotes.CommF_ khong ton tai")
        return nil
    end
    local packed = table.pack(...)
    local res = table.pack(pcall(function()
        return remote:InvokeServer(table.unpack(packed, 1, packed.n))
    end))
    if not res[1] then
        LurnaRemoteNote(action, res[2])
        return nil
    end
    R.ok = R.ok + 1
    if ttl and key then
        R.read[key] = { t = tick(), v = res[2] }
    elseif type(action) == "string" then
        -- action GHI (mua / craft / an trai / nhan quest): du lieu vua doi ->
        -- huy cache doc ngay, neu khong GetM/GetIn se doc so cu va mua lai lan 2.
        R.read = {}
    end
    return table.unpack(res, 2, res.n)
end

function LurnaCommE(...)
    local R = _G.__LurnaRemote
    local remote = LurnaGetRemote("CommE")
    if not remote then
        LurnaRemoteNote(select(1, ...), "Remotes.CommE khong ton tai")
        return
    end
    local packed = table.pack(...)
    local ok, err = pcall(function()
        remote:FireServer(table.unpack(packed, 1, packed.n))
    end)
    if ok then R.ok = R.ok + 1 else LurnaRemoteNote(select(1, ...), err) end
end

function LurnaRemoteInvoke(name, ...)
    local remote = LurnaGetRemote(name)
    if not remote then LurnaRemoteNote(name, "remote khong ton tai") return nil end
    local packed = table.pack(...)
    local res = table.pack(pcall(function()
        return remote:InvokeServer(table.unpack(packed, 1, packed.n))
    end))
    if not res[1] then LurnaRemoteNote(name, res[2]) return nil end
    _G.__LurnaRemote.ok = _G.__LurnaRemote.ok + 1
    return table.unpack(res, 2, res.n)
end

-- Xoa cache doc khi biet du lieu vua thay doi (mua/craft/an trai)
function LurnaClearReadCache()
    _G.__LurnaRemote.read = {}
end

-- [LURNA FIX #110] Cu la:
--   local Remotes = { RFJobsRemoteFunction = replicated.Modules.Net["RF/JobsRemoteFunction"], ... }
-- Dong dau index THANG `.Modules.Net[...]` o TOP-LEVEL, khong pcall. Neu Roblox
-- chua replicate xong `Modules`, hoac game doi ten remote, thi dong nay NEM LOI
-- ngay top-level va TOAN BO ~19.700 dong con lai (fast attack, farm, tab Hop,
-- Kaitun...) KHONG BAO GIO CHAY. FIX #24/#25 da sua loai loi nay ben trong ham
-- nhung bo sot dung cho nguy hiem nhat.
-- Gio resolve lazy + co cache: goi LurnaNet("RF/Craft") o dau cung an toan.
-- ============================================================================
_G.__LurnaNetCache = _G.__LurnaNetCache or {}
function LurnaNet(name)
  local c = _G.__LurnaNetCache[name]
  if c and c.Parent then return c end
  local obj = nil
  pcall(function()
    local mods = replicated:FindFirstChild("Modules") or replicated:WaitForChild("Modules", 10)
    local net  = mods and (mods:FindFirstChild("Net") or mods:WaitForChild("Net", 10))
    obj = net and (net:FindFirstChild(name) or net:WaitForChild(name, 10))
  end)
  if obj then _G.__LurnaNetCache[name] = obj end
  return obj
end
local Remotes = setmetatable({}, {
  __index = function(_, k)
    if k == "RFJobsRemoteFunction" then return LurnaNet("RF/JobsRemoteFunction") end
    if k == "RFCraft"              then return LurnaNet("RF/Craft") end
    return nil
  end
})
EquipWeapon = function(toolOrCategory)
  if not toolOrCategory or toolOrCategory == "" then
    toolOrCategory = _G.SelectWeapon or "Melee"
  end
  pcall(function()
    local char = plr.Character
    if not char or not char:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") then return end
    local currentTool = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
    if currentTool and (currentTool.Name == toolOrCategory or currentTool.ToolTip == toolOrCategory) then
      return
    end
    local directTool = plr.Backpack:FindFirstChild(toolOrCategory)
    if directTool and directTool:IsA("Tool") then
      char.Humanoid:EquipTool(directTool)
      return
    end
    for _, t in ipairs(plr.Backpack:GetChildren()) do
      if t:IsA("Tool") then
        -- [LURNA FIX #30] thieu plain-mode: vu khi "Pole (2nd Form)" co dau "(" ")"
        -- la ky tu dac biet cua Lua pattern => string.find NEM LOI (unfinished capture)
        -- hoac khong bao gio khop => EquipWeapon that bai am tham.
        if t.ToolTip == toolOrCategory or string.find(string.lower(t.ToolTip), string.lower(toolOrCategory), 1, true) then
          char.Humanoid:EquipTool(t)
          return
        end
      end
    end
    if not char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool") then
      for _, t in ipairs(plr.Backpack:GetChildren()) do
        if t:IsA("Tool") and (t.ToolTip == "Melee" or t.ToolTip == "Sword" or t.ToolTip == "Blox Fruit") then
          char.Humanoid:EquipTool(t)
          return
        end
      end
    end
  end)
end
weaponSc = function(weapon)
  -- [LURNA FIX #273] Thieu `break`. Vong nay khong dung lai sau khi cam duoc vu khi
  -- dau tien: no goi EquipWeapon cho MOI tool trung ToolTip. Vi EquipWeapon so sanh
  -- theo TEN, lan goi thu hai khong thoat som duoc nen thuc su EquipTool lai =>
  -- (a) ban ra N lenh EquipTool thay vi 1, (b) ket qua la dang cam thanh vu khi CUOI
  -- trong danh sach, khong phai cai dau - nguoi dung chon "Sword" ma nhan duoc thanh
  -- kiem khac han cai dinh cam. Bon cho goi (dong 893-929) deu nam trong vong lap
  -- ky nang nen so lenh nhan len theo tan so vong.
  for __in, v in pairs(plr.Backpack:GetChildren()) do
    if v:IsA("Tool") then
      if v.ToolTip == weapon then
        EquipWeapon(v.Name)
        return
      end
    end
  end
end

--      dung tan 0.35s cho vu khi DA nam san trong tay => DPS thap.
-- Cach sua: neo mob + diem treo vao MOT toa do CO DINH (attribute "Locked"), gom

-- ============================================================================

-- workspace.Enemies ve anchor (ke ca Sea Beasts / boss). Tat di thi tra ve
-- bring cung loai 350 studs mac dinh.
getgenv().LurnaMagnetFull   = (getgenv().LurnaMagnetFull == true)

-- Neo mob: tra ve MOT CFrame khong doi (chi lay vi tri, bo goc quay cua mob de
-- diem treo khong lac theo huong mob dang xoay). Chi neo lai khi mob that su troi
-- qua 60 studs (mob respawn cho khac / bi server keo ve).
function LurnaAnchor(model)
  if not model then return nil end
  local hrp = model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
  if not hrp then return nil end
  local a = model:GetAttribute("Locked")
  if typeof(a) ~= "CFrame" then
    a = CFrame.new(hrp.Position)
    pcall(function() model:SetAttribute("Locked", a) end)
    return a
  end
  if (hrp.Position - a.Position).Magnitude > 60 then
    a = CFrame.new(hrp.Position)
    pcall(function() model:SetAttribute("Locked", a) end)
  end
  return a
end

-- Diem treo phia tren mob, nhin thang xuong. Dung CHUNG cho moi ham Attack.*
function LurnaHover(anchor, height)
  local h = tonumber(height) or tonumber(getgenv().LurnaHoverHeight) or 12
  return anchor * CFrame.new(0, h, 0) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(-90), 0, 0)
end

-- [LURNA FIX #107] Toggle "Auto Turn on Spin xyz" (RandomCFrame) truoc day duoc
-- hien thuc bang 5 lan _tp co wait() CHAN o giua, dat cuoi moi ham Attack.*:
--   Attack.Kill  : 5 x wait(.5)  = 2.5 GIAY chan MOI lan goi  => DPS sut ~90%
--   Kill2/Sword  : 5 x wait(0.1) = 0.5 giay chan
-- Te hon: moi diem den la anchor*CFrame.new(0,30,25) tuc ~39 studs khoi mob =>
-- NGOAI vung xac thuc ~15 studs cua server => suot ca chuoi quay do KHONG co
-- sat thuong nao duoc ghi nhan. Nguoi dung bat toggle nay vi tuong "an toan hon"
-- roi tu lam farm cua minh cham hon script khac ~10 lan.
-- Gio quay bang goc tinh tu tick(): khong wait, khong chan scheduler, ban kinh
-- nam gon trong vung hop le, va van doi goc moi frame nen van xoa duoc pattern.
-- ============================================================================
function LurnaSpinHover(anchor)
  local h = tonumber(getgenv().LurnaHoverHeight) or 12
  local r = tonumber(getgenv().LurnaSpinRadius) or 6
  local a = tick() * (tonumber(getgenv().LurnaSpinSpeed) or 3)
  return anchor
       * CFrame.new(math.cos(a) * r, h, math.sin(a) * r)
       * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(-90), 0, 0)
end

-- Diem treo cho vong kill: tu chon giua treo co dinh va treo quay.
function LurnaKillHover(anchor)
  if RandomCFrame then return LurnaSpinHover(anchor) end
  return LurnaHover(anchor)
end

-- Tat CanCollide toan than: van dung GetDescendants nhung CO THROTTLE 1 giay
-- (va chay ngay lap tuc khi doi Character) thay vi moi lan goi _tp.
_G.__LurnaNoClipLast = _G.__LurnaNoClipLast or 0
function LurnaNoCollide(character, force)
  if not character then return end
  if _G.__LurnaNoClipChar ~= character then
    _G.__LurnaNoClipChar = character
    force = true
  end
  local now = tick()
  if not force and (now - (_G.__LurnaNoClipLast or 0)) < 1 then return end
  _G.__LurnaNoClipLast = now
  for _, part in ipairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
    if part:IsA("BasePart") and part.CanCollide then
      part.CanCollide = false
    end
  end
end

-- Vu khi: KHONG equip lai va KHONG cho tooltip khi vu khi dung loai da nam trong
-- tay. Day la cho tiet kiem thoi gian lon nhat trong vong kill.
_G.__LurnaWep = _G.__LurnaWep or { tip = nil, last = 0 }
function LurnaEnsureWeapon(want)
  local char = plr.Character
  if not char then return nil end
  local tool = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
  if tool then
    local ok, tip = pcall(function() return tool.ToolTip end)
    tip = ok and tip or nil
    _G.__LurnaWep.tip = tip
    if want == nil or want == "" or tool.Name == want or tip == want then
      return tip
    end
    if tip and string.find(string.lower(tip), string.lower(tostring(want)), 1, true) then
      return tip
    end
  end
  -- toi da 1 lan EquipTool / 0.5s de khong spam remote trang bi
  local now = tick()
  if now - (_G.__LurnaWep.last or 0) >= 0.5 then
    _G.__LurnaWep.last = now
    if want == nil or want == "" then
      EquipWeapon("Melee")
    else
      EquipWeapon(want)
    end
  end
  return _G.__LurnaWep.tip
end

-- ============================================================================
-- [LURNA FEATURE #4] CHON MUC TIEU: UU TIEN MOB CUA QUEST + UU TIEN CUM DONG NHAT
-- Truoc day vong farm lay con mob DAU TIEN khop ten trong workspace.Enemies (thu
-- tu Instance, gan nhu ngau nhien) => rat hay bam vao mot con le loi o xa, trong
-- khi dan 10 con dang dung cho khac => moi don danh chi trung 1 muc tieu.
-- Nay cham diem: so mob dong loai quanh no (cum) truoc, roi moi den khoang cach.
-- ============================================================================
-- Bo cham diem dung chung: tra ve con mob nam trong CUM DONG NHAT, uu tien gan.
function LurnaBestOf(list, radius)
  if not list or #list == 0 then return nil end
  if #list == 1 then return list[1] end
  local hrp = LurnaHRP()
  local r = tonumber(radius) or tonumber(getgenv().LurnaBringRadius) or 350
  local best, bestScore = nil, -math.huge
  for i = 1, #list do
    local ri = list[i]:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if ri then
      local vp = ri.Position
      local cluster = 0
      for j = 1, #list do
        local rj = list[j]:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if rj and (rj.Position - vp).Magnitude <= r then
          cluster = cluster + 1
        end
      end
      local dist = hrp and (vp - hrp.Position).Magnitude or 0
      local score = cluster * 1000 - dist
      if score > bestScore then
        bestScore = score
        best = list[i]
      end
    end
  end
  return best or list[1]
end

_G.__LurnaPick = _G.__LurnaPick or { t = 0, mob = nil }
function LurnaPickMob(matchFn, radius)
  local cached = _G.__LurnaPick.mob
  if cached and cached.Parent and (tick() - (_G.__LurnaPick.t or 0)) < 0.3 then
    local hum = cached:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if hum and hum.Health > 0 and (not matchFn or matchFn(cached.Name)) then
      return cached
    end
  end
  local hrp = LurnaHRP()
  local list = {}
  for _, v in ipairs(workspace.Enemies:GetChildren()) do
    if v:IsA("Model") and (not matchFn or matchFn(v.Name)) then
      local root = v:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
      local hum = v:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
      if root and hum and hum.Health > 0 and not v:GetAttribute("IsBoat") then
        table.insert(list, v)
      end
    end
  end
  if #list == 0 then
    _G.__LurnaPick.mob = nil
    return nil
  end
  local best = LurnaBestOf(list, radius)
  _G.__LurnaPick.mob = best
  _G.__LurnaPick.t = tick()
  return best
end

local Attack = {}
Attack.__index = Attack
Attack.Alive = function(model) if not model then return end local Humanoid = model:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") return Humanoid and Humanoid.Health > 0 end
-- [LURNA FIX #2] Attack.Pos cũ viết `mode.Position` (sai chính tả của `model`) nên
-- hàm này luôn văng lỗi. Cả 3 hàm dưới đều đổi sang HRP hiện tại thay vì biến Root cache.
Attack.Pos = function(model,dist)
  local r = LurnaHRP()
  local m = model and model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
  if not r or not m then return false end
  return (r.Position - m.Position).Magnitude <= dist
end
Attack.Dist = function(model,dist)
  local r = LurnaHRP()
  local m = model and model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
  if not r or not m then return false end
  return (r.Position - m.Position).Magnitude <= dist
end
Attack.DistH = function(model,dist)
  local r = LurnaHRP()
  local m = model and model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
  if not r or not m then return false end
  return (r.Position - m.Position).Magnitude > dist
end
-- [LURNA FIX #3] EquipWeapon() là BẤT ĐỒNG BỘ (Humanoid:EquipTool). Ở tick đầu sau
-- khi đổi vũ khí, FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool") trả về nil -> code cũ `Equipped.ToolTip`
-- văng "attempt to index nil", bị pcall của vòng lặp farm nuốt mất => cả lượt farm chết.
Attack.GetToolTip = function()
  local char = plr.Character
  local tool = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
  if not tool then return nil, nil end
  local ok, tip = pcall(function() return tool.ToolTip end)
  return ok and tip or nil, tool
end
-- Chờ tối đa `timeout` giây cho Tool xuất hiện sau khi equip.
Attack.WaitToolTip = function(timeout)
  local t0 = os.clock()
  repeat
    local tip = Attack.GetToolTip()
    if tip then return tip end
    task.wait(0.05)
  until os.clock() - t0 > (timeout or 0.35)
  return nil
end
-- [LURNA FIX #34] Ca 6 ham Attack.* deu bi 3 loi giong nhau:
--   a) doc model.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame SONG lam diem treo => rung theo mob.
--   b) goi EquipWeapon(...) roi Attack.WaitToolTip(0.35) MOI TICK, ke ca khi vu khi
--      da nam trong tay => moi vong lap mat toi 0.35s vo ich.
--   c) khong doc lai anchor nen BringEnemy va diem treo lech nhau.
-- Nay dung LurnaAnchor (co dinh) + LurnaEnsureWeapon (khong chan) + LurnaHover.
Attack.Kill = function(model,Succes)
  if not (model and Succes) then return end
  if not model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then return end
  local anchor = LurnaAnchor(model)
  if not anchor then return end
  PosMon = anchor.Position
  BringEnemy(model)
  local ToolTip = LurnaEnsureWeapon(_G.SelectWeapon)
  if ToolTip == "Blox Fruit" then
    _tp(anchor * CFrame.new(0,10,0) * CFrame.Angles(0,math.rad(90),0))
  else
    _tp(LurnaKillHover(anchor))   -- [FIX #107] tu quay neu RandomCFrame, KHONG wait
  end
end

  if not (model and Succes) then return end
  if not model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then return end
  local anchor = LurnaAnchor(model)
  if not anchor then return end
  PosMon = anchor.Position
  BringEnemy(model)

  else
    _tp(anchor * CFrame.new(0,(tonumber(getgenv().LurnaHoverHeight) or 12),8) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(-90),0,0))
  end
  if RandomCFrame then _tp(LurnaSpinHover(anchor)) end   -- [FIX #107]
end

end

Attack.Mas = function(model,Succes)
  if not (model and Succes) then return end
  if not model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then return end
  local anchor = LurnaAnchor(model)
  if not anchor then return end
  PosMon = anchor.Position
  BringEnemy(model)
  local hum = model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
  if not hum then return end
  if hum.Health <= (HealthM or math.huge) then
    _tp(LurnaHover(anchor, 20))
    Useskills("Blox Fruit","Z")
    Useskills("Blox Fruit","X")
    Useskills("Blox Fruit","C")
  else
    LurnaEnsureWeapon("Melee")
    _tp(LurnaHover(anchor))
  end
end

statsSetings = function(Num, value)
  if Num == "Melee" then
    if plr.Data.Points.Value ~= 0 then
      LurnaCommF("AddPoint","Melee",value)
    end
  elseif Num == "Defense" then
    if plr.Data.Points.Value ~= 0 then
      LurnaCommF("AddPoint","Defense",value)
    end
  elseif Num == "Sword" then
    if plr.Data.Points.Value ~= 0 then
      LurnaCommF("AddPoint","Sword",value)
    end
  elseif Num == "Gun" then
    if plr.Data.Points.Value ~= 0 then
      LurnaCommF("AddPoint","Gun",value)
    end
  elseif Num == "Devil" then
    if plr.Data.Points.Value ~= 0 then
      LurnaCommF("AddPoint","Demon Fruit",value)
    end
  end
end

-- [LURNA FIX #33] BringEnemy cu co 3 van de nang:
--   a) neo ca dan mob vao Mon.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame - mot toa do DANG DI CHUYEN
--      => dan mob bi keo lech theo moi tick, va diem treo cua nhan vat cung lech
--      theo => rung.
--   b) quet lai TOAN BO workspace.Enemies roi ghi CFrame + WalkSpeed + JumpPower +
--      tao BodyVelocity cho TUNG mob o MOI tick (>=10 lan/giay).
--   c) bo qua chinh Mon (v ~= Mon) nen muc tieu van chay lung tung, ca dan chay theo.
-- Nay: gom MOT LUOT vao anchor CO DINH (force = true khi doi muc tieu - dung y
-- "1 lan co bring het quai dong the loai"), sau do chi GIU, va chi ghi lai CFrame
-- khi mob troi qua LurnaBringSnap studs.
-- ============================================================================
LurnaBringSnap = 4
_G.__LurnaBring = _G.__LurnaBring or { last = 0, key = "" }
-- ============================================================================
-- [LURNA FIX #114] LurnaHoldMob tao BodyVelocity + zero WalkSpeed/JumpPower cho
-- MOI con mob duoc gom (bang LurnaBringRadius = 350 studs co the la hang chuc con)
-- nhung KHONG BAO GIO don. Hau qua: tat farm xong dan mob van dung cung tai cho,
-- BodyVelocity con nguyen tren tung con => vua ro rang bat thuong voi server, vua
-- ro ro rang voi nguoi choi khac dung gan. Day dung loai loi ma FIX #40 da sua cho
-- NHAN VAT nhung bo sot cho MOB (thieu doi xung).
-- Gio co so dang ky (luu WalkSpeed/JumpPower goc) + ham nha + watchdog 1s.
-- ============================================================================
_G.__LurnaHeldMobs = _G.__LurnaHeldMobs or {}

function LurnaReleaseMob(v)
  local saved = _G.__LurnaHeldMobs[v]
  _G.__LurnaHeldMobs[v] = nil
  if not v then return end
  pcall(function()
    local root = v:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local bv = root and root:FindFirstChild("BodyVelocity")
    if bv then bv:Destroy() end
    local hum = v:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if hum and type(saved) == "table" then
      if hum.WalkSpeed  == 0 then hum.WalkSpeed  = saved.ws or 16 end
      if hum.JumpPower  == 0 then hum.JumpPower  = saved.jp or 50 end
    end
    v:SetAttribute("Locked", nil)
  end)
end

function LurnaReleaseAllMobs()
  for v in pairs(_G.__LurnaHeldMobs) do pcall(LurnaReleaseMob, v) end
  _G.__LurnaHeldMobs = {}
  _G.LurnaHeldCount = 0
end

function LurnaHoldMob(v, anchorCF, force)
  local hum = v:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
  local root = v:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
  if not (hum and root) or hum.Health <= 0 then return false end
  -- ghi nho gia tri GOC ngay lan giu dau tien, truoc khi zero
  if _G.__LurnaHeldMobs[v] == nil then
    _G.__LurnaHeldMobs[v] = { ws = hum.WalkSpeed, jp = hum.JumpPower }
  end
  if force or (root.Position - anchorCF.Position).Magnitude > LurnaBringSnap then
    root.CFrame = anchorCF
  end
  if root.CanCollide then root.CanCollide = false end
  if root.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Magnitude > 0.1 then
    root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
    root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
  end
  if hum.WalkSpeed ~= 0 then hum.WalkSpeed = 0 end
  if hum.JumpPower ~= 0 then hum.JumpPower = 0 end
  if not root:FindFirstChild("BodyVelocity") then
    local bv = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
    bv.Name = "BodyVelocity"
    bv.MaxForce = Vector3.new(1e9, 1e9, 1e9)
    bv.Velocity = Vector3.zero
    bv.Parent = root
  end
  return true
end

-- Watchdog: nha mob da chet / da bi xoa, va nha SACH khi nguoi dung tat Bring Mobs.
task.spawn(function()
  if _G.__LurnaHeldGC then return end
  _G.__LurnaHeldGC = true
  while task.wait(1) do
    pcall(function()
      if _B == false then
        if next(_G.__LurnaHeldMobs) ~= nil then LurnaReleaseAllMobs() end
        return
      end
      for v in pairs(_G.__LurnaHeldMobs) do
        local hum = v and v.Parent and v:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if not hum or hum.Health <= 0 then LurnaReleaseMob(v) end
      end
    end)
  end
end)

function LurnaSameKind(a, b)
  if a.Name == b.Name then return true end
  local ta, tb = a:GetAttribute("EnemyType"), b:GetAttribute("EnemyType")
  return ta ~= nil and ta == tb
end

BringEnemy = function(Mon, force)
  local held = 0
  pcall(function()
    -- toggle "Bring Mobs" (:6038) ghi vao _B nhung TRUOC DAY khong ai doc _B =>
    -- tat toggle van gom mob. Gio doc that.
    if _B == false then return end
    if not Mon then
      local hrp = LurnaHRP()
      if not hrp then return end
      local closestDist = math.huge
      for _, enemy in ipairs(workspace.Enemies:GetChildren()) do
        local hum = enemy:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        local root = enemy:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if hum and root and hum.Health > 0 then
          local dist = (root.Position - hrp.Position).Magnitude
          if dist < closestDist then
            closestDist = dist
            Mon = enemy
          end
        end
      end
      if not Mon then return end
    end

    local anchorCF = LurnaAnchor(Mon)
    if not anchorCF then return end

    -- doi muc tieu => BAT BUOC gom lai mot luot ngay, khong cho het chu ky
    local key = tostring(Mon)
    if _G.__LurnaBring.key ~= key then
      _G.__LurnaBring.key = key
      force = true
    end
    local now = tick()
    local rate = tonumber(getgenv().LurnaBringRate) or 0.25
    if not force and (now - (_G.__LurnaBring.last or 0)) < rate then return end
    _G.__LurnaBring.last = now

    -- [LURNA FIX #319] math.huge -> so huu han (LurnaAntiBan.SimRadius). 1500 van
    -- phu ban kinh gom mob 350 nen khong mat gi, ma bo duoc mot gia tri khong
    -- client that nao dat.
    if LurnaAntiBan and LurnaAntiBan.SimRadius then LurnaAntiBan.SimRadius() end

    -- ghim CHINH muc tieu truoc (day la thu cu thieu)
    if getgenv().LurnaPinTarget ~= false then
      if LurnaHoldMob(Mon, anchorCF, force) then held = held + 1 end
    end

    if getgenv().LurnaBringAll == false then
      _G.LurnaHeldCount = held
      return
    end
    local radius = getgenv().LurnaMagnetFull and 5000 or (tonumber(getgenv().LurnaBringRadius) or 350)
    for _, v in ipairs(workspace.Enemies:GetChildren()) do
      if v ~= Mon and v.Parent and v:IsA("Model") and (getgenv().LurnaMagnetFull or LurnaSameKind(v, Mon)) then
        local root = v:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if root and (root.Position - anchorCF.Position).Magnitude <= radius then
          if LurnaHoldMob(v, anchorCF, force) then held = held + 1 end
        end
      end
    end
    _G.LurnaHeldCount = held
  end)
  return held
end
Useskills = function(weapon, skill)
  if weapon == "Melee" then
    weaponSc("Melee")
    if skill == "Z" then
      vim1:SendKeyEvent(true, "Z", false, game);
      vim1:SendKeyEvent(false, "Z", false, game);
    elseif skill == "X" then
      vim1:SendKeyEvent(true, "X", false, game);
      vim1:SendKeyEvent(false, "X", false, game);
    elseif skill == "C" then
      vim1:SendKeyEvent(true, "C", false, game);
      vim1:SendKeyEvent(false, "C", false, game);
    end
  elseif weapon == "Sword" then
    weaponSc("Sword")
    if skill == "Z" then
      vim1:SendKeyEvent(true, "Z", false, game);
      vim1:SendKeyEvent(false, "Z", false, game);
    elseif skill == "X" then
      vim1:SendKeyEvent(true, "X", false, game);
      vim1:SendKeyEvent(false, "X", false, game);
    end
  elseif weapon == "Blox Fruit" then
    weaponSc("Blox Fruit")
    if skill == "Z" then
      vim1:SendKeyEvent(true, "Z", false, game);
      vim1:SendKeyEvent(false, "Z", false, game);
    elseif skill == "X" then
      vim1:SendKeyEvent(true, "X", false, game);
      vim1:SendKeyEvent(false, "X", false, game);
    elseif skill == "C" then
      vim1:SendKeyEvent(true, "C", false, game);
      vim1:SendKeyEvent(false, "C", false, game);        
    elseif skill == "V" then
      vim1:SendKeyEvent(true, "V", false, game);
      vim1:SendKeyEvent(false, "V", false, game);
    end
  elseif weapon == "Gun" then
    weaponSc("Gun")
    if skill == "Z" then
      vim1:SendKeyEvent(true, "Z", false, game);
      vim1:SendKeyEvent(false, "Z", false, game);
    elseif skill == "X" then
      vim1:SendKeyEvent(true, "X", false, game);
      vim1:SendKeyEvent(false, "X", false, game);
    end
  end
  if weapon == "nil" and skill == "Y" then
    vim1:SendKeyEvent(true, "Y", false, game);
    vim1:SendKeyEvent(false, "Y", false, game);
  end
end

-- [LURNA FIX #315] LOP DO NANG LUC EXECUTOR
-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Ba dong ngay duoi day truoc kia la:
--     local gg = getrawmetatable(game)
--     local old = gg.__namecall
--     setreadonly(gg, false)
-- goi TRAN, khong kiem tra gi. Executor nao thieu getrawmetatable la loi ngay
-- dong dau -> CA HUB khong len, nguoi dung chi thay "dan script khong ra menu"
-- ma khong co dong bao loi nao doc duoc. Day la loi chan-load, khong phai loi
-- am tham: no xay ra o dong 953 trong khi UI dung o dong 3000+.
--
-- Hai chuyen rieng biet duoc xu ly o day:
--
-- 1) getgenv() co the la mot table CHET. Hub goi getgenv() 387 lan de giu co
--    (getgenv().LurnaUnstun, getgenv().AutoFarm...). Executor hang thap tra ve
--    mot table moi khong noi voi moi truong that, nen ghi vao do thi vong lap
--    doc bien toan cuc khong bao gio thay -> cong tac bat len ma khong chay gi.
--    Cach do: ghi mot khoa vao table nghi van roi doc lai bang BIEN TOAN CUC
--    TRAN. Thay thi table do that su la moi truong; khong thay thi bo.
--
-- 2) Ham nao thieu thi bit lai, ham nao da co cho kiem thi de yen. Chi cai stub
--    cho 7 ham dang duoc goi TRAN trong file (getrawmetatable/setreadonly xu ly
--    tay o duoi, newcclosure/getnamecallmethod/getgc/getupvalues/setupvalue cai
--    stub). Con getsenv/getconnections/setfpscap/getcustomasset... da co
--    `if X then` san o cho dung -> KHONG stub, vi stub se lam dieu kien do lot
--    qua roi chay tiep voi du lieu rong, tu loi im thanh loi sai.
-- ============================================================================
local LurnaEnv = { Caps = {}, Stubbed = {}, Env = nil, Name = "?" }
do
    -- Table nao dung la moi truong that? Ghi thu roi doc lai bang global tran.
    local function connected(t)
        if type(t) ~= "table" then return false end
        local ok = pcall(function() t.__LurnaEnvProbe = true end)
        local seen = (__LurnaEnvProbe == true)
        pcall(function() t.__LurnaEnvProbe = nil end)
        return ok and seen
    end

    local pick = nil
    if type(getgenv) == "function" then
        local ok, t = pcall(getgenv)
        if ok and connected(t) then pick = t end
    end
    if not pick and type(getfenv) == "function" then
        local ok, t = pcall(getfenv, 0)
        if ok and connected(t) then pick = t end
    end
    if not pick then pick = _G end
    LurnaEnv.Env = pick

    -- Va lai getgenv cho 387 cho goi san: neu getgenv dang tra ve table chet
    -- thi tu day tro di no tra ve dung table ma bien toan cuc doc duoc.
    if type(getgenv) ~= "function" then
        pcall(function() pick.getgenv = function() return pick end end)
    else
        local ok, t = pcall(getgenv)
        if not (ok and connected(t)) then
            pcall(function() pick.getgenv = function() return pick end end)
        end
    end

    pcall(function()
        if type(identifyexecutor) == "function" then
            LurnaEnv.Name = tostring(identifyexecutor())
        elseif type(getexecutorname) == "function" then
            LurnaEnv.Name = tostring(getexecutorname())
        end
    end)
    -- Danh sach ham nang cao hub nay dung that (da grep ca file), khong liet ke
    -- cho dep. Do bang getfenv(0) truoc roi den pick: mot so executor de ham o
    -- moi truong that nhung khong bo vao getgenv.
    local WANTED = {
        "getrawmetatable", "setreadonly", "newcclosure", "getnamecallmethod",
        "getgc", "getupvalues", "setupvalue", "getconnections", "getsenv",
        "cloneref", "getcustomasset", "setfpscap", "checkcaller",
        "fireproximityprompt", "firetouchinterest", "queue_on_teleport",
        "setclipboard", "writefile", "readfile", "isfile", "listfiles",
        "makefolder", "request", "http_request", "hookfunction",
        "hookmetamethod", "getupvalue", "islclosure", "getloadedmodules",
    }
    local root = nil
    pcall(function() if type(getfenv) == "function" then root = getfenv(0) end end)
    local function lookup(n)
        local f = nil
        if type(root) == "table" then f = rawget(root, n) end
        if type(f) ~= "function" and type(pick) == "table" then f = rawget(pick, n) end
        if type(f) ~= "function" then
            pcall(function()
                local g = _G[n]
                if type(g) == "function" then f = g end
            end)
        end
        return (type(f) == "function") and f or nil
    end
    for _, n in ipairs(WANTED) do
        LurnaEnv.Caps[n] = (lookup(n) ~= nil)
    end
    LurnaEnv.Caps["http"] = LurnaEnv.Caps["request"] or LurnaEnv.Caps["http_request"]
    LurnaEnv.Caps["fs"] = LurnaEnv.Caps["writefile"] and LurnaEnv.Caps["readfile"]
        and LurnaEnv.Caps["isfile"]

    function LurnaEnv.Has(n)
        return LurnaEnv.Caps[n] == true
    end

    -- Stub CHI cho 5 ham dang duoc goi tran o duoi. Gia tri tra ve phai vo hai
    -- theo dung cach ma cho goi mong doi: getgc tra bang rong thi vong `for _,v
    -- in next, getgc()` chay 0 lan, newcclosure tra lai chinh ham thi hook van
    -- gan duoc (chi la khong duoc boc C), getnamecallmethod tra "" thi dieu kien
    -- FireServer that bai -> hook nhuong duong cho ham goc.
    local STUB = {
        newcclosure = function(f) return f end,
        getnamecallmethod = function() return "" end,
        getgc = function() return {} end,
        getupvalues = function() return {} end,
        setupvalue = function() end,
    }
    for n, f in pairs(STUB) do
        if not LurnaEnv.Caps[n] then
            local ok = pcall(function() pick[n] = f end)
            if ok then LurnaEnv.Stubbed[n] = true end
        end
    end

    -- In ra cho nguoi dung biet executor thieu gi, thay vi de ho doan tai sao
    -- mot cong tac bat len ma khong co gi xay ra.
    function LurnaEnv.Report()
        local miss = {}
        for _, n in ipairs(WANTED) do
            if not LurnaEnv.Caps[n] then miss[#miss + 1] = n end
        end
        local st = {}
        for n in pairs(LurnaEnv.Stubbed) do
            if type(n) == "string" then st[#st + 1] = n end
        end
        table.sort(miss)
        table.sort(st)
        return {
            Executor = LurnaEnv.Name,
            Missing = miss,
            Stubbed = st,
            Http = LurnaEnv.Caps["http"] == true,
            Fs = LurnaEnv.Caps["fs"] == true,
        }
    end
end

-- Ba dong goc, gio khong con lam sup hub khi thieu ham. gg/old = nil thi hook
-- ben duoi tu bo qua, cac tinh nang khac chay binh thuong.
local gg, old = nil, nil
if LurnaEnv.Has("getrawmetatable") then
    pcall(function() gg = getrawmetatable(game) end)
end
if gg then
    pcall(function() old = gg.__namecall end)
    if LurnaEnv.Has("setreadonly") then pcall(setreadonly, gg, false) end
end
-- ============================================================================
-- [LURNA FIX #316] DO BELI/GIO THAT
-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Muc tieu "5 trieu beli/gio" khong the kiem chung neu khong do. Truoc day hub
-- co hien plr.Data.Beli.Value (mot con so tuyet doi) nhung khong co toc do, nen
-- khong ai biet doi mot thiet lap lam farm nhanh len hay cham di.
--
-- Hai quyet dinh do luong o day:
--
-- 1) CHI CONG DON PHAN TANG. Beli GIAM khi mua vu khi / mua chip / mua Race, va
--    hub nay co ca AutoBuy (dong 11654-11660 mua Black Leg 150k, Electro 500k,
--    Fishman Karate 750k). Neu lay hieu tho (beli_bay_gio - beli_luc_truoc) thi
--    mot lan mua 750k se dim toc do xuong am hang chuc phut. Nen moi lan lay mau
--    chi cong `d` khi d > 0, va luu SO CONG DON vao vong dem. Toc do = hieu cua
--    so cong don tren cua so thoi gian -> khong bao gio am, khong bi tien mua
--    lam nhiem.
--
-- 2) CUA SO TRUOT, khong phai trung binh tu luc bat. Farm co pha: doi respawn,
--    bay giua dao, doi quest. Trung binh ca phien lam mo het cac pha do. Vong
--    dem giu 10 phut (120 mau x 5s) nen doc duoc ca toc do 1 phut gan nhat lan
--    5 phut, va so sanh hai cai do la biet farm dang tot lem hay dang tac.
-- ============================================================================
local LurnaBeli = { Target = 5000000 }
do
    local SAMPLE = 5      -- giay giua hai lan lay mau
    local KEEP = 120      -- so mau giu lai = 10 phut
    local buf = {}        -- vong dem: buf[i] = { t = os.clock(), c = beli cong don }
    local n = 0           -- so mau da ghi (khong giam)
    local earned = 0      -- tong beli KIEM DUOC tu luc chay (chi cong phan tang)
    local lastV = nil
    local t0 = os.clock()

    local function readBeli()
        local v = nil
        pcall(function() v = tonumber(plr.Data.Beli.Value) end)
        return v
    end

    -- Vong dem ghi de: chi so that = ((n - 1) % KEEP) + 1, nen khong bao gio
    -- table.remove(1) (O(n) moi lan) nhu cach viet thuong thay.
    local function push(t, c)
        n = n + 1
        buf[((n - 1) % KEEP) + 1] = { t = t, c = c }
    end

    -- Lay mau cu nhat con nam TRONG cua so `sec`. Neu chua du du lieu thi lay
    -- mau cu nhat co, va tra ve luon do dai thuc te da do duoc de ben goi biet
    -- con so nay dang dua tren bao nhieu giay.
    local function oldestIn(sec)
        local now = os.clock()
        local best = nil
        local lim = math.min(n, KEEP)
        for i = 1, lim do
            local s = buf[i]
            if s and (now - s.t) <= sec then
                if not best or s.t < best.t then best = s end
            end
        end
        if best then return best end
        local oldest = nil
        for i = 1, lim do
            local s = buf[i]
            if s and (not oldest or s.t < oldest.t) then oldest = s end
        end
        return oldest
    end

    -- beli/gio tren cua so `sec`. Tra ve nil khi chua do duoc it nhat 20s: mot
    -- con so dua tren 5s dau se nhay lung tung va vo nghia.
    function LurnaBeli.Rate(sec)
        local s = oldestIn(sec or 60)
        if not s then return nil, 0 end
        local dt = os.clock() - s.t
        if dt < 20 then return nil, dt end
        return ((earned - s.c) / dt) * 3600, dt
    end

    function LurnaBeli.Earned() return earned end
    function LurnaBeli.Uptime() return os.clock() - t0 end

    function LurnaBeli.Stats()
        local r1 = LurnaBeli.Rate(60)
        local r5 = LurnaBeli.Rate(300)
        local up = os.clock() - t0
        local avg = (up >= 20) and ((earned / up) * 3600) or nil
        return {
            Earned = earned,
            Uptime = up,
            Rate1 = r1,
            Rate5 = r5,
            RateAvg = avg,
            Target = tonumber(LurnaBeli.Target) or 5000000,
            Balance = lastV,
        }
    end

    task.spawn(function()
        if _G.__LurnaBeliLoop then return end
        _G.__LurnaBeliLoop = true
        lastV = readBeli()
        push(os.clock(), 0)
        while task.wait(SAMPLE) do
            local v = readBeli()
            if v then
                if lastV then
                    local d = v - lastV
                    if d > 0 then earned = earned + d end
                end
                lastV = v
            end
            push(os.clock(), earned)
        end
    end)
end
-- ============================================================================
-- [LURNA FIX #317] NHIP FARM THEO FRAME TIME (mượt hơn khi máy yếu)
-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Vong farm chinh chay `while task.wait(Sec)` voi Sec = 0.1 CO DINH (dong 41),
-- tuc 10 nhip/giay bat ke may dang chay bao nhieu FPS. Tren may khoe thi khong
-- sao. Tren dien thoai / may yeu thi moi nhip con phai canh voi:
--   - bo ghim mob theo TUNG FRAME cua LurnaHoldAt (FIX #40)
--   - BringEnemy quet workspace.Enemies moi 0.25s
--   - LurnaEnsureWeapon + LurnaAnchor + _tp moi nhip
-- Khi frame time da tren 33ms, 10 nhip/giay khong lam farm nhanh hon mot chut
-- nao (server co cooldown don rieng) nhung lam frame rate sut them -> nguoi dung
-- thay "giat". Nen do frame time that roi gian nhip ra khi may dang kho.
--
-- Chi noi ra cho ro: day KHONG phai farm cham di. So don/giay do server quyet,
-- khong phai do so lan minh ghi CFrame. Gian nhip chi bo bot cong viec du.
--
-- Khong sua bien `Sec` toan cuc: no duoc dung o hang tram vong khac, trong do co
-- nhung vong thoat bang `until Root.Position == <hang so>` (xem FIX #272) nen doi
-- nhip cua chung la viec rieng. Cho nay chi lay nhip cho vong farm chinh.
-- ============================================================================
LurnaFarmTick = nil
do
    local RS = game:GetService("RunService")
    local avg = 1 / 60          -- frame time trung binh truot
    local floorSec = 0.1        -- nhip nhanh nhat, dung bang Sec cu

    RS.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
        -- He so 0.1: nhay theo tut FPS trong khoang ~1 giay, khong giat theo mot
        -- frame don le (mot frame 200ms vi Roblox nap asset la binh thuong).
        avg = avg + (dt - avg) * 0.1
    end)

    -- Nguoi dung van chan tren duoc: LurnaFarmTickMax = 0.1 la tat han tinh nang
    -- nay, hanh vi tro lai y ban cu.
    function LurnaFarmTick()
        local cap = tonumber(getgenv().LurnaFarmTickMax) or 0.25
        if cap < floorSec then cap = floorSec end
        local fps = (avg > 0) and (1 / avg) or 60
        if fps >= 45 then return floorSec end
        if fps <= 18 then return cap end
        -- 18..45 FPS: noi thang tu floorSec len cap
        local k = (45 - fps) / (45 - 18)
        return floorSec + (cap - floorSec) * k
    end

    _G.LurnaFarmFPS = function()
        return (avg > 0) and (1 / avg) or 0
    end
end
-- ============================================================================
-- [LURNA FIX #319] ANTI-BAN: BOT DAU VET "MAY MOC", KHONG PHAI TAT DETECTION
-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Noi thang truoc: khong co cach nao dua ti le khoa acc ve 0 khi dang chay
-- script. Nhung phan lon acc bi khoa khong phai vi ai doc duoc code cua minh -
-- ma vi minh gui len server nhung CON SO khong the la nguoi that. Loai do de do,
-- de ghi log, de doi chieu hang loat. Ba dau vet ro nhat trong chinh file nay:
--
--   1) NHIP DANH DEU TUYET DOI. LurnaAtkGate() mo van dung moi 0.15s => moc thoi
--      gian cua RE/RegisterAttack cach nhau 150ms +- vai ms trong suot hang gio.
--      Nguoi that lech hang chuc ms. Day la dau vet RE NHAT de bo: rai nhieu
--      quanh gia tri trung binh thi thong luong KHONG doi (van ~6.7 don/giay),
--      ma tinh chu ky bien mat.
--
--   2) SimulationRadius = math.huge (4 cho: :876 :13090 :13840 :16683). Khong
--      client that nao dat gia tri do. Ma farm nay chi can phu BringEnemy (350)
--      + tam danh (75); mot so huu han lon lam duoc y het viec do.
--
--   3) CHAY LIEN TUC KHONG NGHI. 8 tieng khong dut mot giay la thu nguoi that
--      khong lam duoc. Day la muc DUY NHAT trong nhom nay co tra gia bang thong
--      luong, nen mac dinh TAT - bat hay khong la ban chon.
--
-- KHONG lam trong day: khong hook, khong vo hieu hoa, khong bit module chong
-- gian lan nao cua game. Do la pha he thong an ninh cua ho, khac han voi viec
-- chinh so cua chinh minh cho hop ly.
-- ============================================================================
LurnaAntiBan = { BreakUntil = 0 }
do
    getgenv().LurnaAtkJitter  = tonumber(getgenv().LurnaAtkJitter)  or 0.18
    getgenv().LurnaPauseOdds  = tonumber(getgenv().LurnaPauseOdds)  or 0
    getgenv().LurnaSimRadius  = tonumber(getgenv().LurnaSimRadius)  or 1500
    getgenv().LurnaBreakEvery = tonumber(getgenv().LurnaBreakEvery) or 0
    getgenv().LurnaBreakFor   = tonumber(getgenv().LurnaBreakFor)   or 20

    local ATK_FLOOR = 0.10   -- san cung cua rule §1: jitter khong duoc pha xuong

    -- Khoang cach toi lan ban ke tiep. Rai deu quanh `base` nen ky vong = base,
    -- thong luong trung binh khong doi.
    -- [LURNA FIX #322] Ban #319 tinh cuc "rot tay" THEO MOI LAN BAN: odds = 3
    -- -> 3% moi lan goi. O nhip 0.15s la ~6.7 lan/giay, nen 3% hoa ra la mot
    -- cuc dung 0.3-0.8s CU ~5.5 GIAY MOT LAN - do dung la cai "kill aura bi
    -- khuot". Va vi cuc nay CONG THEM chu khong rai deu hai ben nhu jitter, no
    -- an that ~10% thong luong (0.03 * 0.55s tren nen 0.15s). Sai don vi chu
    -- khong sai y tuong. Nay: tinh theo LAN/PHUT nen khong con phong to theo
    -- nhip ban, cuc ngan hon nhieu (0.10-0.25s), va MAC DINH = 0 tuc TAT han.
    local lastHes = 0
    function LurnaAntiBan.AtkInterval(base)
        base = tonumber(base) or 0.15
        local j = tonumber(getgenv().LurnaAtkJitter) or 0
        if j < 0 then j = 0 end
        if j > 0.5 then j = 0.5 end
        local v = base * (1 + (math.random() * 2 - 1) * j)
        local per = tonumber(getgenv().LurnaPauseOdds) or 0   -- lan / PHUT
        if per > 0 then
            local now = os.clock()
            if now - lastHes >= (60 / per) then
                lastHes = now
                v = v + 0.10 + math.random() * 0.15
            end
        end
        if v < ATK_FLOOR then v = ATK_FLOOR end
        return v
    end

    -- Nghi ngan dinh ky. Ep qua LurnaAtkGate nen CHI mot cho nay la chan het ca
    -- ba nguon ban remote (AttackNoCoolDown + FastAttackModule + HitRegistration)
    -- - khong phai di sua hang tram vong farm. Nhan vat van di lai, chi khong ra
    -- don: dung thu ma server thay duoc.
    local lastBreak = os.clock()
    function LurnaAntiBan.Resting()
        local every = tonumber(getgenv().LurnaBreakEvery) or 0
        if every <= 0 then return false end
        local now = os.clock()
        if LurnaAntiBan.BreakUntil > now then return true end
        if now - lastBreak >= every * 60 then
            lastBreak = now
            local dur = tonumber(getgenv().LurnaBreakFor) or 20
            -- rai +-30%: nghi dung 20.00s moi lan cung lai la mot chu ky de do
            LurnaAntiBan.BreakUntil = now + dur * (0.7 + math.random() * 0.6)
            return true
        end
        return false
    end

    -- Thay math.huge o 4 cho. 1500 van phu ban kinh gom mob 350 va tam danh 75
    -- nen khong mat chuc nang nao.
    function LurnaAntiBan.SimRadius()
        if not sethiddenproperty then return end
        local r = tonumber(getgenv().LurnaSimRadius) or 1500
        if r < 500 then r = 500 end
        pcall(sethiddenproperty, plr, "SimulationRadius", r)
    end

    -- Bang danh gia rui ro. Khong hua hen gi - chi noi ro dang de lo cho nao,
    -- vi cai quyet dinh ti le bi khoa la THIET LAP nguoi dung chon, khong phai
    -- mot cong tac "anti-ban" nao.
    function LurnaAntiBan.Risk()
        local L, score = {}, 0
        local rate = tonumber(getgenv().FastAttackSpeed) or 0.15
        if rate <= 0.105 then
            score = score + 35
            L[#L + 1] = "Nhịp đánh 100ms — nhanh nhất có thể, rủi ro cao nhất"
        elseif rate < 0.14 then
            score = score + 15
            L[#L + 1] = "Nhịp đánh " .. math.floor(rate * 1000) .. "ms — dưới mặc định 150ms"
        end
        if (tonumber(getgenv().LurnaAtkJitter) or 0) <= 0 then
            score = score + 20
            L[#L + 1] = "Không rải nhịp đánh — mốc thời gian đều tuyệt đối"
        end
        if _G.LurnaHitReg then
            score = score + 25
            L[#L + 1] = "Hit Registration đang BẬT — gói hit có cả Character của mình"
        end
        if (tonumber(getgenv().LurnaSimRadius) or 1500) > 100000 then
            score = score + 20
            L[#L + 1] = "SimulationRadius vô cực"
        end
        if _G.LurnaHitboxOn then
            score = score + 10
            L[#L + 1] = "Hitbox Expander đang bật"
        end
        -- [LURNA FEATURE #21] Noclip la hanh vi de nhan ra: nguoi nam trong long nui
        -- hay trong tuong la trang thai khong the co khi choi that. Tinh diem o day
        -- de o Rui Ro noi that, chu khong am tham coi nhu vo hai.
        if getgenv().LurnaNoclip then
            score = score + 15
            L[#L + 1] = "Noclip đang BẬT — vị trí xuyên vào địa hình rất dễ nhận ra"
        end
        if not _G.AutoHopServer then
            score = score + 10
            L[#L + 1] = "Không hop server — ở một server quá lâu"
        end
        if (tonumber(getgenv().LurnaBreakEvery) or 0) <= 0 then
            score = score + 10
            L[#L + 1] = "Không nghỉ giữa phiên"
        end
        if score > 100 then score = 100 end
        return score, L
    end
end
-- [LURNA FIX #48] hook __namecall cu co 3 loi khien Aimbot "bat ma khong an":
--   a) gan args[2] = MousePos ma khong kiem tra MousePos co phai Vector3 khong. Khi
--      chua co muc tieu MousePos = nil => tool ban vao nil, server bo qua, va cac
--      vong Farm Mastery / SeaBeast cung mat luon don trong khoang do.
--   b) dieu kien chi mo khi ABmethod == "Aim Player"/"Nearest Aim", nhung dropdown
--      Select Aim Method khong bao gio goi callback luc tao (xem FIX #50) nen
--      ABmethod = nil => bat Aimbot Method Skills hoan toan vo tac dung.
--   c) khong co Silent Aim. Nay them getgenv().LurnaSilentAim: moi phat ban tu tool
--      deu duoc keo ve muc tieu aim hien tai (chi khi DA co muc tieu, chua co thi
--      giu nguyen MousePos de khong pha vong farm).
-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- [LURNA FIX #306] Bao loi nguoi dung: "silent aim cx v" (cung khong on). Ban #48
-- con BON loi, hai trong so do la loi lam MAT sat thuong:
--   1) `tostring(args[1]) == "RemoteEvent"` KHONG kiem tra lop cua remote.
--      tostring(Instance) tra ve TEN (Instance.Name), khong phai ClassName. Nen dieu
--      kien nay chi khop dung nhung remote DAT TEN la "RemoteEvent" - tinh co la
--      Tool.RemoteEvent cua Blox Fruits, con moi remote khac (RE/ShootGunEvent,
--      remote cua skill trai...) thi KHONG BAO GIO duoc ngam. Do la ly do Silent Aim
--      "bat nhung nhu khong bat".
--   2) Ghi de args[2] BAT KE no la gi. Chinh vong Aimbot Gun cua file nay ban
--      `re:FireServer("TAP", part.Position)` cho Skull Guitar (dong 15399): args[2]
--      la chuoi "TAP" va bi thay bang mot Vector3 => goi tin sai chu ky, server bo,
--      Aimbot Gun voi Skull Guitar KHONG BAO GIO ban duoc. Gio chi thay the doi so
--      DA LA Vector3.
--   3) `old(unpack(args))` mat so luong doi so: unpack dung o phan tu nil dau tien.
--      Dung select("#", ...) + table.pack/unpack de giu dung chu ky.
--   4) Khong co danh sach chan. Sau khi sua loi (1), hook se khop THEM nhieu remote,
--      trong do co `LeftClickRemote:FireServer(Vector3.new(0.01,-500,0.01),1,true)`
--      o dong 17491 - doi so do la HUONG danh xuong, khong phai toa do. Ghi de bang
--      toa do muc tieu la pha nhanh farm do. Ba remote sat thuong bi chan theo ten.
-- KHONG dung checkcaller() o day (khac voi #305 ben Auto_Bounty): rat nhieu vong farm
-- trong file nay TU ban remote va DUA VAO hook nay chinh vi tri cho chung; chan theo
-- checkcaller la tat luon nhung vong do.
local LurnaAimDeny = {
    ["LeftClickRemote"] = true,
    ["RE/RegisterHit"] = true,
    ["RE/RegisterAttack"] = true,
}
-- Dieu kien mo hook: giu Y NGUYEN danh sach co cua #48, chi tach ra ham cho doc duoc.
local function LurnaAimWanted()
  return (_G.FarmMastery_G and not SoulGuitar) or (_G.FarmMastery_Dev) or (_G.FarmBlazeEM)
    or (_G.Prehis_Skills)
    or (_G.SeaBeast1 or _G.FishBoat or _G.PGB or _G.Leviathan1 or _G.Complete_Trials)
    or _G.AimMethod or getgenv().LurnaSilentAim
end
-- [LURNA FIX #307] Doc BO PHAN cua muc tieu roi lay .Position NGAY LUC goi tin bay
-- di, thay vi dung toa do da chup san trong _G.__LurnaAimPos. Vong aim chay
-- `while task.wait()` nen anh chup gia tam 1 frame, nhung nguoi choi Blox Fruits
-- dung Soru/Fly di 60-100 studs/giay - du de lech ra ngoai hitbox. Van giu day du
-- chuoi du phong cu (anh chup -> MousePos) de khong pha cac vong farm dang dua vao no.
local function LurnaAimPoint()
  if getgenv().LurnaSilentAim then
    local part = _G.__LurnaAimPart
    if typeof(part) == "Instance" and part.Parent then return part.Position end
    if typeof(_G.__LurnaAimPos) == "Vector3" then return _G.__LurnaAimPos end
  end
  if typeof(MousePos) == "Vector3" then return MousePos end
  return nil
end
-- [LURNA FIX #315] Chi cai hook khi that su co metatable + ham goc. Thieu thi
-- Aimbot im lang khong hoat dong, con lai ca hub van chay - truoc day cho nay
-- lam sup toan bo script.
if gg and old then
gg.__namecall = newcclosure(function(self, ...)
  -- Duong ve NHANH: hook nay nam tren MOI loi goi `obj:Method()` cua ca game.
  if not LurnaAimWanted() then return old(self, ...) end
  if tostring(getnamecallmethod()) ~= "FireServer" then return old(self, ...) end
  if typeof(self) ~= "Instance" then return old(self, ...) end
  local isRe = false
  pcall(function() isRe = self:IsA("RemoteEvent") end)
  if not isRe or LurnaAimDeny[self.Name] then return old(self, ...) end

  local aim = LurnaAimPoint()
  if typeof(aim) ~= "Vector3" then return old(self, ...) end

  local n = select("#", ...)
  for i = 1, n do
    if typeof((select(i, ...))) == "Vector3" then
      local args = table.pack(...)
      args[i] = aim
      return old(self, table.unpack(args, 1, n))
    end
  end
  return old(self, ...)
end)
end -- [#315] dong khoi `if gg and old then`
-- [LURNA FIX #43] GetConnectionEnemies cu tra ve con mob DAU TIEN khop ten theo
-- thu tu Instance. Ham nay la nguon chon muc tieu cua RAT NHIEU vong farm (Bone,
-- Ectoplasm, Dojo, mastery, boss...) nen tat ca deu bi bam vao con le loi o xa.
-- Nay gom het roi tra ve con nam trong CUM DONG NHAT (dung chung LurnaBestOf),
-- them loc IsBoat va khong con index truc tiep workspace.Enemies.
GetConnectionEnemies = function(a)
  local function collect(container)
    local list = {}
    if not container then return list end
    for _, v in ipairs(container:GetChildren()) do
      if v:IsA("Model") and ((typeof(a) == "table" and table.find(a, v.Name)) or v.Name == a)
        and Attack.Alive(v) and not v:GetAttribute("IsBoat") then
        table.insert(list, v)
      end
    end
    return list
  end
  local list = collect(replicated)
  if #list == 0 then list = collect(workspace:FindFirstChild("Enemies")) end
  return LurnaBestOf(list)
end
LowCpu = function()
  local decalsyeeted = true
  local g = game
  local w = g.Workspace
  local l = g.Lighting
  local t = w.Terrain
  t.WaterWaveSize = 0
  t.WaterWaveSpeed = 0
  t.WaterReflectance = 0
  t.WaterTransparency = 0
  l.GlobalShadows = false
  l.FogEnd = 9e9
  l.Brightness = 0
  settings().Rendering.QualityLevel = "Level01"
  for i, v in pairs(g:GetDescendants()) do
    if v:IsA("Part") or v:IsA("Union") or v:IsA("CornerWedgePart") or v:IsA("TrussPart") then
      v.Material = "Plastic"
      v.Reflectance = 0
    elseif v:IsA("Decal") or v:IsA("Texture") and decalsyeeted then
      v.Transparency = 1
    elseif v:IsA("ParticleEmitter") or v:IsA("Trail") then
      v.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0)
    elseif v:IsA("Explosion") then
      v.BlastPressure = 1
      v.BlastRadius = 1
    elseif v:IsA("Fire") or v:IsA("SpotLight") or v:IsA("Smoke") or v:IsA("Sparkles") then
      v.Enabled = false
    elseif v:IsA("MeshPart") then
      v.Material = "Plastic"
      v.Reflectance = 0
      v.TextureID = 10385902758728957
    end
  end
  for i, e in pairs(l:GetChildren()) do
    if e:IsA("BlurEffect") or e:IsA("SunRaysEffect") or e:IsA("ColorCorrectionEffect") or e:IsA("BloomEffect") or e:IsA("DepthOfFieldEffect") then
      e.Enabled = false
    end
  end
end

CheckBoat = function()
  -- [LURNA FIX #69] `v.Owner.Value` index TRUC TIEP: bat ky con nao trong
  -- workspace.Boats KHONG co "Owner" (thuyen NPC, thuyen event, mo hinh trang tri,
  -- clone cua nguoi khac) deu lam ham nay NEM LOI. CheckBoat duoc goi trong 3 vong
  -- (SailBoats, SailBoat_Hydra, chuoi Leviathan) va ca ba chi co MOT pcall bao
  -- ngoai => mot con thuyen la lam chet ca tick. Nay loc IsA("Model") +
  -- FindFirstChild("Owner") dung nhu checkboatBeastHunter() trong corpus
  -- (deobfuscated.lua.txt:18398-18422).
  local boats = workspace:FindFirstChild("Boats")
  if not boats then return false end
  for _, v in ipairs(boats:GetChildren()) do
    if v:IsA("Model") then
      local own = v:FindFirstChild("Owner")
      if own and tostring(own.Value) == tostring(plr.Name) then
        return v
      end
    end
  end
  return false
end

_G.__LurnaGate = _G.__LurnaGate or {}
function LurnaGate(key, sec)
  local now = tick()
  local last = _G.__LurnaGate[key]
  if last and (now - last) < (tonumber(sec) or 1) then return false end
  _G.__LurnaGate[key] = now
  return true
end
function LurnaGateReset(key)
  _G.__LurnaGate[key] = nil
end

-- [LURNA FEATURE #11] HA TANG DUNG CHUNG CHO RAID / DUNGEON
-- Dat o day (truoc moi vong lap) de cac vong o cuoi file goi duoc ngay tu tick dau.
-- ============================================================================
-- Trang thai raid: corpus Hub/ dung CA HAI duong dan GUI
--   PlayerGui.Main.TopHUDList.RaidTimer.Visible  (71 lan)
--   PlayerGui.Main.Timer.Visible                 (80 lan)
-- Ban cu chi index 1 duong dan va index TRUC TIEP nen throw khi thieu.
function LurnaRaidActive()
  local ok, res = pcall(function()
    local gui = plr:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui")
    local main = gui and gui:FindFirstChild("Main")
    if not main then return false end
    local top = main:FindFirstChild("TopHUDList")
    local t1 = top and top:FindFirstChild("RaidTimer")
    if t1 and t1.Visible then return true end
    local t2 = main:FindFirstChild("Timer")
    if t2 and t2.Visible then return true end
    return false
  end)
  return ok and res or false
end

-- Ten 5 dao raid: da kiem chung trong corpus (Island 1..5, 58-68 lan moi ten).
LurnaRaidIslands = {"Island 1","Island 2","Island 3","Island 4","Island 5"}

function LurnaRaidLocations()
  local wo = workspace:FindFirstChild("_WorldOrigin")
  return wo and wo:FindFirstChild("Locations") or nil
end

-- Dao raid gan nhat voi nhan vat.
function LurnaRaidCurrentIsland()
  local loc = LurnaRaidLocations()
  local hrp = LurnaHRP()
  if not loc or not hrp then return nil end
  local best, bestD = nil, math.huge
  for _, name in ipairs(LurnaRaidIslands) do
    local p = loc:FindFirstChild(name)
    if p then
      local d = (hrp.Position - p.Position).Magnitude
      if d < bestD then bestD = d best = name end
    end
  end
  return best
end

-- Chon mob trong ban kinh `radius` quanh dao raid hien tai, cham diem theo cum
-- dong nhat (dung lai LurnaBestOf cua FEATURE #4) thay vi lay con dau tien.
function LurnaRaidPickMob(radius)
  local loc = LurnaRaidLocations()
  local cur = LurnaRaidCurrentIsland()
  if not loc or not cur then return nil end
  local isl = loc:FindFirstChild(cur)
  if not isl then return nil end
  local r = tonumber(radius) or 450
  local en = workspace:FindFirstChild("Enemies")
  if not en then return nil end
  local list = {}
  for _, v in ipairs(en:GetChildren()) do
    if v:IsA("Model") and Attack.Alive(v) and not v:GetAttribute("IsBoat") then
      local root = v:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
      if root and (root.Position - isl.Position).Magnitude < r then
        table.insert(list, v)
      end
    end
  end
  if #list == 0 then return nil end
  _G.__LurnaRaidIsland = cur
  return LurnaBestOf(list, r)
end

-- Dao ke tiep trong chuoi 1->5. Tra ve Instance de goi _tp.
function LurnaRaidNextIsland()
  local loc = LurnaRaidLocations()
  local cur = LurnaRaidCurrentIsland()
  if not loc or not cur then return nil end
  local i = table.find(LurnaRaidIslands, cur)
  if not i or not LurnaRaidIslands[i+1] then return nil end
  return loc:FindFirstChild(LurnaRaidIslands[i+1])
end

	 end
    end
  end
  return false
end

	  end
    end
  end
return 0
end

getInfinity_Ability = function(Method, Var)
  if not Root then return end
  if Method == "Soru" and Var then
    for _,gc in next, getgc() do
      if plr.Character.Soru then
        if ((typeof(gc) == "function") and (getfenv(gc).script == plr.Character.Soru)) then
          for _, v in next, getupvalues(gc) do
            if (typeof(v) == "table") then
              repeat wait(Sec) v.LastUse = 0 until not Var or (not Attack.Alive(plr.Character))
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end    
  elseif Method == "Energy" and Var then
    plr.Character.Energy.Changed:connect(function()
      if Var then plr.Character.Energy.Value = Energy end 
    end)
  elseif Method == "Observation" and Var then
    local VisionRadius = plr.VisionRadius
    VisionRadius.Value = math.huge
  end
end

    end
  end)
end

-- ============================================================================
-- [LURNA FIX #40] HAI LOI CON LAI GAY RUNG KHI TREO TREN MOB
--   a) toPos cu tao BodyVelocity "LurnaVelocity" (Velocity = 0, MaxForce = 1e9) va
--      KHONG BAO GIO xoa. Humanoid van co gang di chuyen nhan vat trong khi
--      BodyVelocity keo van toc ve 0 => hai luc danh nhau => nhan vat rung tai cho.
--      Te hon: sau khi tat farm, vat the nay con nguyen nen nhan vat bi "dong bang"
--      giua khong khi.
--   b) Vong farm chi ghi CFrame 10 lan/giay (Sec = 0.1). Giua 2 lan ghi, trong luc
--      keo nhan vat roi ~5cm roi bi snap len lai => rung nhe o tan so 10Hz.
-- Cach sua: mot bo ghim chay MOI FRAME (Heartbeat). Vong farm chi can cap nhat toa
-- do dich (LurnaHoldAt), bo ghim giu nhan vat dung yen tuyet doi giua cac tick.
-- Tu nha ghim sau 0.5s khong duoc cap nhat => tat farm la di chuyen lai binh thuong.
-- ============================================================================
LurnaHoldCF = nil
LurnaHoldT = 0
function LurnaHoldAt(cf)
    LurnaHoldCF = cf
    LurnaHoldT = tick()
end
function LurnaHoldRelease()
    LurnaHoldCF = nil
end
task.spawn(function()
    if _G.__LurnaHoldLoop then return end
    _G.__LurnaHoldLoop = true
    game:GetService("RunService").Heartbeat:Connect(function()
        if not LurnaHoldCF then return end
        if tick() - (LurnaHoldT or 0) > 0.5 then
            LurnaHoldCF = nil
            return
        end
        local hrp = LurnaHRP()
        if not hrp then return end
        -- Neu mot chuc nang KHAC vua dich chuyen nhan vat di xa (vd: dung plate quest,
        -- vao raid, hop server) thi NHA ghim ngay, khong keo nguoi choi ve.
        if (hrp.Position - LurnaHoldCF.Position).Magnitude > 60 then
            LurnaHoldCF = nil
            return
        end
        hrp.CFrame = LurnaHoldCF
        hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
        hrp.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
    end)
end)

-- [LURNA FIX #54] requestEntrance CU KHONG BAO GIO CO TAC DUNG
-- Ban cu: LurnaRequestEntrance(pos) ban THANG toa do dich cho remote
-- "requestEntrance". Server Blox Fruits chi chap nhan toa do cua MOT CUA VAO
-- CO THAT (Sky3, UnderWater, Cursed Ship, Mansion, Castle...); voi toa do mob
-- hoac tam dao bat ky thi remote bi bo qua => moi chuyen di xa deu phai tween
-- 100% duong o 325 studs/s.
-- Ban moi: dung bang cua vao co dinh theo tung sea (dung mo hinh cua
-- Blox_Fruits_Kaitun.lua:961 trong chinh project nay), chon cua GAN DICH NHAT
-- va CHI ban khi cua do gan dich hon vi tri hien tai (neu khong thi ban se bi
-- keo ra xa hon). Moi toa do duoi day doi chieu duoc trong corpus Hub/
-- (Cursed Ship xuat hien 64 lan, Mansion 52, UnderWater 24, Castle 20,
--  Hydra 16, Temple of Time 13, Sky3 13, Sky3Exit 12).
-- ==========================================================================
LurnaHasItem = function(name)
    local inv = nil
    pcall(function() inv = LurnaCommF("getInventory") end)
    if type(inv) ~= "table" then return false end
    for _, v in pairs(inv) do
        if type(v) == "table" and v.Name == name then return true end
    end
    return false
end
