-- Gia 4 mon vo GOC ma engine Superhuman (:10296) can mua. Ba mon dau tra bang Beli,
-- Dragon Claw tra bang 1500 Fragments qua BlackbeardReward (:10307).
LurnaFullP1Base = {
  { name = "Black Leg",      cost = 150000, cur = "Beli" },
  { name = "Electro",        cost = 500000, cur = "Beli" },
  { name = "Fishman Karate", cost = 750000, cur = "Beli" },
  { name = "Dragon Claw",    cost = 1500,   cur = "Fragments" },
}

-- [LURNA FIX #149] Bao ro dang TAC VI TIEN, khong phai tac vi loi.
-- LOI THAT: engine Superhuman chi ghi _G.Level = true trong nhanh "DA CO mon vo goc
-- ma mastery < 299". Neu mon goc CHUA CO va tien KHONG DU thi ca 4 nhanh deu roi vao
-- "if not GetBP(...) then if Beli >= X ..." - khong ai ghi _G.Level ca. Nhan vat dung
-- yen, LurnaFullSig khong doi, 240s sau watchdog khoa Phase 1 va bao "dung im" - trong
-- khi nguyen nhan that chi la thieu Beli. Nay: san farm luon do LurnaFullFarmFloor
-- (trong LurnaFullReadyStep) dam nhiem, con ham nay noi ro con thieu bao nhieu tien.
function LurnaFullP1Money()
  local m = {}
  for _, b in ipairs(LurnaFullP1Base) do
    if not LurnaFullHas(b.name) then
      local have = (b.cur == "Beli") and LurnaFullBeli() or LurnaFullFrag()
      if have < b.cost then
        table.insert(m, string.format("%s (%s %d/%d)", b.name, b.cur, have, b.cost))
      end
    end
  end
  return m
end

function LurnaFullP1()
  -- Nen tang phase 1 (fast attack, mo haki, bring mob, cong diem, ghim vu khi,
  -- san farm) da do LurnaFullReadyStep lam moi luot - khong lap lai o day.
  -- LUU Y: KHONG bat _G.Level o day. Moi engine vo (:10292 Superhuman, :10330
  -- Death Step, :10363 Sharkman...) TU ghi _G.Level 10 lan/giay de tam dung cay cap
  -- trong luc len mastery; neu o day cung ghi moi giay thi hai ben da nhau, farm bi
  -- ngat lien tuc va widget ben Tabs.Main nhap nhay. LurnaFullFarmFloor chi ep lai
  -- khi da dung im qua <LurnaFullFloor> giay nen khong da nhau voi engine.
  local ladder = { "Auto_SuperHuman", "AutoDeathStep", "Auto_SharkMan_Karate",
                   "Auto_Electric_Claw", "AutoDragonTalon", "Auto_God_Human" }

  if not LurnaFullHas("Superhuman") then
    LurnaFullOnly(ladder, "Auto_SuperHuman")
    local poor = LurnaFullP1Money()
    if #poor > 0 then
      LurnaFullSay("Vo 1/6", string.format(
        "dang len Superhuman nhung CHUA DU TIEN mua mon goc: %s. Dang cay tiep de kiem "
        .. "tien (engine tu mua ngay khi du).", table.concat(poor, ", ")))
    else
      LurnaFullSay("Vo 1/6", string.format(
        "dang len Superhuman | Black Leg %d / Electro %d / Fishman %d / Dragon Claw %d (can 299)",
        LurnaFullMastery("Black Leg"), LurnaFullMastery("Electro"),
        LurnaFullMastery("Fishman Karate"), LurnaFullMastery("Dragon Claw")))
    end
    return
  end

  local cur, left = LurnaFullRotate("p1v2", {
    { key = "AutoDeathStep",        need = function() return not LurnaFullHas("Death Step") end },
    { key = "Auto_SharkMan_Karate", need = function() return not LurnaFullHas("Sharkman Karate") end },
    { key = "Auto_Electric_Claw",   need = function() return not LurnaFullHas("Electric Claw") end },
    { key = "AutoDragonTalon",      need = function() return not LurnaFullHas("Dragon Talon") end },
  }, 75)
  if cur then
    local lb, ms = "-", -1
    for _, e in ipairs(LurnaFullV2) do
      if e.key == cur.key then lb, ms = e.label, LurnaFullMastery(e.base) end
    end
    LurnaFullSay("Vo 2/6", string.format(
      "dang lam %s (mastery goc %d, can 400) - con %d mon V2 thieu, luan phien 75s/mon",
      lb, ms, left))
    return
  end

  -- [LURNA FIX #80b] Da co Godhuman roi ma phase 1 van chay => chi con thieu LEVEL.
  -- Truoc day nhanh nay van bat _G.Auto_God_Human, tuc la engine goi BuyGodhuman
  -- lien tuc cho mon da so huu. Nay tat het ladder va chi cay cap.
  if LurnaFullHas("Godhuman") then
    LurnaFullOnly(ladder, nil)
    LurnaFullDrive("Level", true)
    local lv = LurnaFullLevel()
    local tg = tonumber(getgenv().LurnaFullLevelTarget) or 2800
    LurnaFullSay("Level", string.format(
      "da du bo vo (Godhuman) - chi con cay cap: Lv %d/%d. "
      .. "Keo thanh \"Moc level coi la xong Phase 1\" xuong neu ban muon di tiep som hon.",
      lv, tg))
    return
  end

  LurnaFullOnly(ladder, "Auto_God_Human")
  LurnaFullSay("Vo 3/6", "du 4 mon V2 - dang lam Godhuman (engine tu farm material)")
end

-- ============================== PHASE 2 - Saber & TTK ======================
-- Saber: ProQuestProgress (Sea 1, dao Jungle) - engine _G.AutoSaber da co.
-- TTK  : LegendarySwordDealer "1"/"2"/"3" (73/14 file) roi MysteriousMan "2"
--        (10/10 file). File chi co Button nen phase nay goi remote truc tiep,
--        va bat _G.Tp_LgS de bay den NPC cho NPC nam trong tam.
function LurnaFullH2()
  return LurnaFullHas("Saber") and LurnaFullHas("True Triple Katana")
end

function LurnaFullP2()
  if not LurnaFullHas("True Triple Katana") then
    LurnaFullDrive("Tp_LgS", true)
    if LurnaGate("full_ttk", 10) then
      local r = {}
      for _, k in ipairs({ "1", "2", "3" }) do
        r[#r + 1] = tostring(LurnaCommF("LegendarySwordDealer", k))
      end
      _G.__LurnaFullRet.TTK = table.concat(r, "/") .. " -> MM:" ..
        tostring(LurnaCommF("MysteriousMan", "2"))
    end
    LurnaFullSay("TTK", "dang mua 3 kiem legendary + True Triple Katana | server tra: "
      .. tostring(_G.__LurnaFullRet.TTK or "chua goi"))
    return
  end
  LurnaFullDrive("Tp_LgS", false)

  if not LurnaFullHas("Saber") then
    if not LurnaFullNeedSea(1, "Saber") then
      LurnaFullDrive("AutoSaber", false)
      return
    end
    LurnaFullDrive("AutoSaber", true)
    local st = LurnaFullPro()
    if type(st) == "table" then
      LurnaFullSay("Saber", string.format("Torch %s | Cup %s | Mob %s | Relic %s",
        tostring(st.UsedTorch), tostring(st.UsedCup),
        tostring(st.KilledMob), tostring(st.UsedRelic)))
    else
      LurnaFullSay("Saber", "ProQuestProgress chua tra bang - co the chua du Level 200")
    end
    return
  end
  LurnaFullDrive("AutoSaber", false)
  LurnaFullSay("Saber & TTK", "da co ca Saber va True Triple Katana")
end

-- ========================= PHASE 3 - CDK & Soul Guitar =====================
-- CDKQuest 275 hit / 13 file. Ma buoc chay -3 -> -4 -> -5 roi 1 -> 2 -> 3;
-- Progress.Finished = nil (chua bat dau) / false (dang lam).
-- Engine co san: _G.Auto_Yama (EliteHunter>=30 + SealedKatana), _G.Auto_Tushita
-- (TushitaGate + Holy Torch + 5 duoc + Longma), _G.CDK_YM (thu thach Evil),
-- _G.CDK_TS (thu thach Good), _G.CDK (boss Cursed Skeleton),
-- _G.Auto_Soul_Guitar + _G.AutoMatSoul (GuitarPuzzleProgress 74/12).
function LurnaFullCDKProg(side)
  local t = LurnaFullCDKTable()
  if type(t) ~= "table" then return nil, nil end
  return tonumber(t[side]), t.Finished
end

-- T-RexHub.lua.txt:7300-7360: khi thu thach DANG LAM thi Progress.Evil / .Good la
-- SO AM (-3 rung Forest Pirate, -4 Haze, -5 Hell Dimension) va Progress.Finished
-- la false; chua bat dau thi Finished == nil. Corpus KHONG ghi so nao la "xong"
-- nen KHONG doan: coi la con viec khi nil / am / Finished ~= true.
function LurnaFullCDKNeed(side)
  if LurnaFullHas("Cursed Dual Katana") then return false end
  local v, fin = LurnaFullCDKProg(side)
  if fin == true then return false end
  if v == nil then return true end
  return v < 0
end

-- [LURNA FEATURE #18] RENGOKU BI BO SOT khoi Kaitun Full. Hai engine that su co
-- san trong file - _G.KeysRen (:9219: farm "Snow Lurker"/"Arctic Warrior" den khi
-- roi "Hidden Key", equip key roi bay den cong Ice Castle) va _G.IceBossRen (:9200:
-- danh "Awakened Ice Admiral") - va ca hai id widget DA nam trong LurnaFullIds
-- (:18509-18510), nhung KHONG PHASE NAO drive chung. Ket qua: chay het 8 phase van
-- khong co Rengoku, du ban da chon "chuoi kiem" gom Rengoku.
function LurnaFullH3()
  return LurnaFullHas("Cursed Dual Katana") and LurnaFullHas("Soul Guitar")
     and LurnaFullHas("Rengoku")
end

-- Rengoku o BIEN 2 (Ice Castle), khong phai Bien 3 nhu CDK/Soul Guitar.
function LurnaFullP3Ren()
  local key = LurnaFullHas("Hidden Key")
  -- Luan phien 60s: khi da co key, engine KeysRen tu equip key + bay den cong con
  -- IceBossRen danh boss. Neu key bi tieu khi mo cong thi vong sau KeysRen lai lam
  -- tiep, nen khong nhanh nao ket cung.
  local cur = LurnaFullRotate("p3ren", {
    { key = "KeysRen",    lb = "farm Hidden Key + mo cong Ice Castle",
      need = function() return true end },
    { key = "IceBossRen", lb = "danh Awakened Ice Admiral",
      need = function() return key end },
  }, 60)
  LurnaFullSay("Rengoku", string.format("Bien 2 - dang lam: %s | Hidden Key: %s",
    tostring(cur and cur.lb or "-"), key and "co" or "chua co"))
end

function LurnaFullP3()
  -- [LURNA FEATURE #18] Truoc day ca phase bi khoa sau MOT gate LurnaFullNeedSea(3),
  -- nen buoc Rengoku (Bien 2) khong the nao chay. Nay tach gate theo tung buoc.
  local sea     = LurnaFullSea()
  local s3      = { "Auto_Yama", "Auto_Tushita", "CDK_YM", "CDK_TS", "CDK",
                    "Auto_Soul_Guitar", "AutoMatSoul" }
  local s2      = { "KeysRen", "IceBossRen" }
  local needRen = not LurnaFullHas("Rengoku")
  local need3   = (not LurnaFullHas("Cursed Dual Katana"))
               or (not LurnaFullHas("Soul Guitar"))

  if sea ~= 3 or not need3 then
    LurnaFullOnly(s3, nil)
    if needRen and sea == 2 then
      LurnaFullP3Ren()
      return
    end
    LurnaFullOnly(s2, nil)
    if need3 then
      LurnaFullNeedSea(3, "CDK & Soul Guitar")
    elseif needRen then
      LurnaFullNeedSea(2, "Rengoku")
    else
      LurnaFullSay("Phase 3", "da co Cursed Dual Katana, Soul Guitar va Rengoku")
    end
    return
  end
  LurnaFullOnly(s2, nil)

  local cur, left = LurnaFullRotate("p3", {
    { key = "Auto_Yama",        lb = "Yama (SealedKatana)",
      need = function() return not LurnaFullHas("Yama", "Cursed Dual Katana") end },
    { key = "Auto_Tushita",     lb = "Tushita (Longma)",
      need = function() return not LurnaFullHas("Tushita", "Cursed Dual Katana") end },
    { key = "CDK_YM",           lb = "thu thach Evil",
      need = function() return LurnaFullCDKNeed("Evil") end },
    { key = "CDK_TS",           lb = "thu thach Good",
      need = function() return LurnaFullCDKNeed("Good") end },
    { key = "CDK",              lb = "boss Cursed Skeleton",
      need = function()
        if LurnaFullHas("Cursed Dual Katana") then return false end
        return LurnaFullHas("Yama") and LurnaFullHas("Tushita")
      end },
    { key = "Auto_Soul_Guitar", lb = "Soul Guitar",
      need = function() return not LurnaFullHas("Soul Guitar") end },
  }, 90)

  if not cur then
    -- Het viec o Bien 3; con Rengoku (Bien 2) thi bao ra chu khong tu di sea.
    if needRen then
      LurnaFullNeedSea(2, "Rengoku")
    else
      LurnaFullSay("Phase 3", "da co Cursed Dual Katana, Soul Guitar va Rengoku")
    end
    return
  end
  -- Soul Guitar can material rieng -> bat kem engine farm material cua no
  LurnaFullDrive("AutoMatSoul", cur.key == "Auto_Soul_Guitar")

  local e, g = LurnaFullCDKProg("Evil")
  local go = select(1, LurnaFullCDKProg("Good"))
  local gp = LurnaFullGuitar()
  local gs = "-"
  if type(gp) == "table" then
    gs = string.format("Swamp %s Grave %s Ghost %s Trophy %s Pipe %s",
      tostring(gp.Swamp), tostring(gp.Gravestones), tostring(gp.Ghost),
      tostring(gp.Trophies), tostring(gp.Pipes))
  end
  LurnaFullSay("CDK & Guitar", string.format(
    "dang lam: %s (con %d viec, luan phien 90s)\nEvil %s | Good %s | Finished %s | Guitar: %s",
    tostring(cur.lb), left, tostring(e), tostring(go), tostring(g), gs))
end

function LurnaFullP4()
  -- [LURNA FIX #81] Shark Anchor la do craft o Bien 3. Truoc day phase nay khong
  -- kiem tra sea nen o Sea 1/2 no goi CraftItem moi 15s cho den khi watchdog khoa.
  if not LurnaFullNeedSea(3, "Shark Anchor") then
    LurnaFullDriveG("LurnaLeviCraft", false)
    return
  end
  if LurnaGate("full_anchor", 15) then
    _G.__LurnaFullRet.Anchor = tostring(LurnaCommF("CraftItem", "Craft", "SharkAnchor"))
  end
  LurnaFullDriveG("LurnaLeviChain", true)
  LurnaFullDriveG("LurnaLeviCraft", true)
  if _G.__LurnaFullOldCraftKey == nil then
    _G.__LurnaFullOldCraftKey = getgenv().LurnaLeviCraftKey or "LeviathanCrown"
  end
  getgenv().LurnaLeviCraftKey = "SharkAnchor"
  LurnaFullSay("Shark Anchor", string.format(
    "goi CraftItem/Craft/SharkAnchor moi 15s - server tra: %s\n"
    .. "Cong thuc Shark Anchor KHONG co trong corpus nen khong ep material; "
    .. "dang bat chuoi Leviathan (FEATURE #14, khoa SharkAnchor) de gom do.",
    tostring(_G.__LurnaFullRet.Anchor or "chua goi")))
end

-- ========================= PHASE 5 - Thuc Tinh Toc V4 ======================
-- RaceV4Progress 59 hit / 11 file. "Check" tra ve MOT SO:
--   1 -> "Begin" | 2 -> TP diem dung + "Teleport" cho den khi vao Temple
--   3 -> "Continue" | 4 -> xong.
-- File goc chi co Button "Talk With Stone" ban lien tiep ca 4 lenh; day la
-- state machine that su.
LurnaFullV4Stage  = CFrame.new(2959.87231, 2282.42139, -7216.23193)
LurnaFullV4Temple = Vector3.new(28286.35546875, 14896.5078125, 102.62469482422)

-- [LURNA FIX #85] H5 cu la "LurnaFullV4Check() == 4". SAI NANG hai duong:
--   1) "Check" tra ve MOC TIEN DO cua chuoi noi chuyen voi Stone (1..4), khong
--      phai "da co V4". Zeion:7300 cho thay Check == 4 chi la lam xong 4 buoc
--      noi chuyen, sau do CON phai lam MysticIsland + CheckTempleDoor moi ra V4.
--   2) Voi acc DA CO V4 san (hoac chua du dieu kien) remote tra ve NIL, nen
--      "nil == 4" = false MAI MAI => chuoi tac cung o Phase 5, khong bao gio
--      len duoc 6/7/8. Day chinh la loi "check progress ko duoc" nang nhat.
-- Cach do SO HUU that (kiem chung 3 file doc lap):
--   Zeion:498  Backpack/Character co tool "Awakening"  => V4
--   Zeion:500  plr.Data.RaceVersion.Value              => so phien ban toc
--   relz:6589  "Awakening" nam trong danh sach tool KHONG phai vu khi
function LurnaFullRaceVer()
  if GetBP("Awakening") then return 4 end
  local n = 0
  pcall(function() n = tonumber(plr.Data.RaceVersion.Value) or 0 end)
  if n < 3 then
    pcall(function()
      if plr.Data.Race:FindFirstChild("Evolved") then n = math.max(n, 3) end
    end)
  end
  return n
end

function LurnaFullH5()
  if LurnaFullRaceVer() >= 4 then return true end
  return false
end

function LurnaFullP5()
  if not LurnaFullNeedSea(3, "Race V4") then return end
  local v = LurnaFullV4Check()
  if v == nil then
    -- [LURNA FIX #85] Da co V4 thi H5 bat roi, khong vao day. Vao day tuc la CHUA
    -- co V4 ma remote cung khong tra so => that su chua du dieu kien.
    LurnaFullSay("Race V4", string.format(
      "RaceV4Progress/Check khong tra so, ma toc dang o V%d (chua V4). "
      .. "Thuong la chua Race V3 hoac chua du Level. Chuoi se cho watchdog roi "
      .. "nhay sang phase khac, khong dung im o day.",
      LurnaFullRaceVer()))
    return
  end
  if v == 1 then
    if LurnaGate("full_v4_begin", 8) then
      LurnaCommF("RaceV4Progress", "Begin")
      _G.__LurnaFullC.v4 = nil
    end
    LurnaFullSay("Race V4", "buoc 1/4: goi Begin")
  elseif v == 2 then
    local d = LurnaFullDist(LurnaFullV4Temple)
    if d > 15 then
      LurnaFullGo(LurnaFullV4Stage)
      if LurnaGate("full_v4_tp", 2) then
        LurnaCommF("RaceV4Progress", "Teleport")
        _G.__LurnaFullC.v4 = nil
      end
      LurnaFullSay("Race V4", string.format(
        "buoc 2/4: dung o diem cho roi goi Teleport - con %d studs toi Temple of Time",
        math.floor(d)))
    else
      LurnaFullSay("Race V4", "buoc 2/4: da vao Temple of Time, cho server cap nhat")
    end
  elseif v == 3 then
    if LurnaGate("full_v4_cont", 8) then
      LurnaCommF("RaceV4Progress", "Continue")
      _G.__LurnaFullC.v4 = nil
    end
    LurnaFullSay("Race V4", "buoc 3/4: goi Continue")
  else
    -- Check == 4: xong 4 buoc noi chuyen NHUNG chua chac da co V4 (con MysticIsland
    -- + CheckTempleDoor). H5 chi tin vao tool "Awakening" / Data.RaceVersion.
    LurnaFullSay("Race V4", string.format(
      "Check = 4 (xong 4 buoc noi chuyen) nhung toc van dang V%d. Con phai vao "
      .. "Temple of Time / MysticIsland. Bat 'Auto Mystic Island' hoac lam tay buoc cuoi.",
      LurnaFullRaceVer()))
  end
  -- Doi toc sang Cyborg: CommF_("CyborgTrainer"," Buy") - CHU Y dau cach o dau
  -- doi so (5 hit co dau cach / 2 hit khong). Mac dinh TAT vi KHONG hoan tac duoc.
  if getgenv().LurnaFullCyborg and LurnaGate("full_cyborg", 30) then
    _G.__LurnaFullRet.Cyborg = tostring(LurnaCommF("CyborgTrainer", " Buy"))
  end
end

-- ========================= PHASE 6 - Train 5/5 Gears =======================
-- Trong corpus KHONG co he thong item nao ten "Gears" (30 hit nhung chi nam
-- trong BananaHub.beautified + chinh ban deobfuscate cua no = 1 nguon). Cai
-- DUNG la 5 o chieu thuc tinh: GetBP(<Trai>).AwakenedMoves Z X C V F - dung 5 o,
-- khop chinh xac nhan "Train 5/5 Gears" tren dashboard.
LurnaFullSlots = { "Z", "X", "C", "V", "F" }

function LurnaFullFruit()
  local name = nil
  pcall(function()
    for _, v in ipairs(plr.Backpack:GetChildren()) do
      if v:FindFirstChild("AwakenedMoves") then name = v.Name return end
    end
    for _, v in ipairs(plr.Backpack:GetChildren()) do
      if v:IsA("Tool") and v.ToolTip == "Blox Fruit" then name = v.Name return end
    end
    if plr.Character then
      for _, v in ipairs(plr.Character:GetChildren()) do
        if v:IsA("Tool") and v.ToolTip == "Blox Fruit" then name = v.Name return end
      end
    end
  end)
  return name
end

function LurnaFullAwaken()
  local fruit = LurnaFullFruit()
  if not fruit then return 0, nil end
  local n = 0
  pcall(function()
    local t = GetBP(fruit)
    local am = t and t:FindFirstChild("AwakenedMoves")
    if am then
      for _, k in ipairs(LurnaFullSlots) do
        if am:FindFirstChild(k) then n = n + 1 end
      end
    end
  end)
  return n, fruit
end

function LurnaFullH6()
  local n = LurnaFullAwaken()
  return n >= 5
end

function LurnaFullP6()
  local n, fruit = LurnaFullAwaken()
  if not fruit then
    -- [LURNA FIX #151] Truoc day chi bao mot dong roi return. Ma "khong giu trai" la
    -- trang thai KHONG THE TU HET duoc: chuoi khong the tu mua/tu an trai cho ban, nen
    -- no dung im dung 240s cho watchdog roi moi di tiep - mat 4 phut moi vong. Nay tu
    -- KHOA phase ngay va noi ro phai lam gi; bam "Xoa khoa watchdog" sau khi da giu
    -- trai la chay lai duoc.
    _G.__LurnaFullBlockN[6] = (tonumber(_G.__LurnaFullBlockN[6]) or 0) + 1
    _G.__LurnaFullBlocked[6] = {
      t   = tick(),
      sec = LurnaFullBlockSecs(6),
      n   = _G.__LurnaFullBlockN[6],
      why = "khong co Blox Fruit trong tui - hay GIU trai muon thuc tinh roi bam 'Xoa khoa watchdog'",
    }
    LurnaFullSay("Awaken", "khong thay Blox Fruit nao trong tui - BO QUA phase 6, "
      .. "hay GIU trai muon thuc tinh roi bam 'Xoa khoa watchdog / chay lai'")
    _G.__LurnaFullPhase = 0
    return
  end
  -- Raid Runner [FEATURE #11] lo: mua chip -> chon chip -> trieu hoi -> farm 5 dao
  LurnaFullDriveG("LurnaRaidRun", true)
  LurnaFullDriveG("LurnaRaidAwaken", true)
  -- KHONG tu goi Awakener/Awaken o day: engine _G.Auto_Awakener (Raid Runner vua bat)
  -- da goi Check roi Awaken trong vong lap cua no o :13708-13710. Goi them chi la
  -- spam remote. O day chi DOC de bao trang thai ra UI.
  local chk
  if LurnaGate("full_awaken", 10) then
    chk = LurnaCommF("Awakener", "Check")
    _G.__LurnaFullRet.Awaken = tostring(chk)
  end
  LurnaFullSay("Awaken", string.format(
    "%s: %d/5 chieu (Z X C V F) | Awakener/Check: %s\n"
    .. "Raid Runner [#11]: %s",
    fruit, n, tostring(_G.__LurnaFullRet.Awaken or "dang doc"),
    tostring(_G.__LurnaRaidPhase or "-")))
end

  -- [LURNA FIX #86b] Da co Sanguine Art thi viec con lai la CAY MASTERY, khong phai
  -- goi BuySanguineArt nua. File nay KHONG co engine cay mastery cho VO (chi co

  --      callback :4594) roi GHI DE _G.SelectWeapon moi 0.5s => moi gan cua toi bi

-- =========================== BO DIEU PHOI (SCHEDULER) ======================
-- Cach chon phase: quet theo THU TU UU TIEN (o "Thu tu phase"), bo qua phase da
-- xong (Have() == true), bo qua phase nguoi dung go vao o "Bo qua", bo qua phase
-- dang bi watchdog khoa. LurnaFullForce ~= 0 thi ep dung phase do.
LurnaFullBlockFor = 600

-- [LURNA FIX #145] Lui gio TANG DAN thay vi co dinh 600s.
-- LOI THAT: Phase 4 (Shark Anchor) gan nhu KHONG BAO GIO xong duoc - cong thuc
-- che tao khong nam trong file nay - nen vong lap la: vao Phase 4 -> dung im 240s
-- -> watchdog khoa 600s -> het 600s -> LurnaFullPick lai quet tu dau va lai vao
-- Phase 4. Cu 840s thi 240s (28%) do vao mot phase khong the xong, va moi lan
-- vao/ra deu goi LurnaFullUndrive - dap luon nhung gi phase 5..8 dang chay.
-- Nay: lan khoa thu k thi cho 600 * 2^(k-1) giay, tran o k = 4 (10 > 20 > 40 > 80
-- phut). Phase tac that se tu bi day ra khoi vong lap; phase chi tac tam thoi
-- (thieu material, dang doi raid) van duoc thu lai som.
function LurnaFullBlockSecs(n)
  local k = tonumber((_G.__LurnaFullBlockN or {})[n]) or 1
  if k < 1 then k = 1 end
  if k > 4 then k = 4 end
  return LurnaFullBlockFor * (2 ^ (k - 1))
end

-- [LURNA FIX #150] Truoc day ham nay chay CA 8 Have() moi 1 giay, tuc ~20 luot
-- quet Backpack + goi CommF moi giay (chinh comment cu trong file cung thua nhan).
-- Do la thue lag lon nhat cua FEATURE #17, va lag = ban cham = farm cham. Nay chi
-- quet lai moi 3s, hoac ngay lap tuc khi bi goi voi force = true (doi phase, bam
-- nut reset). Phase dang chay van duoc cap nhat moi luot de khong bao "xong" tre.
function LurnaFullRefresh(force, only)
  if only then
    local p = LurnaFullPhases[only]
    if p then
      local ok, r = pcall(p.Have)
      _G.__LurnaFullDone[only] = (ok and r) and true or false
    end
    return
  end
  if not force and (tick() - (_G.__LurnaFullDoneT or 0)) < 3 then return end
  _G.__LurnaFullDoneT = tick()
  for _, p in ipairs(LurnaFullPhases) do
    local ok, r = pcall(p.Have)
    _G.__LurnaFullDone[p.n] = (ok and r) and true or false
  end
end

function LurnaFullIsBlocked(n)
  local b = _G.__LurnaFullBlocked[n]
  if type(b) ~= "table" then return false end
  if (tick() - (b.t or 0)) > (b.sec or LurnaFullBlockSecs(n)) then
    _G.__LurnaFullBlocked[n] = nil
    return false
  end
  return true
end

-- [LURNA FIX #146] Thu tu chay: truoc day la ipairs(LurnaFullPhases) - tuc CHI SO
-- 1..8 - nen Phase 1 (cay len Lv 2800, hang GIO) luon phai xong truoc Phase 2
-- (Saber Lv 200 + True Triple Katana: re, nhanh, va la mon tang sat thuong lon
-- nhat cho ca chuoi con lai). Chay dung thu tu bang so la chay nguoc gia tri.
-- Nay doc tu getgenv().LurnaFullOrderStr, mac dinh "2,1,3,5,6,7,8,4": lay vu khi
-- truoc, roi cay level, va day Phase 4 (hay tac) xuong cuoi. Phase nao khong duoc
-- liet ke van duoc bo sung vao duoi nen khong bao gio bi mat phase.
function LurnaFullOrder()
  local s = tostring(getgenv().LurnaFullOrderStr or "")
  if _G.__LurnaFullOrder and _G.__LurnaFullOrder.s == s then return _G.__LurnaFullOrder.t end
  local t, seen = {}, {}
  for w in s:gmatch("%d+") do
    local n = tonumber(w)
    if n and n >= 1 and n <= 8 and not seen[n] then
      seen[n] = true
      table.insert(t, n)
    end
  end
  for n = 1, 8 do if not seen[n] then table.insert(t, n) end end
  _G.__LurnaFullOrder = { s = s, t = t }
  return t
end

function LurnaFullPick()
  local f = tonumber(getgenv().LurnaFullForce) or 0
  if f >= 1 and f <= 8 then
    -- [LURNA FIX #83] Ep phase da xong thi NOI RA, dung lap im lang.
    if _G.__LurnaFullDone[f] then
      LurnaFullSay("Ep phase " .. f, string.format(
        "phase %d da XONG roi ma ban van ep chay. Bang tien do se hien [x]. "
        .. "Chuyen dropdown ve \"Tu dong\" de chuoi tu nhay phase con thieu.", f))
    end
    return LurnaFullPhases[f]
  end
  for _, n in ipairs(LurnaFullOrder()) do
    if not _G.__LurnaFullDone[n] and not _G.__LurnaFullSkip[n] and not LurnaFullIsBlocked(n) then
      return LurnaFullPhases[n]
    end
  end
  return nil
end

-- O nhap "Bo qua phase": "2,4,7" -> _G.__LurnaFullSkip
function LurnaFullSkipSet(s)
  local t = {}
  for w in tostring(s or ""):gmatch("%d+") do
    local n = tonumber(w)
    if n and n >= 1 and n <= 8 then t[n] = true end
  end
  _G.__LurnaFullSkip = t
  return t
end

function LurnaFullResetBlock()
  _G.__LurnaFullBlocked = {}
  _G.__LurnaFullBlockN  = {}   -- [#145] xoa luon so lan khoa, khong thi lui gio van con tang
  _G.__LurnaFullRot     = {}
  _G.__LurnaFullC       = {}
  _G.__LurnaFullMiss    = {}   -- [#150] xoa memo "con thieu gi" de doc lai so lieu thuc
  _G.__LurnaFullDoneT   = 0
  _G.__LurnaFullT0      = tick()
  -- [LURNA FIX #93] Truoc day liet ke tay 8 ten gate va bi LECH voi ten that:
  -- reset "full_v4" / "full_cdk" / "full_saber" - ba key KHONG TON TAI - trong khi
  -- gate that su la full_v4_begin, full_v4_tp, full_v4_cont, full_sea_<n>. Ket qua
  -- la bam "Xoa khoa watchdog / chay lai" ma Phase 5 van phai cho het cooldown cu.
  -- Nay quet het key bat dau bang "full_" nen them gate moi khong bao gio lech nua.
  local ng = 0
  for k in pairs(_G.__LurnaGate or {}) do
    if type(k) == "string" and string.sub(k, 1, 5) == "full_" then
      _G.__LurnaGate[k] = nil
      ng = ng + 1
    end
  end
  LurnaFullSay("Reset", string.format(
    "da xoa het khoa watchdog + %d cooldown remote, chay lai tu phase con thieu dau tien", ng))
end

-- Watchdog do "CO TIEN TRIEN hay khong", KHONG do thoi gian tho: farm level
-- 1-2800 mat nhieu gio nen dem thoi gian tho se cat oan. Chu ky nao doi thi
-- dong ho reset; dung im qua <watchdog> giay moi bi coi la tac.
-- [LURNA FIX #88] Sig cu co "#plr.Backpack:GetChildren()". Moi lan farm EQUIP hay
-- UNEQUIP vu khi, tool chuyen qua lai giua Backpack va Character nen so tool con
-- trong Backpack doi lien tuc => sig doi MOI GIAY => watchdog KHONG BAO GIO no,
-- phase tac se treo vinh vien. Sig cu con nhet ca __LurnaFullWhy, ma chuoi do chua
-- so studs / cau tra loi cua server nen cung nhay lien tuc.
-- Nay do dung cai can do: "phase nay CON THIEU GI" (LurnaFullMiss) - roi rac, chi
-- doi khi co tien trien that - cong HOP tool cua Backpack + Character (hop nen
-- equip/unequip khong lam doi).
function LurnaFullSig()
  local a = { tostring(_G.__LurnaFullPhase), tostring(_G.__LurnaFullStep) }
  pcall(function() table.insert(a, tostring(plr.Data.Level.Value)) end)
  local n = tonumber(_G.__LurnaFullPhase) or 0
  if n >= 1 and n <= 8 then
    local ok, r = pcall(LurnaFullMiss, n)
    table.insert(a, (ok and tostring(r)) or "?")
  end
  local set = {}
  pcall(function()
    for _, v in ipairs(plr.Backpack:GetChildren()) do set[v.Name] = true end
    if plr.Character then
      for _, v in ipairs(plr.Character:GetChildren()) do
        if v:IsA("Tool") then set[v.Name] = true end
      end
    end
  end)
  local c = 0
  for _ in pairs(set) do c = c + 1 end
  table.insert(a, tostring(c))
  return table.concat(a, "|")
end

function LurnaFullTick()
  if not getgenv().LurnaFullRun then return end

  -- Quyen han duy nhat duoc cap: tu dung Bypass TP khi di xa > 4000 studs.
  if getgenv().LurnaFullBypass and _G.__LurnaFullOldBypass == nil then
    _G.__LurnaFullOldBypass  = getgenv().LurnaBypassTP
    _G.__LurnaFullOldMinDist = getgenv().LurnaBypassMinDist
    getgenv().LurnaBypassTP      = true
    getgenv().LurnaBypassMinDist = 4000
    pcall(function() LurnaSyncToggle("Toggle_Bypass_TP", true) end)
  end

  -- [LURNA FIX #140..#143] Lop NEN cho moi phase, chay TRUOC khi chon phase: cong
  -- diem, ghim vu khi manh nhat, ep nhip ban, va san farm neu dang dung im. Truoc
  -- day khong co lop nay: acc chay het 8 phase voi 0 diem cong va co the vung Black
  -- Leg trong khi trong tui co Godhuman.
  LurnaFullReadyStep()

  LurnaFullRefresh()
  local p = LurnaFullPick()

  if not p then
    local nblock, nskip = 0, 0
    for n = 1, 8 do
      if LurnaFullIsBlocked(n) then nblock = nblock + 1 end
      if _G.__LurnaFullSkip[n] then nskip = nskip + 1 end
    end
    _G.__LurnaFullPhase = 0
    if nblock > 0 then
      LurnaFullSay("Tam dung", string.format(
        "khong con phase nao chay duoc: %d phase bi khoa (watchdog), %d phase bo qua. "
        .. "Bam 'Xoa khoa watchdog' de thu lai.", nblock, nskip))
    else
      LurnaFullSay("XONG", "da xong ca 8 phase (hoac da bo qua het) - dang nghi")
    end
    -- [LURNA FIX #79] Truoc day cho tat 13 key _G, con 5 key getgenv()
    -- (LurnaRaidRun / LurnaRaidAwaken / LurnaLeviChain / LurnaLeviCraft /
    -- LurnaLeviSang) van chay MAI sau khi chuoi xong. Nay tra lai het.
    pcall(LurnaFullUndrive)
    return
  end

  -- Doi phase -> reset dong ho + xoa luan phien cu
  if _G.__LurnaFullPhase ~= p.n then
    _G.__LurnaFullPhase = p.n
    _G.__LurnaFullT0    = tick()
    _G.__LurnaFullEnter = tick()   -- [#145] moc VAO phase, xem giai thich o duoi
    _G.__LurnaFullSigV  = ""
    _G.__LurnaFullRot   = {}
    _G.__LurnaFullMiss  = {}   -- [#150] so lieu cua phase cu khong con y nghia
    LurnaFullLog(string.format("=> vao PHASE %d: %s", p.n, p.name))
  end

  local ok, err = pcall(p.Run)
  if not ok then LurnaFullSay(p.name, "loi khi chay phase: " .. tostring(err)) end

  -- [#150] Phase DANG chay thi kiem tra rieng moi luot (re, chi 1 Have()) de bao
  -- "xong" ngay, khong phai doi het 3s cua vong quet chung.
  LurnaFullRefresh(false, p.n)

  -- Cham nhip watchdog
  local sig = LurnaFullSig()
  if sig ~= _G.__LurnaFullSigV then
    _G.__LurnaFullSigV = sig
    _G.__LurnaFullT0   = tick()
    -- [#145] Co tien trien that -> tha luon so lan bi khoa cua phase nay. Neu khong,
    -- mot phase tung tac 3 lan roi sau do chay tot van phai chiu muc cho 40 phut o
    -- lan tac ke tiep, du nguyen nhan cu da het (vd da mua du material).
    -- Doi 5s sau khi VAO phase moi tinh: tick dau tien cua moi phase luon "doi sig"
    -- (sigV vua bi reset ve "") nen neu tha ngay thi lui gio se khong bao gio tang.
    if _G.__LurnaFullBlockN[p.n] and (tick() - (_G.__LurnaFullEnter or 0)) > 5 then
      _G.__LurnaFullBlockN[p.n] = nil
    end
  else
    local wd = tonumber(getgenv().LurnaFullWatchdog) or 240
    if wd > 0 and (tick() - (_G.__LurnaFullT0 or 0)) > wd then
      -- [#145] Lan khoa thu may cua phase nay -> lui gio tang dan.
      local k = (tonumber(_G.__LurnaFullBlockN[p.n]) or 0) + 1
      _G.__LurnaFullBlockN[p.n] = k
      local sec = LurnaFullBlockSecs(p.n)
      _G.__LurnaFullBlocked[p.n] = {
        t   = tick(),
        sec = sec,
        n   = k,
        why = string.format("dung im %ds tai buoc '%s' (%s)", math.floor(wd),
              tostring(_G.__LurnaFullStep), tostring(_G.__LurnaFullWhy)),
      }
      LurnaFullLog(string.format("WATCHDOG khoa PHASE %d lan %d, thu lai sau %d phut: %s",
        p.n, k, math.floor(sec / 60), _G.__LurnaFullBlocked[p.n].why))
      -- [LURNA FIX #87] Truoc day chi tat cac key _G trong __LurnaFullDrove. 5 key
      -- getgenv() (LurnaRaidRun LurnaRaidAwaken LurnaLeviChain LurnaLeviCraft
      -- LurnaLeviSang) KHONG nam trong bang do nen phase bi khoa roi ma engine cua
      -- no VAN CHAY, danh nhau voi phase tiep theo. Undrive tra lai het, va tra ve
      -- GIA TRI CU chu khong phai tat sach.
      pcall(LurnaFullUndrive)
      _G.__LurnaFullPhase = 0
    end
  end
end

-- [LURNA FIX #84] Moi dong noi ro CON THIEU GI, khong chi "cho"/"xong": truoc day
-- bang nay khong tra loi duoc cau hoi "sao no bao chua xong?".
-- [LURNA FIX #150] Ham nay khong he re: no goi LurnaFullHas (quet Backpack) tam
-- lan, cong LurnaFullV4Check / LurnaFullAwaken / LurnaFullSangMastery (deu la
-- CommF). Ma no bi goi 8 lan/giay boi LurnaFullReport (UI) VA 1 lan/giay boi
-- LurnaFullSig (watchdog) => 9 luot/giay. Nay dem qua memo 2s cho tung phase.
-- LUU Y: LurnaFullSig lay ket qua nay lam thuoc do tien trien, nen memo phai
-- ngan hon watchdog rat nhieu (2s so voi 240s) - khong lam watchdog mu.
function LurnaFullMissRaw(n)
  local m = {}
  local function need(cond, txt) if cond then table.insert(m, txt) end end
  local ok = pcall(function()
    if n == 1 then
      need(not LurnaFullHas("Godhuman"), "Godhuman")
      local lv = tonumber(LurnaFullLevel()) or 0
      local tg = tonumber(getgenv().LurnaFullLevelTarget) or 2800
      need(lv < tg, string.format("Lv %d/%d", lv, tg))
    elseif n == 2 then
      need(not LurnaFullHas("Saber"), "Saber")
      need(not LurnaFullHas("True Triple Katana"), "True Triple Katana")
    elseif n == 3 then
      need(not LurnaFullHas("Yama"), "Yama")
      need(not LurnaFullHas("Tushita"), "Tushita")
      need(not LurnaFullHas("Cursed Dual Katana"), "CDK")
      need(not LurnaFullHas("Soul Guitar"), "Soul Guitar")
      need(not LurnaFullHas("Rengoku"), "Rengoku (Bien 2)")   -- [FEATURE #18]
    elseif n == 4 then
      -- [LURNA FIX #92] Truoc day 2 phase nay tra ve HANG SO. Vi LurnaFullSig (watchdog)
      -- lay chinh chuoi nay lam thuoc do tien trien, hang so = watchdog khong the
      -- phat hien phase 4/7 bi tac. Nay ghim vao cau tra loi cua server (roi rac,
      -- chi doi khi tinh hinh doi that).
      need(true, string.format("Shark Anchor (craft: %s)",
        tostring(_G.__LurnaFullRet.Anchor or "chua goi")))
    elseif n == 5 then
      local v = LurnaFullV4Check()
      need(true, string.format("V4 (dang V%d, RaceV4/Check = %s)",
        LurnaFullRaceVer(), tostring(v)))
    elseif n == 6 then
      local c, fr = LurnaFullAwaken()
      need(true, string.format("%s %d/5 chieu", tostring(fr or "chua giu trai"), c))
    elseif n == 7 then
      need(true, string.format("Leviathan Crown / Sanguine Art (buoc #14: %s)",
        tostring(_G.__LurnaLeviStep or "chua chay")))
    elseif n == 8 then
      need(not LurnaFullHas("Sanguine Art"), "Sanguine Art")
      if LurnaFullHas("Sanguine Art") then
        local tg = tonumber(getgenv().LurnaFullSangTarget) or 600
        local ms = LurnaFullSangMastery()
        need(ms < tg, string.format("mastery %s/%d",
          (ms >= 0) and tostring(ms) or "?", tg))
      end
    end
  end)
  if not ok then return "khong doc duoc" end
  return (#m > 0) and table.concat(m, ", ") or "-"
end

function LurnaFullMiss(n)
  local c = _G.__LurnaFullMiss[n]
  if type(c) == "table" and (tick() - (c.t or 0)) < 2 then return c.v end
  local v = LurnaFullMissRaw(n)
  _G.__LurnaFullMiss[n] = { t = tick(), v = v }
  return v
end

-- Bang tien do 8 dong cho UI (:SetDesc)
function LurnaFullReport()
  local out = {}
  -- [#146] Liet ke theo DUNG thu tu se chay, khong phai 1..8, de ban thay ngay
  -- phase nao sap toi. So dau dong van la so phase that.
  for _, n in ipairs(LurnaFullOrder()) do
    local p = LurnaFullPhases[n]
    local mark
    if _G.__LurnaFullDone[p.n] then          mark = "[x] xong"
    elseif _G.__LurnaFullSkip[p.n] then      mark = "[-] bo qua"
    elseif LurnaFullIsBlocked(p.n) then
      local b = _G.__LurnaFullBlocked[p.n] or {}
      local left = math.max(0, math.floor(((b.sec or 600) - (tick() - (b.t or 0))) / 60))
      mark = string.format("[!] khoa lan %d, con %d phut: %s",
             tonumber(b.n) or 1, left, tostring(b.why))
    elseif _G.__LurnaFullPhase == p.n then   mark = "[>] DANG CHAY - thieu: " .. LurnaFullMiss(p.n)
    else                                     mark = "[ ] cho - thieu: " .. LurnaFullMiss(p.n)
    end
    table.insert(out, string.format("%d. %s - %s", p.n, p.name, mark))
  end
  table.insert(out, "")
  table.insert(out, string.format("Level %s | Sea %d | Buoc: %s | %s",
    tostring(LurnaFullLevel()), LurnaFullSea(),
    tostring(_G.__LurnaFullStep), tostring(_G.__LurnaFullWhy)))
  -- [#140..#143] Dong nay tra loi cau hoi "sao farm cham?" ma ban khong phai doan.
  table.insert(out, "Nen: " .. tostring(_G.__LurnaFullReady))
  return table.concat(out, "\n")
end

spawn(function()
  while true do
    if getgenv().LurnaFullRun then
      pcall(LurnaFullTick)
    -- [LURNA FIX #89] Dieu kien cu bo sot truong hop: watchdog vua khoa phase nen
    -- __LurnaFullPhase da = 0, nguoi dung tat cong tac ngay luc do => Undrive khong
    -- chay, cac cong tac bi chuoi bat van O NGUYEN. Nay xet ca bang snapshot.
    elseif _G.__LurnaFullPhase ~= 0 or _G.__LurnaFullOldBypass ~= nil
        or next(_G.__LurnaFullPrev or {}) ~= nil
        or next(_G.__LurnaFullPrevG or {}) ~= nil
        or _G.__LurnaFullOldWeapon ~= nil or _G.__LurnaFullOldWP ~= nil then
      pcall(LurnaFullUndrive)
      _G.__LurnaFullPhase = 0
      LurnaFullSay("Tat", "da tat Kaitun Full va tra lai quyen cho cac cong tac cu")
    end
    task.wait(1)
  end
end)

  Callback = function(Value) getgenv().LurnaFullFloor = tonumber(Value) or 6 end
})
Tabs.Kaitun:AddButton({
  Title = "Xoa khoa watchdog / chay lai",
  Description = "Xoa het phase bi khoa va bat dau lai tu phase con thieu dau tien",
  Callback = function() pcall(LurnaFullResetBlock) end
})
LurnaFullStatusBox = Tabs.Kaitun:AddParagraph({
  Title = "Bang Tien Do 8 Phase",
  Content = "chua chay"
})
LurnaFullLogBox = Tabs.Kaitun:AddParagraph({
  Title = "Nhat ky Kaitun Full",
  Content = "-"
})
spawn(function()
  -- [LURNA FIX #74] Bang tien do phai chay CA KHI cong tac tong dang TAT.
  -- Truoc day LurnaFullRefresh() chi duoc goi trong LurnaFullTick(), ma Tick
  -- return ngay o dong dau khi LurnaFullRun == false => _G.__LurnaFullDone
  -- luon rong => ca 8 phase luon hien "[ ] cho" du ban da co Godhuman/CDK.
  while task.wait(1) do
    if not getgenv().LurnaFullRun then
      -- Doc cham hon (3s) vi Have() co goi remote; chi de xem, khong dieu khien.
      if (tick() - (_G.__LurnaFullIdleT or 0)) > 3 then
        _G.__LurnaFullIdleT = tick()
        pcall(LurnaFullRefresh, true)
      end
    end
    pcall(function()
      if LurnaFullStatusBox then
        LurnaFullStatusBox:SetDesc(string.format("%s | Sea %s | Bypass>4000: %s\n%s",
          getgenv().LurnaFullRun and "DANG BAT" or "TAT",
          tostring(LurnaFullSea()),
          getgenv().LurnaFullBypass and "ON" or "off",
          LurnaFullReport()))
      end
      if LurnaFullLogBox then
        local t = _G.__LurnaFullLog or {}
        local last = {}
        for i = math.max(1, #t - 5), #t do table.insert(last, t[i]) end
        LurnaFullLogBox:SetDesc((#last > 0) and table.concat(last, "\n") or "-")
      end
    end)
  end
end)

-- DA LOAI BO vi 0 lan xuat hien trong corpus (khong bia remote):
--   * KHONG co remote nao ten dang "Dungeon"/"StartDungeon"/"EnterDungeon".
--     Grep ca project chi ra EntranceTeleporter (2), ExitTeleporter (8),
--     Key (3). Nghia la buoc VAO dungeon khong the tu dong bang remote.
--   * Nen buoc vao chi co ba duong: (a) ten remote do CHINH BAN dien vao o
--     Input, (b) fireproximityprompt vao prompt gan do (day la API cua
--     executor, khong phai ten cua game), (c) khong duoc thi bao ro "hay tu

--
-- CAI NAY LAM DUOC (sau khi da o trong dungeon thi tu chay het):

--   thi dem luot roi bat dau lai. Bon cong tac TP Exit 1..4 bam tay khong can

getgenv().LurnaDunRun   = getgenv().LurnaDunRun   or false -- cong tac tong
getgenv().LurnaDunFocus = (getgenv().LurnaDunFocus ~= false) -- tap trung boss
getgenv().LurnaDunLoop  = (getgenv().LurnaDunLoop  ~= false) -- xong lam lai
getgenv().LurnaDunEnter = getgenv().LurnaDunEnter or false -- vao dungeon (yeu)
getgenv().LurnaDunNpc   = getgenv().LurnaDunNpc   or ""    -- ten remote ban dien

LurnaDunCfg = {
  RANGE    = 5000, -- bang FARM_RANGE :16445 cua engine #66, de khong lech
  EMPTY_N  = 3,    -- phai TRONG lien tuc 3 tick moi tin la sach (mob ra tung dot)
  ADV_WAIT = 6,    -- cho 6s xem tang co doi khong, khong doi thi len bac sau
  STUCK    = 90,   -- 90s khong nhich duoc gi thi cuu
  STUCK_N  = 3,    -- cuu 3 lan khong duoc thi dung han, khong quay vong am tham
  MAX_STEP = 100,  -- chan tang moi luot, tranh vong lap vo tan
}

_G.__LurnaDunPhase  = _G.__LurnaDunPhase  or "TAT"
_G.__LurnaDunWhy    = _G.__LurnaDunWhy    or "-"
_G.__LurnaDunStep   = _G.__LurnaDunStep   or "-"
_G.__LurnaDunLog    = _G.__LurnaDunLog    or {}
_G.__LurnaDunDrove  = _G.__LurnaDunDrove  or {}
_G.__LurnaDunSaved  = _G.__LurnaDunSaved  or nil -- gia tri TPFloor1..4 truoc khi cuop
_G.__LurnaDunFloor  = _G.__LurnaDunFloor  or 0   -- tang dang dung
_G.__LurnaDunBest   = _G.__LurnaDunBest   or 0   -- tang cao nhat tung len duoc
_G.__LurnaDunSteps  = _G.__LurnaDunSteps  or 0   -- so lan nhay tang trong luot nay
_G.__LurnaDunRuns   = _G.__LurnaDunRuns   or 0   -- so luot xong
_G.__LurnaDunEmpty  = _G.__LurnaDunEmpty  or 0   -- dem tick lien tuc khong con mob
_G.__LurnaDunTier   = _G.__LurnaDunTier   or 1   -- bac nhay dang thu (1..4)
_G.__LurnaDunAdvT   = _G.__LurnaDunAdvT   or 0   -- luc bam nhay, de biet het 6s chua
_G.__LurnaDunAdvFr  = _G.__LurnaDunAdvFr  or 0   -- tang luc bam nhay
_G.__LurnaDunMark   = _G.__LurnaDunMark   or ""  -- dau moc tien do (phase|tang)
_G.__LurnaDunMarkT  = _G.__LurnaDunMarkT  or 0
_G.__LurnaDunSaves  = _G.__LurnaDunSaves  or 0   -- da cuu may lan
_G.__LurnaDunT0     = _G.__LurnaDunT0     or 0   -- luc bat dau luot
_G.__LurnaDunLast   = _G.__LurnaDunLast   or 0   -- luot truoc mat bao nhieu giay
_G.__LurnaDunFocusOn = _G.__LurnaDunFocusOn or false
_G.__LurnaDunBoss   = _G.__LurnaDunBoss   or "-" -- ten + % HP boss, chi de xem

function LurnaDunLog(s)
  s = tostring(s)
  local t = _G.__LurnaDunLog
  if t[#t] == s then return end -- cung mot cau thi khong nhoi lai
  table.insert(t, os.date("%H:%M:%S") .. " " .. s)
  while #t > 12 do table.remove(t, 1) end
end

function LurnaDunSay(step, why)
  _G.__LurnaDunStep = tostring(step or "-")
  _G.__LurnaDunWhy  = tostring(why or "-")
  LurnaDunLog(string.format("[%s] %s", tostring(_G.__LurnaDunPhase), _G.__LurnaDunWhy))
end

-- workspace.Map.Dungeon: co the KHONG ton tai (dang o ngoai bien), nen tra nil
-- chu khong duoc de no nem loi lam chet ca vong lap 1s.
function LurnaDunMap()
  local ok, m = pcall(function()
    local mp = workspace:FindFirstChild("Map")
    return mp and mp:FindFirstChild("Dungeon") or nil
  end)
  return ok and m or nil
end

-- Danh sach tang da SAP XEP tang dan. Con nao ten khong ra so thi bo qua (map
-- co the co con phu), giong y cach GetHighestFloor() :16565 loc tonumber.
function LurnaDunFloors()
  local out = {}
  local m = LurnaDunMap()
  if not m then return out end
  pcall(function()
    for _, v in ipairs(m:GetChildren()) do
      local n = tonumber(v.Name)
      if n then table.insert(out, { n = n, obj = v }) end
    end
  end)
  table.sort(out, function(a, b) return a.n < b.n end)
  return out
end

function LurnaDunIn()
  return #LurnaDunFloors() > 0
end

-- Root cua EntranceTeleporter / ExitTeleporter. which = "Exit" hoac "Entrance".
function LurnaDunTele(floorObj, which)
  if not floorObj then return nil end
  local ok, r = pcall(function()
    local t = floorObj:FindFirstChild(which .. "Teleporter")
    return t and t:FindFirstChild("Root") or nil
  end)
  return ok and r or nil
end

-- Tang dang dung. Ban cu (GetCurrentFloor :16486) chi nhan khi cach EXIT duoi
-- 200 studs, nen dung giua tang la doc ra 0 - khong dung de dieu khien duoc.
-- Day doi sang: tang nao co teleporter (vao HAY ra) GAN nguoi nhat thi la tang
-- do, khong dat nguong. Dung giua tang van ra dung so.
function LurnaDunHere()
  local hrp = LurnaHRP()
  if not hrp then return 0, nil end
  local bestN, bestObj, bestD = 0, nil, math.huge
  for _, f in ipairs(LurnaDunFloors()) do
    for _, w in ipairs({ "Exit", "Entrance" }) do
      local r = LurnaDunTele(f.obj, w)
      if r then
        local d = (r.Position - hrp.Position).Magnitude
        if d < bestD then bestD, bestN, bestObj = d, f.n, f.obj end
      end
    end
  end
  return bestN, bestObj
end

function LurnaDunTop()
  local fl = LurnaDunFloors()
  if #fl == 0 then return 0, nil end
  local t = fl[#fl]
  return t.n, t.obj
end

-- Dem mob con song trong ban kinh, dong thoi lay con MaxHealth to nhat. Con to
-- nhat gan nhu chac la boss/mini-boss, va cai nay doc tu Humanoid nen khong
-- phai doan ten con nao - khong bia danh sach ten boss.
function LurnaDunAlive(radius)
  radius = radius or LurnaDunCfg.RANGE
  local hrp = LurnaHRP()
  if not hrp then return 0, nil, 0 end
  local cnt, big, bigHp = 0, nil, -1
  pcall(function()
    local en = workspace:FindFirstChild("Enemies")
    if not en then return end
    for _, v in ipairs(en:GetChildren()) do
      if v:IsA("Model") and not v:GetAttribute("IsBoat") then
        local root = v:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        local hum = v:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if root and hum and hum.Health > 0
           and (root.Position - hrp.Position).Magnitude <= radius then
          cnt = cnt + 1
          if hum.MaxHealth > bigHp then bigHp, big = hum.MaxHealth, v end
        end
      end
    end
  end)
  return cnt, big, bigHp
end

-- Giong LurnaRaidDrive: ghi _G[k], NHO lai la chinh minh bat, va keo cong tac
-- tren UI theo cho khop. Undrive chi tat lai DUNG nhung gi minh da bat.
function LurnaDunDrive(k, v, uiId)
  _G[k] = v
  if v then _G.__LurnaDunDrove[k] = uiId or true end
  if uiId then pcall(LurnaSyncToggle, uiId, v) end
end

function LurnaDunUndrive()
  for k, uiId in pairs(_G.__LurnaDunDrove) do
    _G[k] = false
    if type(uiId) == "string" then pcall(LurnaSyncToggle, uiId, false) end
  end
  _G.__LurnaDunDrove = {}
end

-- Bon cong tac TPFloor1..4 la latch mot-phat: dang chay ma no con bat thi no se
-- keo nguoi di ngang sau lung minh. Nen cat luc bat dau va TRA LAI luc dung -
-- khong tu y dong quyet dinh cua nguoi dung.
function LurnaDunSeizeTP()
  if _G.__LurnaDunSaved then return end
  local s = {}
  for i = 1, 4 do
    s["TPFloor" .. i] = _G["TPFloor" .. i] and true or false
    _G["TPFloor" .. i] = false
    pcall(LurnaSyncToggle, "Toggle_TP_Exit_" .. i, false)
  end
  _G.__LurnaDunSaved = s
end

function LurnaDunReleaseTP()
  local s = _G.__LurnaDunSaved
  if not s then return end
  for i = 1, 4 do
    local v = s["TPFloor" .. i] and true or false
    _G["TPFloor" .. i] = v
    pcall(LurnaSyncToggle, "Toggle_TP_Exit_" .. i, v)
  end
  _G.__LurnaDunSaved = nil
end

-- CHI MOT engine chay mot luc. Hai cai cung banh mob thi ca hai deu giat, nen
-- viec loai tru nhau dat gon o DUNG MOT cho thay vi rai khap state machine.
--   "farm" = de engine #66 (Toggle_Auto_Farm_Dungeon) don ca tang
--   "boss" = tat #66, chay vong tap trung con MaxHealth to nhat
--   "off"  = tat het
function LurnaDunEngine(mode)
  if mode == "farm" then
    _G.__LurnaDunFocusOn = false
    LurnaDunDrive("AutoFarmDungeon", true, "Toggle_Auto_Farm_Dungeon")
  elseif mode == "boss" then
    LurnaDunDrive("AutoFarmDungeon", false, "Toggle_Auto_Farm_Dungeon")
    _G.__LurnaDunDrove["AutoFarmDungeon"] = "Toggle_Auto_Farm_Dungeon"
    _G.__LurnaDunFocusOn = true
  else
    _G.__LurnaDunFocusOn = false
    LurnaDunDrive("AutoFarmDungeon", false, "Toggle_Auto_Farm_Dungeon")
  end
end

-- Bon BAC nhay tang. Day dung la bon cong tac TP Exit 1..4 bam tay gop lai roi
-- chay tu dong theo thu tu: bac truoc 6s ma tang khong doi thi tu len bac sau.
--   bac 1 = ExitTeleporter cua tang DANG dung      (nhu TP Exit (1))
--   bac 2 = EntranceTeleporter cua tang KE TIEP    (nhu TP Exit (2))
--   bac 3 = ExitTeleporter cua tang CAO NHAT       (nhu TP Exit (3))
--   bac 4 = ExitTeleporter GAN nguoi nhat          (nhu TP Exit (4))
function LurnaDunAdvance(tier, curN, curObj)
  local hrp = LurnaHRP()
  if not hrp then return false, "khong co HumanoidRootPart" end
  local target, note
  if tier == 1 then
    target, note = LurnaDunTele(curObj, "Exit"), "exit tang " .. tostring(curN)
  elseif tier == 2 then
    for _, f in ipairs(LurnaDunFloors()) do
      if f.n > curN then
        target = LurnaDunTele(f.obj, "Entrance")
        note = "cua vao tang " .. tostring(f.n)
        if target then break end
      end
    end
  elseif tier == 3 then
    local tn, tobj = LurnaDunTop()
    target, note = LurnaDunTele(tobj, "Exit"), "exit tang cao nhat " .. tostring(tn)
  else
    local bd = math.huge
    for _, f in ipairs(LurnaDunFloors()) do
      local r = LurnaDunTele(f.obj, "Exit")
      if r then
        local d = (r.Position - hrp.Position).Magnitude
        if d < bd then
          bd, target, note = d, r, "exit gan nhat (tang " .. tostring(f.n) .. ")"
        end
      end
    end
  end
  if not target then
    return false, "bac " .. tostring(tier) .. ": khong co cho nhay"
  end
  -- y het bon toggle cu: * CFrame.new(0,3,0) de khong ket trong san
  local ok = pcall(function() hrp.CFrame = target.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 3, 0) end)
  if not ok then return false, "bac " .. tostring(tier) .. ": dat CFrame that bai" end
  return true, note
end

-- Tim ProximityPrompt gan nguoi. CO Y khong quet workspace:GetDescendants():
-- map Blox Fruits qua to, quet mot phat la treo may. Chi soi trong workspace.NPCs
-- va chinh Map.Dungeon, va chi nhung model da o trong ban kinh.
function LurnaDunPrompt(radius)
  radius = radius or 40
  local hrp = LurnaHRP()
  if not hrp then return nil end
  local best, bd = nil, math.huge
  -- [LURNA FIX #332] Truoc day viet ipairs({ workspace.NPCs, LurnaDunMap() }) - sai
  -- that: ipairs DUNG NGAY o phan tu nil dau tien, nen khi trong dungeon ma
  -- workspace.NPCs khong ton tai thi nguon thu hai (chinh Map.Dungeon) khong bao gio
  -- duoc soi -> ham tra ve nil va #19 tuong dungeon khong co prompt nao. Bay gio xay
  -- danh sach bang table.insert co canh, khong con lo hong vi tri 1.
  local boxes = {}
  local wn = workspace:FindFirstChild("NPCs")
  if wn then table.insert(boxes, wn) end
  local dm = LurnaDunMap()
  if dm then table.insert(boxes, dm) end
  for _, box in ipairs(boxes) do
    if box then
      pcall(function()
        for _, m in ipairs(box:GetChildren()) do
          local part = m:IsA("BasePart") and m
            or m:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            or (m:IsA("Model") and m.PrimaryPart)
          if part then
            local d = (part.Position - hrp.Position).Magnitude
            if d <= radius and d < bd then
              local p = m:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("ProximityPrompt", true)
              if p and p.Enabled then bd, best = d, p end
            end
          end
        end
      end)
    end
  end
  return best, bd
end

-- Nut "Do tim": CHI DOC roi ghi vao o log, khong ban remote nao, khong in ra
-- console. De ban tu thay ten THAT ma dien vao o Input - do la cach duy nhat
-- lam buoc vao tu dong ma khong phai bia ten remote.
function LurnaDunScan()
  LurnaDunLog("== do tim ==")
  pcall(function()
    local rs = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
    local hit = 0
    for _, box in ipairs({ rs, rs:FindFirstChild("Remotes") }) do
      if box then
        for _, v in ipairs(box:GetChildren()) do
          local nm = string.lower(v.Name)
          if (v:IsA("RemoteEvent") or v:IsA("RemoteFunction") or v:IsA("Folder"))
             and (string.find(nm, "dungeon", 1, true) or string.find(nm, "raid", 1, true)) then
            hit = hit + 1
            LurnaDunLog("remote: " .. v.Name)
          end
        end
      end
    end
    if hit == 0 then LurnaDunLog("remote: khong con nao khop dungeon/raid") end
  end)
  pcall(function()
    local mp = workspace:FindFirstChild("Map")
    if not mp then LurnaDunLog("map: khong co workspace.Map") return end
    local n = 0
    for _, v in ipairs(mp:GetChildren()) do
      if string.find(string.lower(v.Name), "dungeon", 1, true) then
        n = n + 1
        LurnaDunLog("map: " .. v.Name)
      end
    end
    if n == 0 then LurnaDunLog("map: chua co con nao ten dungeon") end
  end)
  local fl = LurnaDunFloors()
  if #fl > 0 then
    local names = {}
    for _, f in ipairs(fl) do table.insert(names, tostring(f.n)) end
    LurnaDunLog("tang: " .. table.concat(names, ","))
  else
    LurnaDunLog("tang: chua co (dang o ngoai dungeon)")
  end
  local p, d = LurnaDunPrompt(60)
  if p then
    LurnaDunLog(string.format("prompt: %s (%dm)", tostring(p.ObjectText), math.floor(d or 0)))
  else
    LurnaDunLog("prompt: khong co cai nao trong 60m")
  end
end

-- Buoc VAO dungeon - phan YEU nhat, va no biet the. Corpus khong co remote nao
-- lam viec nay nen o day KHONG bia ten nao ca:
--   1) ban dien ten vao o Input -> LurnaCommF(ten, "1") trong pcall + rate gate
--   2) co ProximityPrompt gan   -> fireproximityprompt (API executor, khong phai
--      ten cua game)
--   3) khong duoc gi            -> noi thang "tu vao mot lan di"
function LurnaDunEnterStep()
  if not getgenv().LurnaDunEnter then
    return "hay tu vao dungeon mot lan, tu do Kaitun se lo het"
  end
  if not LurnaGate("dun_enter", 4) then return "cho nhip thu vao" end
  local nm = tostring(getgenv().LurnaDunNpc or "")
  if nm ~= "" then
    local ok = pcall(function() LurnaCommF(nm, "1") end)
    return ok and ("da thu remote ban dien: " .. nm) or ("remote khong an: " .. nm)
  end
  local p = LurnaDunPrompt(40)
  if p and fireproximityprompt then
    local ok = pcall(fireproximityprompt, p)
    if ok then return "da bam prompt gan do: " .. tostring(p.ObjectText) end
  end
  return "chua vao duoc: bam Do Tim roi dien ten remote vao o duoi"
end

-- Dung han: tra lai moi thu da cuop, keo cong tac tren UI ve TAT, va NOI RO vi
-- sao. Khong bao gio dung am tham.
function LurnaDunStop(why)
  getgenv().LurnaDunRun = false
  _G.__LurnaDunPhase = "TAT"
  LurnaDunEngine("off")
  LurnaDunUndrive()
  LurnaDunReleaseTP()
  pcall(LurnaSyncToggle, "Toggle_Lurna_Dun_Run", false)
  LurnaDunSay("dung", tostring(why))
end

function LurnaDunStep()
  -- Moc tien do = phase + tang. Y het nhau qua STUCK giay la thuc su ket, luc
  -- do doi bac nhay va tha lai rate gate. Cuu STUCK_N lan khong duoc thi dung,
  -- khong quay vong vo tan trong im lang.
  local mark = tostring(_G.__LurnaDunPhase) .. "|" .. tostring(_G.__LurnaDunFloor)
  if mark ~= _G.__LurnaDunMark then
    _G.__LurnaDunMark, _G.__LurnaDunMarkT = mark, tick()
  elseif (tick() - _G.__LurnaDunMarkT) > LurnaDunCfg.STUCK then
    _G.__LurnaDunMarkT = tick()
    _G.__LurnaDunSaves = _G.__LurnaDunSaves + 1
    if _G.__LurnaDunSaves > LurnaDunCfg.STUCK_N then
      LurnaDunStop(string.format("ket %ds x %d lan cuu khong duoc",
        LurnaDunCfg.STUCK, LurnaDunCfg.STUCK_N))
      return
    end
    _G.__LurnaDunEmpty = 0
    _G.__LurnaDunTier = (_G.__LurnaDunTier % 4) + 1
    pcall(LurnaGateReset, "dun_enter")
    LurnaDunLog(string.format("ket %ds - cuu lan %d, doi sang bac %d",
      LurnaDunCfg.STUCK, _G.__LurnaDunSaves, _G.__LurnaDunTier))
  end

  -- ---------- khong o trong dungeon ----------
  if not LurnaDunIn() then
    local p = _G.__LurnaDunPhase
    if p == "CLEAR" or p == "BOSS" or p == "ADVANCE" then
      -- vua o trong ma gio map bien => luot da xong
      _G.__LurnaDunRuns = _G.__LurnaDunRuns + 1
      _G.__LurnaDunLast = (_G.__LurnaDunT0 > 0) and math.floor(tick() - _G.__LurnaDunT0) or 0
      LurnaDunLog(string.format("XONG luot %d - %d tang - %ds",
        _G.__LurnaDunRuns, _G.__LurnaDunSteps, _G.__LurnaDunLast))
      _G.__LurnaDunSteps, _G.__LurnaDunT0 = 0, 0
      if not getgenv().LurnaDunLoop then
        LurnaDunStop("xong luot, va khong bat Lam Lai")
        return
      end
    end
    _G.__LurnaDunPhase = "ENTER"
    LurnaDunEngine("off")
    LurnaDunSay("vao dungeon", LurnaDunEnterStep())
    return
  end

  -- ---------- dang o trong dungeon ----------
  if _G.__LurnaDunT0 == 0 then
    _G.__LurnaDunT0 = tick()
    _G.__LurnaDunSteps, _G.__LurnaDunEmpty = 0, 0
    _G.__LurnaDunTier, _G.__LurnaDunSaves = 1, 0
    LurnaDunSeizeTP()
    LurnaDunLog("bat dau luot moi")
  end

  local curN, curObj = LurnaDunHere()
  _G.__LurnaDunFloor = curN
  if curN > _G.__LurnaDunBest then _G.__LurnaDunBest = curN end
  local topN = LurnaDunTop()
  local cnt, big = LurnaDunAlive(LurnaDunCfg.RANGE)
  _G.__LurnaDunBoss = "-"
  if big then
    local hum = big:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if hum and hum.MaxHealth > 0 then
      _G.__LurnaDunBoss = string.format("%s %d%%", big.Name,
        math.floor(hum.Health / hum.MaxHealth * 100))
    end
  end

  -- Vua bam nhay xong: xem tang co doi that khong. Doi = an, het ADV_WAIT giay
  -- ma khong doi = bac do khong an, len bac sau.
  if _G.__LurnaDunPhase == "ADVANCE" then
    if curN > 0 and curN ~= _G.__LurnaDunAdvFr then
      _G.__LurnaDunSteps = _G.__LurnaDunSteps + 1
      _G.__LurnaDunTier, _G.__LurnaDunEmpty = 1, 0
      _G.__LurnaDunPhase = "CLEAR"
      LurnaDunSay("len tang", string.format("da sang tang %d", curN))
      return
    end
    local left = LurnaDunCfg.ADV_WAIT - (tick() - _G.__LurnaDunAdvT)
    if left > 0 then
      LurnaDunSay("cho tang doi", string.format("bac %d, con %ds",
        _G.__LurnaDunTier, math.ceil(left)))
      return
    end
    _G.__LurnaDunTier = (_G.__LurnaDunTier % 4) + 1
    _G.__LurnaDunPhase = "CLEAR"
    LurnaDunSay("nhay khong an", "doi sang bac " .. tostring(_G.__LurnaDunTier))
    return
  end

  -- Con mob thi don. O tang cuoi va co bat Tap Trung Boss thi tat engine #66 di
  -- va tu banh con MaxHealth to nhat: adds tang cuoi de re lien tuc, "danh con
  -- gan nhat" se banh adds mai ma khong bao gio den duoc boss.
  if cnt > 0 then
    _G.__LurnaDunEmpty = 0
    if getgenv().LurnaDunFocus and topN > 0 and curN >= topN then
      _G.__LurnaDunPhase = "BOSS"
      LurnaDunEngine("boss")
      LurnaDunSay("danh boss", string.format("tang cuoi %d - %s | con %d muc tieu",
        curN, _G.__LurnaDunBoss, cnt))
    else
      _G.__LurnaDunPhase = "CLEAR"
      LurnaDunEngine("farm")
      LurnaDunSay("don tang", string.format("tang %d/%d - con %d con", curN, topN, cnt))
    end
    return
  end

  -- Het mob. KHONG tin ngay: mob ra tung dot, nhay exit dung luc dot moi dang
  -- spawn la vo luot. Phai TRONG lien tuc EMPTY_N nhip moi coi la sach.
  _G.__LurnaDunEmpty = _G.__LurnaDunEmpty + 1
  if _G.__LurnaDunEmpty < LurnaDunCfg.EMPTY_N then
    _G.__LurnaDunPhase = "CLEAR"
    LurnaDunSay("kiem tra sach", string.format("trong %d/%d nhip",
      _G.__LurnaDunEmpty, LurnaDunCfg.EMPTY_N))
    return
  end

  if _G.__LurnaDunSteps >= LurnaDunCfg.MAX_STEP then
    LurnaDunSay("chan nhay", string.format("da nhay %d tang trong mot luot",
      _G.__LurnaDunSteps))
    return
  end

  LurnaDunEngine("off")
  local ok, note = LurnaDunAdvance(_G.__LurnaDunTier, curN, curObj)
  if ok then
    _G.__LurnaDunPhase = "ADVANCE"
    _G.__LurnaDunAdvT, _G.__LurnaDunAdvFr = tick(), curN
    LurnaDunSay("nhay tang", string.format("bac %d -> %s",
      _G.__LurnaDunTier, tostring(note)))
  else
    _G.__LurnaDunTier = (_G.__LurnaDunTier % 4) + 1
    LurnaDunSay("thu bac khac", tostring(note))
  end
end

function LurnaDunReport()
  local topN = LurnaDunTop()
  local el = (_G.__LurnaDunT0 > 0) and math.floor(tick() - _G.__LurnaDunT0) or 0
  local eng = _G.__LurnaDunFocusOn and "boss"
    or (_G.AutoFarmDungeon and "farm" or "off")
  return string.format(
    "Phase: %s | Buoc: %s\nVi sao: %s\nTang: %s/%s | Cao nhat tung len: %s\nCon to nhat: %s\nDa nhay: %d tang | Xong: %d luot | Luot truoc: %ds | Luot nay: %ds\nEngine: %s | Cuu: %d/%d",
    tostring(_G.__LurnaDunPhase), tostring(_G.__LurnaDunStep), tostring(_G.__LurnaDunWhy),
    tostring(_G.__LurnaDunFloor), tostring(topN), tostring(_G.__LurnaDunBest),
    tostring(_G.__LurnaDunBoss), _G.__LurnaDunSteps, _G.__LurnaDunRuns,
    _G.__LurnaDunLast, el, eng, _G.__LurnaDunSaves, LurnaDunCfg.STUCK_N)
end

-- Vong tap trung boss. Chi chay khi LurnaDunEngine("boss") bat co, va luc do
-- engine #66 da bi tat - hai cai KHONG BAO GIO cung chay, nen khong giat.
spawn(function()
  while true do
    local w = 0.2
    local okT, t = pcall(LurnaFarmTick)
    if okT and tonumber(t) then w = tonumber(t) end
    -- [Rule 1] khong bao gio ban duoi 0.15s, ke ca khi LurnaFarmTick tra thap
    if w < 0.15 then w = 0.15 end
    if _G.__LurnaDunFocusOn and getgenv().LurnaDunRun then
      pcall(function()
        local _, big = LurnaDunAlive(LurnaDunCfg.RANGE)
        if big then Attack.Kill(big, true) end
      end)
    else
      w = 0.5 -- khong lam gi thi ngu lau hon cho do ton CPU
    end
    task.wait(w)
  end
end)

    if getgenv().LurnaDunRun then pcall(LurnaDunStep) end
    pcall(function()
      if LurnaDunStatusBox then
        LurnaDunStatusBox:SetDesc(string.format("%s | Trong dungeon: %s\n%s",
          getgenv().LurnaDunRun and "DANG BAT" or "TAT",
          LurnaDunIn() and "CO" or "khong",
          LurnaDunReport()))
      end
      if LurnaDunLogBox then
        local t = _G.__LurnaDunLog or {}
        local last = {}
        for i = math.max(1, #t - 6), #t do table.insert(last, t[i]) end
        LurnaDunLogBox:SetDesc((#last > 0) and table.concat(last, "\n") or "-")
      end
    end)
  end
end)

-- ============================================================================
-- [LURNA FEATURE #20] ESP NPC - nhin ra NPC xuyen tuong
-- ============================================================================
-- MUC DO KIEM CHUNG (doc that trong corpus Hub/, khong bia):
--   CHAC CHAN:
--     * workspace.NPCs:GetChildren()            :2821, :11285
--     * <npc>.HumanoidRootPart                  :2822, :18040
--     * BillboardGui + Adornee + AlwaysOnTop    kieu ESP cua ChestEsp :15511
--     * math.floor(khoang cach / 3) .. " M"     quy uoc san co :15535
--
-- CO Y LAM KHAC may cai ESP cu trong file nay:
--   Cac ESP cu chay "while <co> do <Esp>() task.wait() end" tuc la MOI FRAME,
--   va moi frame lai dung chuoi text moi cho tung vat. NPC thi ca tram con nen
--   lam vay la tut FPS thay ro. Cai nay:
--     - tao BillboardGui DUNG MOT LAN cho moi NPC, lan sau tim lai chu khong tao
--     - 0.3s moi doi chu mot lan (khoang cach khong nhay nhanh den vay)
--     - qua ban kinh thi AN nhan (Enabled = false) chu KHONG xoa, vao lai tam
--       ban kinh la hien ngay, khong phai tao lai
--     - nhan gan vao chinh HumanoidRootPart cua NPC nen NPC bien la nhan bien
--       theo, khong bao gio con nhan mo vang lai giua khong khi
--
-- KHONG lam trong day: khong hook, khong vo hieu hoa module nao cua game. Day
-- chi la ve chu len man hinh cua chinh may minh.
-- ============================================================================

getgenv().LurnaNpcEsp     = getgenv().LurnaNpcEsp or false
-- [LURNA FIX #329] Ban kinh cu Max 5000 / mac dinh 1500 la QUA THAP: mot dao
-- Blox Fruits da rong hon the, nen NPC ngay dao ben canh cung khong hien.
-- Keo len 50000 va mac dinh 8000. Keo len thi phai chan so nhan lai (Cap), neu
-- khong ca man hinh la chu de nhau - xem LurnaNpcEspTick().
getgenv().LurnaNpcEspDist = getgenv().LurnaNpcEspDist or 8000
getgenv().LurnaNpcEspFind = getgenv().LurnaNpcEspFind or ""
getgenv().LurnaNpcEspCap  = getgenv().LurnaNpcEspCap  or 40
-- [LURNA FIX #330] Nguon thu hai: NPC chua duoc load vao vung.
getgenv().LurnaNpcEspAll  = getgenv().LurnaNpcEspAll or false
_G.__LurnaNpcEspTag = "LurnaNpcEsp"
_G.__LurnaNpcEspN   = _G.__LurnaNpcEspN or 0
_G.__LurnaNpcEspTot = _G.__LurnaNpcEspTot or 0
_G.__LurnaNpcEspFar = _G.__LurnaNpcEspFar or 0 -- so NPC dung coc (nguon thu hai)

function LurnaNpcEspMake(root)
  local g = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
  g.Name = _G.__LurnaNpcEspTag
  g.Size = UDim2.new(0, 220, 0, 34)
  g.ExtentsOffset = Vector3.new(0, 2.4, 0)
  g.Adornee = root
  g.AlwaysOnTop = true
  g.Parent = root
  local L = Instance.new("TextLabel")
  L.Name = "Lb"
  L.Font = Enum.Font.Code
  L.TextSize = 14
  L.TextWrapped = true
  L.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
  L.BackgroundTransparency = 1
  L.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.4
  -- vang cam: khong trung cyan cua Esp Chest (:15527) hay do/xanh cua Esp Player
  L.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 190, 90)
  L.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top
  L.Parent = g
  return g
end

-- [LURNA FIX #330] workspace.NPCs CHI chua NPC dang duoc load trong vung. NPC o
-- dao khac, va nhat la NPC MOI cua ban update ma minh chua tung den gan, la
-- khong thay gi ca. ReplicatedStorage.NPCs moi la danh sach DAY DU game biet
-- (:2826, :18023) va moi con cung co HumanoidRootPart mang toa do (:18040).
-- ReplicatedStorage khong ve ra man hinh duoc nen phai dung Part vo hinh lam
-- coc - dung kieu AdvanFruitEsp (:15364) da co san trong file. Khac mot cho:
-- gom het coc vao MOT Folder de tat cong tac la xoa sach mot phat, khong de roi
-- Part lung tung trong workspace nhu ban cu.
function LurnaNpcEspFolder(make)
  local f = workspace:FindFirstChild("LurnaNpcEspProxy")
  if not f and make then
    f = Instance.new("Folder")
    f.Name = "LurnaNpcEspProxy"
    f.Parent = workspace
  end
  return f
end

function LurnaNpcEspProxy(name, cf)
  local f = LurnaNpcEspFolder(true)
  if not f then return nil end
  local p = f:FindFirstChild(name)
  if not p then
    p = Instance.new("Part")
    p.Name = name
    p.Size = Vector3.new(1, 1, 1)
    p.Transparency = 1
    p.Anchored = true
    p.CanCollide = false
    -- Hai thuoc tinh nay moi co o Roblox doi sau; pcall rieng de may cu khong
    -- nem loi lam mat luon cai coc.
    pcall(function() p.CanQuery = false p.CanTouch = false end)
    p.Parent = f
  end
  p.CFrame = cf
  return p
end

-- Tat cong tac thi xoa sach nhan. Duyet ca workspace.NPCs, khong dua vao danh
-- sach nho trong bo nho: NPC co the da bi thay the con khac trong luc bat.
function LurnaNpcEspClear()
  pcall(function()
    local box = workspace:FindFirstChild("NPCs")
    if not box then return end
    for _, npc in ipairs(box:GetChildren()) do
      local root = npc:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
      local g = root and root:FindFirstChild(_G.__LurnaNpcEspTag)
      if g then g:Destroy() end
    end
  end)
  -- [LURNA FIX #330] coc cua nguon thu hai: xoa ca Folder mot phat
  pcall(function()
    local f = LurnaNpcEspFolder(false)
    if f then f:Destroy() end
  end)
  _G.__LurnaNpcEspN, _G.__LurnaNpcEspTot, _G.__LurnaNpcEspFar = 0, 0, 0
end

-- [LURNA FIX #329] Ban kinh keo len 50000 nen phai chan SO NHAN lai: sap theo
-- khoang cach roi chi ve Cap con gan nhat. Khong chan thi keo thanh truot len
-- het la ca man hinh phu chu - dung nghia "thay xa hon nhung khong doc duoc gi".
function LurnaNpcEspDraw(cand, total, far)
  table.sort(cand, function(a, b) return a.d < b.d end)
  local cap = tonumber(getgenv().LurnaNpcEspCap) or 40
  local shown = 0
  for i, c in ipairs(cand) do
    pcall(function()
      local g = c.part:FindFirstChild(_G.__LurnaNpcEspTag)
      if i <= cap then
        if not g then g = LurnaNpcEspMake(c.part) end
        g.Enabled = true
        local L = g:FindFirstChild("Lb")
        if L then L.Text = string.format("%s\n%d M", c.nm, math.floor(c.d / 3)) end
        shown = shown + 1
      elseif g then
        -- an di, KHONG xoa: vao lai trong tam la hien ngay, khong phai tao lai
        g.Enabled = false
      end
    end)
  end
  return shown, total, far
end

function LurnaNpcEspTick()
  local hrp = LurnaHRP()
  if not hrp then return 0, 0, 0 end
  local box = workspace:FindFirstChild("NPCs")
  local q = string.lower(tostring(getgenv().LurnaNpcEspFind or ""))
  local lim = tonumber(getgenv().LurnaNpcEspDist) or 8000
  local cand, total, far, live = {}, 0, 0, {}

  -- nguon 1: NPC that dang o trong vung. Duyet TRUC TIEP moi nhip nen NPC moi
  -- cua ban update tu hien, khong co danh sach nao phai lam moi tay.
  if box then
    for _, npc in ipairs(box:GetChildren()) do
      pcall(function()
        local root = npc:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not root then return end
        total = total + 1
        live[npc.Name] = true
        local d = (root.Position - hrp.Position).Magnitude
        local hit = (q == "") or (string.find(string.lower(npc.Name), q, 1, true) ~= nil)
        if hit and d <= lim then
          table.insert(cand, { part = root, nm = npc.Name, d = d })
        else
          local g = root:FindFirstChild(_G.__LurnaNpcEspTag)
          if g then g.Enabled = false end
        end
      end)
    end
  end

  -- [LURNA FIX #330] nguon 2: NPC chua load. Bo qua con nao da co o nguon 1,
  -- khong thi mot NPC hien hai cai nhan de nhau.
  if getgenv().LurnaNpcEspAll then
    pcall(function()
      for _, npc in ipairs(replicated.NPCs:GetChildren()) do
        pcall(function()
          local r = npc:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
          if not r or live[npc.Name] then return end
          total = total + 1
          local d = (r.Position - hrp.Position).Magnitude
          local hit = (q == "") or (string.find(string.lower(npc.Name), q, 1, true) ~= nil)
          if hit and d <= lim then
            local p = LurnaNpcEspProxy(npc.Name, r.CFrame)
            if p then
              far = far + 1
              table.insert(cand, { part = p, nm = npc.Name .. " *", d = d })
            end
          end
        end)
      end
    end)
  end
  return LurnaNpcEspDraw(cand, total, far)
end

-- MOT vong duy nhat, khong sinh vong moi moi lan bat cong tac (kieu cu
-- "task.spawn trong Callback" bam nhanh la co hai ba vong cung chay).
spawn(function()
  while true do
    if getgenv().LurnaNpcEsp then
      local ok, n, t, fr = pcall(LurnaNpcEspTick)
      if ok then
        _G.__LurnaNpcEspN, _G.__LurnaNpcEspTot = n or 0, t or 0
        _G.__LurnaNpcEspFar = fr or 0
      end
      task.wait(0.3)
    else
      task.wait(1)
    end
    pcall(function()
      if LurnaNpcEspBox then
        LurnaNpcEspBox:SetDesc(string.format(
          "%s | Hien: %d / %d NPC (coc xa: %d)\nBan kinh: %d | Chan nhan: %d | Loc ten: %s",
          getgenv().LurnaNpcEsp and "DANG BAT" or "TAT",
          _G.__LurnaNpcEspN, _G.__LurnaNpcEspTot, _G.__LurnaNpcEspFar,
          math.floor(tonumber(getgenv().LurnaNpcEspDist) or 0),
          math.floor(tonumber(getgenv().LurnaNpcEspCap) or 0),
          (tostring(getgenv().LurnaNpcEspFind or "") ~= "")
            and tostring(getgenv().LurnaNpcEspFind) or "(tat ca)"))
      end
    end)
    -- [LURNA FIX #331] NPCList (:18021) chi duoc dung DUNG MOT LAN luc load. Ban
    -- update them NPC, hoac replicated.NPCs day len day du sau khi menu da mo, la
    -- o chon NPC ben tab Dich Chuyen thieu con moi vinh vien. Day so sanh so
    -- luong, khac thi dung lai roi SetValues (#233). Gate 5s de khong quet
    -- replicated.NPCs 0.3s mot lan cho khong.
    if LurnaGate("npclist_refresh", 5) then
      pcall(function()
        if not (NPCsPos and NPCsPos.SetValues and NPCList) then return end
        local kids = replicated.NPCs:GetChildren()
        if #kids == #NPCList then return end
        local t = {}
        for _, v in ipairs(kids) do table.insert(t, v.Name) end
        table.sort(t)
        NPCList = t
        NPCsPos:SetValues(t)
      end)
    end
  end
end)

Tabs.Esp:AddToggle("Toggle_Esp_Npc_All", {
  Title = "Kể Cả NPC Chưa Hiện Trong Vùng",
  Description = "Lấy thêm từ danh sách đầy đủ của game, tên có dấu * ở cuối. Toạ độ là chỗ NPC mọc nên NPC nào đi lại thì hơi lệch",

        if f then f:Destroy() end
      end)
      _G.__LurnaNpcEspFar = 0
    end
  end
})

-- ============================================================================
-- [LURNA FEATURE #21] NOCLIP - di xuyen tuong, co GHI NHO de tra lai dung
-- ============================================================================
-- MUC DO KIEM CHUNG (doc that trong corpus Hub/, khong bia):
--   CHAC CHAN (co that trong chinh file nay):
--     * part:IsA("BasePart") + part.CanCollide = false  :452-455 LurnaNoCollide
--     * RunService (local san co o giua file)           :17379
--     * LurnaHRP()                                      :76
--     * ten mover phai nam trong MOVER_OK cua Anti-Stun :17598
--
-- SUA MOT LOI THAT cua ban Fly co trong file (:17520-17524):
--   Ban do khi TAT thi dat CanCollide = true cho TAT CA BasePart cua nhan vat.
--   Nhung mu, kinh, phu kien va vai part cua chinh nhan vat VON DA false tu dau
--   - bat het len la doi trang thai goc. Cai nay ghi lai DUNG nhung part no da
--   tat, va chi tra lai nhung part do. Cung kieu "cat roi tra lai" nhu
--   LurnaDunSeizeTP (:23527) cua #19.
--
-- KHONG lam trong day: khong hook, khong vo hieu hoa, khong bit module chong
-- gian lan nao cua game. Chi ghi CanCollide - thuoc tinh client duoc phep ghi.
-- NOI RO GIOI HAN: server van thay toa do that. Nam trong long nui / trong tuong
-- la hanh vi de nhan ra, nen no CO cong diem rui ro trong LurnaAntiBan.Risk().
-- ============================================================================

getgenv().LurnaNoclip     = getgenv().LurnaNoclip     or false
getgenv().LurnaNoclipHold = getgenv().LurnaNoclipHold or false
-- Bang ghi nho part da tat. __mode = "k" de part bi Destroy tu roi ra khoi bang,
-- khong giu tham chieu chet lam ro bo nho sau hang tram lan hoi sinh.
_G.__LurnaNcOff   = _G.__LurnaNcOff or setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
_G.__LurnaNcN     = _G.__LurnaNcN     or 0
_G.__LurnaNcSweep = _G.__LurnaNcSweep or 0

-- Tat CanCollide cua mot part va GHI NHO. Chi nhan la "cua minh" khi part do dang
-- TRUE - part von false thi khong phai viec cua minh, nhan bua thi luc tra lai se
-- bat sai len (dung la loi cua ban Fly cu).
function LurnaNcHide(part)
  if not part then return end
  if not part:IsA("BasePart") then return end
  if part.CanCollide then
    if _G.__LurnaNcOff[part] == nil then
      _G.__LurnaNcOff[part] = true
      _G.__LurnaNcN = _G.__LurnaNcN + 1
    end
    part.CanCollide = false
  end
end

-- Quet ca nhan vat. Goi khi doi Character va moi 0.5s - KHONG moi frame: nhan vat
-- Blox Fruits co ~25 part, quet 60 lan/giay la vo ich. Giua hai lan quet thi vong
-- Stepped chi soi lai danh sach da biet, re hon nhieu.
function LurnaNcSweep()
  local char = plr.Character
  if not char then return 0 end
  local n = 0
  for _, d in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
    if d:IsA("BasePart") then
      LurnaNcHide(d)
      n = n + 1
    end
  end
  return n
end

-- Tra lai. CHI nhung part chinh minh da tat, va chi khi part con nam trong cay
-- (part da bi Destroy thi ghi vao la nem loi, nen boc pcall rieng tung part de mot
-- part xau khong lam ca vong tra lai dung giua duong).
function LurnaNcRestore()
  for part in pairs(_G.__LurnaNcOff) do
    pcall(function()
      if part.Parent then part.CanCollide = true end
    end)
  end
  _G.__LurnaNcOff = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
  _G.__LurnaNcN = 0
end

-- Chan roi xuyen san. Day la cai lam noclip TRO NEN DUNG DUOC: tat het CanCollide
-- thi dung tren mat dat cung tut xuong long dat roi roi mai vao khoang khong.
-- BodyVelocity nay CHI co luc theo truc Y (MaxForce X = Z = 0) nen no giu do cao
-- ma KHONG cuop quyen di ngang - van bam phim di lai binh thuong.
-- Ten "LurnaNcHover" CO Y de duoc them vao MOVER_OK cua Anti-Stun (:17599), neu
-- khong cong tac "xoa mover" ben do coi day la knockback roi xoa mat.
function LurnaNcHover(on)
  local hrp = LurnaHRP()
  if not hrp then return end
  local bv = hrp:FindFirstChild("LurnaNcHover")
  if on then
    if not bv then
      bv = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
      bv.Name = "LurnaNcHover"
      bv.Parent = hrp
    end
    bv.MaxForce = Vector3.new(0, 1e9, 0)
    bv.Velocity = Vector3.zero
  elseif bv then
    bv:Destroy()
  end
end

-- Tat het: tra CanCollide, bo coc giu do cao, xoa moc.
function LurnaNcStop()
  pcall(LurnaNcRestore)
  pcall(LurnaNcHover, false)
  _G.__LurnaNcChar  = nil
  _G.__LurnaNcSweep = 0
end

-- MOT connection Stepped duy nhat, tao DUNG MOT LAN. Cac cong tac khac trong file
-- moi lan bat lai la spawn them mot vong lap moi (bat/tat 5 lan = 5 vong cung
-- chay); day giu dung mot cai va chi doc co, giong cach #20 lam.
-- Dung Stepped chu khong dung task.wait: Stepped chay TRUOC buoc vat ly nen
-- CanCollide da la false luc engine tinh va cham. Dat trong vong lap thuong thi
-- co frame nguoi bi day ra khoi tuong truoc khi minh kip tat.
if not _G.__LurnaNcConn then
  _G.__LurnaNcConn = RunService.Stepped:Connect(function()
    if not getgenv().LurnaNoclip then return end
    local char = plr.Character
    if not char then return end
    if _G.__LurnaNcChar ~= char then
      -- Doi than: bang ghi nho cu vo nghia (part cu da bi Destroy cung voi than
      -- cu), lam lai tu dau thay vi tra lai - khong con gi de tra.
      _G.__LurnaNcChar = char
      _G.__LurnaNcOff  = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
      _G.__LurnaNcN    = 0
      _G.__LurnaNcSweep = 0
    end
    local now = tick()
    if (now - (_G.__LurnaNcSweep or 0)) >= 0.5 then
      _G.__LurnaNcSweep = now
      pcall(LurnaNcSweep)
      -- Coc giu do cao chi khi nguoi dung bat VA khong dang Fly: Fly tu quan van
      -- toc Y (:17474 LurnaFlyVel), hai cai cung ghi la giat len giat xuong.
      pcall(LurnaNcHover, (getgenv().LurnaNoclipHold and not _G.__LurnaFlying) and true or false)
    else
      -- Giua hai lan quet: chi soi lai part da biet. Game bat lai CanCollide khi
      -- doi tu the / equip tool nen van phai soi, nhung khong can duyet lai ca cay.
      for part in pairs(_G.__LurnaNcOff) do
        if part.Parent and part.CanCollide then part.CanCollide = false end
      end
    end
  end)
end

--       -> chung minh boi vong quet :3010-3026 CUA CHINH FILE NAY, va boi
--          Blox_Fruits_Kaitun.lua:3719-3735 cua chinh project
--     * replicated.NPCs:GetChildren()                   :2826, :18023

--     * <npc>.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame                   :2823, :18041
--     * LurnaCommF("StartQuest", ten, id)               :6866 (co trong rate :108)
--     * LurnaCommF("AbandonQuest")                      :6846

--     * LurnaMobDB (bang tinh viet tay cua hub)         :2847

--   YEU (heuristic, CO NHAN RO, va nguoi dung ghi de duoc):

-- Tuong tu cho NPC: so danh sach NPC hom nay voi moc luu lan truoc.

-- KHONG lam trong day: khong hook, khong vo hieu hoa module nao cua game, khong

getgenv().LurnaNqRun = getgenv().LurnaNqRun or false -- cong tac tu lam quest
getgenv().LurnaNqSel = getgenv().LurnaNqSel or ""    -- nhan quest ban chon
getgenv().LurnaNqNpc = getgenv().LurnaNqNpc or ""    -- NPC ban tu chi dinh
_G.__LurnaNqList  = _G.__LurnaNqList  or {}  -- nhan cho dropdown
_G.__LurnaNqMap   = _G.__LurnaNqMap   or {}  -- nhan -> ban ghi quest

  NEAR    = 15,   -- phai cach NPC duoi 15 studs moi goi StartQuest (server chan xa)
  MAX_ROW = 25,   -- so dong toi da trong o bao cao, dai hon la khong doc duoc
