function LurnaNqSay(phase, why)
  _G.__LurnaNqPhase = tostring(phase or "-")
  _G.__LurnaNqWhy   = tostring(why or "-")
end

-- NPCLocation trong LurnaMobDB la CFrame (:2848), nhung GuideModule co the tra ve
-- Vector3. _tp can CFrame nen chuan hoa mot cho.
function LurnaNqCF(v)
  if typeof(v) == "CFrame" then return v end
  if typeof(v) == "Vector3" then return CFrame.new(v) end
  return nil
end

-- Tap quest ma hub DA biet, lay tu chinh bang tinh LurnaMobDB. Tru ra la con la.
function LurnaNqKnown()
  local q = {}
  for _, row in ipairs(LurnaMobDB or {}) do
    if row.QuestName then q[string.lower(tostring(row.QuestName))] = true end
  end
  return q
end

-- "SwanQuest2" -> "swan". Chi la DOAN, xem muc YEU o dau khoi.
function LurnaNqStem(qName)
  local s = tostring(qName or "")
  s = string.gsub(s, "%d+$", "")
  s = string.gsub(s, "[Qq]uest$", "")
  return string.lower(s)
end

-- Moc danh sach NPC cua lan do truoc. Co writefile thi sang phien sau van con,
-- khong co thi chi so trong phien nay - noi ro chu khong im lang.
function LurnaNqBaseGet()
  if isfile and readfile then
    local ok, s = pcall(function()
      if isfile("lurna_npc_moc.txt") then return readfile("lurna_npc_moc.txt") end
      return nil
    end)
    if ok and type(s) == "string" and s ~= "" then return s end
  end
  return _G.__LurnaNqBase
end

function LurnaNqBaseSet(s)
  _G.__LurnaNqBase = s
  if writefile then pcall(writefile, "lurna_npc_moc.txt", s) end
end

-- Tim NPC giao quest, theo thu tu bang chung TOT -> YEU:
--   1) ban tu chi dinh o dropdown        (chac chan nhat, va la duong LUON co)
--   2) LurnaMobDB co dong dung ten quest (chac chan, nhung quest moi thi khong co)
--   3) doan tu ten quest                 (YEU - xem dau khoi)
--   4) GuideModule.Data.LastClosestNPC   (:3041, chinh game chi ra)
function LurnaNqNpcFor(qName)
  local pick = tostring(getgenv().LurnaNqNpc or "")
  if pick ~= "" then
    local cf = LurnaNqCF(GetQuestPointFromNPC(pick))
    if cf then return pick, cf, "bạn chọn" end
  end
  for _, row in ipairs(LurnaMobDB or {}) do
    if row.QuestName == qName and row.NPCLocation then
      local cf = LurnaNqCF(row.NPCLocation)
      if cf then return tostring(qName), cf, "bảng LurnaMobDB" end
    end
  end
  local stem = LurnaNqStem(qName)
  if stem ~= "" and #stem >= 3 then
    local hrp = LurnaHRP()
    local best, bestCf, bestD = nil, nil, math.huge
    -- Xay danh sach nguon THU CONG chu khong viet { a, b } roi ipairs: neu a la nil
    -- thi ipairs dung ngay o vi tri 1 va nguon b KHONG BAO GIO duoc soi. Dung luc o
    -- ngoai bien / trong dungeon thi workspace.NPCs co the khong ton tai, va do la
    -- dung luc can nguon replicated.NPCs nhat.
    local boxes = {}
    local w1 = workspace:FindFirstChild("NPCs")
    if w1 then table.insert(boxes, w1) end
    local w2 = replicated:FindFirstChild("NPCs")
    if w2 then table.insert(boxes, w2) end
    for _, box in ipairs(boxes) do
      for _, npc in ipairs(box:GetChildren()) do
        if string.find(string.lower(npc.Name), stem, 1, true) then
          local r = npc:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
          if r then
            local d = hrp and (r.Position - hrp.Position).Magnitude or 0
            if d < bestD then bestD, best, bestCf = d, npc.Name, r.CFrame end
          end
        end
      end
    end
    if best then return best, bestCf, "đoán từ tên quest (YẾU)" end
  end
  if GuideModule and GuideModule.Data and GuideModule.Data.LastClosestNPC then
    local nm = tostring(GuideModule.Data.LastClosestNPC)
    local cf = LurnaNqCF(GetQuestPointFromNPC(nm))
    if cf then return nm, cf, "GuideModule của game" end
  end
  return nil, nil, "không tìm ra"
end

-- DO TIM. CHI DOC: khong goi remote nao, khong dich chuyen, khong ghi gi vao game.
-- An toan bam bat cu luc nao, ke ca dang farm.
function LurnaNqScan()
  local lvl  = LurnaKaitunLevel()
  local know = LurnaNqKnown()
  local found, nQ = {}, 0
  pcall(function()
    for qName, qData in pairs(Quests) do
      if type(qData) == "table" then
        for qId, info in pairs(qData) do
          if type(info) == "table" and type(info.Task) == "table" then
            nQ = nQ + 1
            if not know[string.lower(tostring(qName))] then
              -- lay mob dai dien + tong so can giet tu chinh Task cua game
              local mob, need = nil, 0
              for mName, cnt in pairs(info.Task) do
                if not mob then mob = tostring(mName) end
                need = need + (tonumber(cnt) or 0)
              end
              table.insert(found, {
                q    = tostring(qName),
                id   = qId,
                req  = tonumber(info.LevelReq) or 0,
                mob  = mob or "?",
                need = need,
                task = info.Task,
              })
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  end)
  -- sap theo level yeu cau: quest lam duoc ngay nam tren
  table.sort(found, function(a, b)
    if a.req ~= b.req then return a.req < b.req end
    return tostring(a.q) .. tostring(a.id) < tostring(b.q) .. tostring(b.id)
  end)

  local list, map, lines = {}, {}, {}
  for _, e in ipairs(found) do
    local lab = string.format("%s #%s | Lv%d | %s x%d",
      e.q, tostring(e.id), e.req, e.mob, e.need)
    table.insert(list, lab)
    map[lab] = e
    if #lines < LurnaNqCfg.MAX_ROW then
      table.insert(lines, ((lvl >= e.req) and "[làm được] " or "[thiếu lv] ") .. lab)
    end
  end
  _G.__LurnaNqList, _G.__LurnaNqMap = list, map
  return found, nQ, lines, lvl
end

-- NPC "moi" = moi so voi MOC luu lan truoc, khong phai so voi bang mob. NPC giao
-- quest va mob la HAI LOAI KHAC NHAU, so cheo hai ben la ra ca tram dong rac -
-- nen o day so dung mot thu voi chinh no o hai thoi diem.
function LurnaNqNpcDiff()
  local names = {}
  pcall(function()
    for _, v in ipairs(replicated.NPCs:GetChildren()) do table.insert(names, v.Name) end
  end)
  table.sort(names)
  local now = table.concat(names, "\n")
  local old = LurnaNqBaseGet()
  LurnaNqBaseSet(now)
  if not old then
    return nil, #names -- lan dau: chua co gi de so, vua dat moc xong
  end
  local seen = {}
  for line in string.gmatch(old, "[^\n]+") do seen[line] = true end
  local new = {}
  for _, n in ipairs(names) do
    if not seen[n] then table.insert(new, n) end
  end
  return new, #names
end

-- Dung bao cao roi day vao o chu + lam moi dropdown. Goi tu nut bam.
function LurnaNqReport()
  local found, nQ, lines, lvl = LurnaNqScan()
  local newNpc, nNpc = LurnaNqNpcDiff()
  local out = {}
  table.insert(out, string.format("Level %d | game có %d dòng quest | %d dòng hub CHƯA biết",
    lvl, nQ, #found))
  if newNpc == nil then
    table.insert(out, string.format("NPC: %d con, vừa đặt mốc lần đầu — dò lại sau update để thấy con mới", nNpc))
  elseif #newNpc == 0 then
    table.insert(out, string.format("NPC: %d con, không có con nào mới so với lần dò trước", nNpc))
  else
    table.insert(out, string.format("NPC MỚI (%d/%d): %s", #newNpc, nNpc,
      table.concat(newNpc, ", ")))
  end
  if #lines == 0 then
    table.insert(out, "Không có quest lạ — bảng LurnaMobDB đang phủ hết quest của game")
  else
    table.insert(out, "--- quest lạ (sắp theo level) ---")
    for _, l in ipairs(lines) do table.insert(out, l) end
    if #found > #lines then
      table.insert(out, string.format("... và %d dòng nữa, chọn ở ô dropdown", #found - #lines))
    end
  end
  _G.__LurnaNqRep = table.concat(out, "\n")
  pcall(function()
    if LurnaNqDrop and LurnaNqDrop.SetValues then LurnaNqDrop:SetValues(_G.__LurnaNqList) end
  end)
  return _G.__LurnaNqRep
end

-- Cat trang thai cua hai engine farm co san roi TRA LAI luc dung. Hai engine cung
-- banh mob thi ca hai deu giat - dung bai hoc cua LurnaDunEngine (#19), nhung o
-- day khong the gop lam mot vi quest moi khong nam trong bang cua chung.
function LurnaNqSeize()
  if _G.__LurnaNqSaved then return end
  local s = { Level = _G.Level and true or false, FarmBoss = _G.FarmBoss and true or false }
  _G.Level, _G.FarmBoss = false, false
  pcall(LurnaSyncToggle, "Toggle_Auto_Farm_Level", false)
  pcall(LurnaSyncToggle, "Toggle_Auto_Farm_Boss", false)
  _G.__LurnaNqSaved = s
end

function LurnaNqRelease()
  local s = _G.__LurnaNqSaved
  if not s then return end
  _G.__LurnaNqSaved = nil
  _G.Level, _G.FarmBoss = s.Level, s.FarmBoss
  pcall(LurnaSyncToggle, "Toggle_Auto_Farm_Level", s.Level)
  pcall(LurnaSyncToggle, "Toggle_Auto_Farm_Boss", s.FarmBoss)
end

-- Quest ban dang chon (nil neu chua chon hoac nhan cu khong con trong ban do moi).
function LurnaNqSel()
  local lab = tostring(getgenv().LurnaNqSel or "")
  if lab == "" then return nil end
  return _G.__LurnaNqMap[lab]
end

-- Xac nhan bang GUI CUA CHINH GAME: bang quest dang hien va tieu de co ten mob cua
-- Task. Doc GUI thay vi tin gia tri remote tra ve - remote co the tra ve rong ma
-- quest van nhan duoc, va nguoc lai.
function LurnaNqHas(e)
  if not e then return false end
  local ok, vis, txt = pcall(function()
    local q = plr.PlayerGui.Main.Quest
    return q.Visible, q.Container.QuestTitle.Title.Text
  end)
  if not ok or not vis or type(txt) ~= "string" then return false end
  local low = string.lower(txt)
  for mName in pairs(e.task) do
    if string.find(low, string.lower(tostring(mName)), 1, true) then return true end
  end
  return false
end

-- Dang giu quest NAO KHAC (bang hien nhung khong khop Task) thi bo di. Y het
-- :6846 cua vong farm cu, chi khac la co rate gate rieng.
function LurnaNqDrop2(e)
  local ok, vis = pcall(function() return plr.PlayerGui.Main.Quest.Visible end)
  if not (ok and vis) then return false end
  if LurnaNqHas(e) then return false end
  if not LurnaGate("nq_abandon", 3) then return false end
  pcall(function() LurnaCommF("AbandonQuest") end)
  return true
end

-- Nhan quest. Server TU CHOI StartQuest khi dung qua xa - day dung la loi F4 da
-- ghi o :2842 cua chinh file nay - nen phai den GAN truoc roi moi goi, va goi qua
-- LurnaCommF de an bang rate :108 chu khong ban thang vao remote.
function LurnaNqStart(e)
  if not e then return false, "chưa chọn quest" end
  local nm, cf, how = LurnaNqNpcFor(e.q)
  if not cf then
    return false, "không tìm ra NPC giao quest, hãy tự chọn ở ô NPC bên dưới"
  end
  local hrp = LurnaHRP()
  if not hrp then return false, "chưa có nhân vật" end
  if (hrp.Position - cf.Position).Magnitude > LurnaNqCfg.NEAR then
    pcall(_tp, cf * CFrame.new(0, 3, 0))
    return false, string.format("đang đến NPC %s (%s)", tostring(nm), tostring(how))
  end
  if not LurnaGate("nq_start", 2) then return false, "chờ nhịp nhận quest" end
  local ok = pcall(function() LurnaCommF("StartQuest", e.q, e.id) end)
  if ok then
    return true, string.format("đã gọi StartQuest %s #%s tại %s", e.q, tostring(e.id), tostring(nm))
  end
  return false, "StartQuest thất bại: " .. tostring(e.q)
end

-- Mob cua Task, tim trong workspace.Enemies. So khop bang string.find de "Swan
-- Pirate [Lv. 775]" van khop voi key "Swan Pirate" trong Task.
function LurnaNqMob(task, range)
  local hrp = LurnaHRP()
  if not hrp then return nil end
  local box = workspace:FindFirstChild("Enemies")
  if not box then return nil end
  local best, bd = nil, range or LurnaNqCfg.RANGE
  for _, v in ipairs(box:GetChildren()) do
    if Attack.Alive(v) then
      local r = v:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
      if r then
        local hit = false
        for mName in pairs(task) do
          if string.find(string.lower(v.Name), string.lower(tostring(mName)), 1, true) then
            hit = true
            break
          end
        end
        if hit then
          local d = (r.Position - hrp.Position).Magnitude
          if d < bd then bd, best = d, v end
        end
      end
    end
  end
  return best, bd
end

-- Mot buoc cua may trang thai. Goi tu vong lap ben duoi.
function LurnaNqStep()
  local e = LurnaNqSel()
  if not e then
    LurnaNqSay("CHON", "bấm Dò rồi chọn một quest ở ô dropdown")
    return
  end
  local lvl = LurnaKaitunLevel()
  if lvl < e.req then
    LurnaNqSay("THIEU_LV", string.format("%s cần Lv%d, đang Lv%d", e.q, e.req, lvl))
    return
  end
  if not LurnaNqHas(e) then
    if LurnaNqDrop2(e) then
      LurnaNqSay("BO_QUEST", "đang giữ quest khác, đã bỏ để nhận đúng quest")
      return
    end
    local ok, why = LurnaNqStart(e)
    LurnaNqSay(ok and "NHAN_QUEST" or "DEN_NPC", why)
    return
  end
  -- Da co quest: danh mob cua Task. Dung DUNG engine kill co san (Attack.Kill
  -- :620) chu khong viet lai vong danh - viet lai la co hai cai cung banh mob
  -- roi giat, dung loi da hoc o #19.
  local mob = LurnaNqMob(e.task, LurnaNqCfg.RANGE)
  if not mob then
    LurnaNqSay("CHO_SPAWN", string.format("%s chưa thấy trong %d studs", e.mob, LurnaNqCfg.RANGE))
    return
  end
  pcall(function() Attack.Kill(mob, true) end)
  LurnaNqSay("DANH", string.format("%s (%s)", mob.Name, e.q))
end

-- Vong chay. Nhip lay tu LurnaFarmTick (:1260) de dong bo voi ca hub.
spawn(function()
  while true do
    local w = 0.25
    local okT, t = pcall(LurnaFarmTick)
    if okT and tonumber(t) then w = tonumber(t) end
    -- [Rule 1] khong bao gio nhanh hon 0.15s, ke ca khi LurnaFarmTick tra thap hon
    if w < 0.15 then w = 0.15 end
    if getgenv().LurnaNqRun then
      pcall(LurnaNqStep)
    else
      w = 0.5 -- khong lam gi thi ngu lau hon cho do ton CPU
    end
    task.wait(w)
  end
end)

-- ============================================================================
-- [LURNA FEATURE #23] FARM FULL DAO TU CHON - chon nhieu dao, tu quay vong
-- ============================================================================
-- MUC DO KIEM CHUNG (doc that trong chinh file nay, khong bia):
--   CHAC CHAN:
--     * local Sea1_Islands / Sea2_Islands / Sea3_Islands  :7377 :7459 :7543
--       moi dong co dang { CFrame = CFrame, Mobs = { ten mob } }, tong 14+9+8 dao
--     * local IslandData - bang dao cua bien dang o        :7684
--     * World1 / World2 / World3 la bien TOAN CUC theo PlaceId :226-228
--     * LurnaBestOf(list, radius) cham diem cum mob        :498
--     * BringEnemy(mob, force)                             :837
--     * Attack.Kill(model, true) / Attack.Alive(model)     :620 / :573
--     * _tp(cframe)                                        :2509
--     * LurnaMobDB co LevelRequest + MobName               :2863
--     * LurnaKaitunLevel()                                 :20181
--     * LurnaSyncToggle(id, val) qua Fluent.Options[id]    :7852
--     * LurnaFarmTick() tra ve nhip farm                   :1260
--     * LurnaGate(key, sec)                                :1592
--     * workspace.Enemies + GetAttribute("IsBoat")         :537-541
--
--   YEU (co nhan ro tren UI, va tat duoc bang cong tac):
--     * "dao nay qua cap" duoc SUY RA tu LurnaMobDB: lay LevelRequest cua cac dong
--       co MobName trung mot trong Mobs cua dao. Do la level YEU CAU CUA QUEST giao
--       con mob do, KHONG phai level cua mob - gan dung chu khong dung tuyet doi.
--       Nen no chi dung de BO QUA, va co o "Bỏ Qua Đảo Quá Cấp" de tat.
--
-- VI SAO CAN CAI NAY khi da co "Auto Farm All Island" (:7692):
--   1. Ten la "All Island" nhung than vong (:7701-7741) chi doc DUNG MOT dao
--      _G.SelectIsland - farm dao do roi nam o do, khong he quay vong.
--   2. Dao het mob (server dong nguoi cung farm) thi no _tp ve tam dao roi DUNG YEN
--      cho spawn vo han. Cai nay doi dao sau DRY giay khong thay con nao.
--   3. LurnaPickMob (:527) KHONG loc theo khoang cach, nen chi can co mob trung ten
--      o dao KHAC la da tinh la tim thay -> BringEnemy keo mob tu nua ban do ve. Cai
--      nay bat buoc mob phai nam trong ban kinh NEAR quanh TAM DAO moi tinh.
--   4. Khong tat Farm Level / Farm Boss nen hai engine cung banh mob roi giat nhau -
--      dung bai hoc cua #19 / #22.
--
-- KHONG lam trong day: khong hook, khong vo hieu hoa module nao cua game, khong goi
-- remote moi - danh bang dung Attack.Kill co san.

getgenv().LurnaFiRun = getgenv().LurnaFiRun or false -- cong tac farm
if getgenv().LurnaFiSkip == nil then getgenv().LurnaFiSkip = true end -- bo qua dao qua cap
_G.__LurnaFiQueue = _G.__LurnaFiQueue or {}  -- danh sach dao se farm, theo thu tu
_G.__LurnaFiIdx   = _G.__LurnaFiIdx   or 1   -- dang o dao thu may trong danh sach
_G.__LurnaFiPick  = _G.__LurnaFiPick  or ""  -- dao dang chon o dropdown
_G.__LurnaFiPhase = _G.__LurnaFiPhase or "TAT"
_G.__LurnaFiWhy   = _G.__LurnaFiWhy   or "-"
_G.__LurnaFiDry   = _G.__LurnaFiDry   or 0   -- moc luc bat dau khong thay mob nao
_G.__LurnaFiSaved = _G.__LurnaFiSaved or nil -- trang thai engine khac, de tra lai
_G.__LurnaFiKill  = _G.__LurnaFiKill  or 0   -- dem so nhip da goi Attack.Kill

LurnaFiCfg = {
  NEAR = 1200, -- mob phai nam trong ban kinh nay quanh TAM DAO moi tinh la cua dao
  DRY  = 12,   -- bao nhieu giay khong thay mob thi chuyen sang dao ke tiep
}
function LurnaFiSay(phase, why)
  _G.__LurnaFiPhase = tostring(phase or "-")
  _G.__LurnaFiWhy   = tostring(why or "-")
end

-- Bang dao cua bien DANG O. IslandData (:7684) da chon san theo World1/2/3, nhung neu
-- game them bien moi thi ca ba co deu false va IslandData la nil - luc do noi RO ra
-- chu khong im lang tra ve bang rong roi de nguoi dung ngoi doi.
function LurnaFiTable()
  if IslandData then return IslandData, nil end
  if World1 then return Sea1_Islands, nil end
  if World2 then return Sea2_Islands, nil end
  if World3 then return Sea3_Islands, nil end
  return nil, "không nhận ra biển hiện tại (PlaceId lạ)"
end

-- Ten dao cua bien hien tai, sap chu cai cho de tim trong dropdown.
function LurnaFiNames()
  local t = LurnaFiTable()
  local out = {}
  if not t then return out end
  for name in pairs(t) do table.insert(out, tostring(name)) end
  table.sort(out)
  return out
end

-- Level cua mot dao, SUY RA tu LurnaMobDB (:2863) - xem muc YEU o dau khoi. Tra ve
-- min, max. Tra 0, 0 khi khong tim thay dong nao khop (dao moi cua ban update chang
-- han) - luc do khong bo qua, vi khong biet thi khong duoc doan bua.
function LurnaFiLevel(name)
  local t = LurnaFiTable()
  local island = t and t[name]
  if not island or type(island.Mobs) ~= "table" then return 0, 0 end
  local want = {}
  for _, mob in ipairs(island.Mobs) do want[string.lower(tostring(mob))] = true end
  local lo, hi = math.huge, 0
  for _, row in ipairs(LurnaMobDB or {}) do
    if row.MobName and want[string.lower(tostring(row.MobName))] then
      local r = tonumber(row.LevelRequest) or 0
      if r < lo then lo = r end
      if r > hi then hi = r end
    end
  end
  if lo == math.huge then return 0, 0 end
  return lo, hi
end
-- Them mot dao vao danh sach. Khong them trung: farm cung mot dao hai lan trong mot
-- vong quay la vo ich, va lam nguoi dung tuong danh sach dai hon thuc te.
function LurnaFiAdd(name)
  name = tostring(name or "")
  if name == "" then return false, "chưa chọn đảo nào" end
  local t = LurnaFiTable()
  if not (t and t[name]) then return false, name .. " không có trong biển hiện tại" end
  for _, v in ipairs(_G.__LurnaFiQueue) do
    if v == name then return false, name .. " đã có trong danh sách" end
  end
  table.insert(_G.__LurnaFiQueue, name)
  return true, "đã thêm " .. name
end

-- Day la nghia "farm FULL": nap ca bang dao cua bien nay vao danh sach mot lan.
function LurnaFiAddAll()
  local n = 0
  for _, name in ipairs(LurnaFiNames()) do
    local ok = LurnaFiAdd(name)
    if ok then n = n + 1 end
  end
  return n
end

function LurnaFiClear()
  _G.__LurnaFiQueue = {}
  _G.__LurnaFiIdx   = 1
  _G.__LurnaFiDry   = 0
end

-- Dao dang farm. Tu keo chi so ve 1 khi no tro ra ngoai danh sach (nguoi dung vua
-- bam Xoa giua luc vong lap dang chay).
function LurnaFiCur()
  local q = _G.__LurnaFiQueue
  if #q == 0 then return nil end
  local i = tonumber(_G.__LurnaFiIdx) or 1
  if i < 1 or i > #q then i = 1; _G.__LurnaFiIdx = 1 end
  return q[i]
end

-- Sang dao ke tiep, quay vong. Khi bat "bo qua dao qua cap" thi nhay tiep, nhung chi
-- thu TOI DA bang so dao trong danh sach - khong lam vay la ca danh sach deu qua cap
-- se thanh vong lap vo han ngay trong mot nhip.
function LurnaFiNext()
  local q = _G.__LurnaFiQueue
  if #q == 0 then return nil end
  local lvl = LurnaKaitunLevel()
  for _ = 1, #q do
    _G.__LurnaFiIdx = ((tonumber(_G.__LurnaFiIdx) or 1) % #q) + 1
    local name = q[_G.__LurnaFiIdx]
    if not getgenv().LurnaFiSkip then return name end
    local lo = LurnaFiLevel(name)
    if lo <= lvl then return name end
  end
  return nil -- ca danh sach deu qua cap
end
-- Mob CUA DAO NAY: ten khop VA nam trong ban kinh NEAR quanh tam dao. Hai dieu kien
-- deu bat buoc. Chi khop ten thi dao Pirates (Mobs = {"Bandit"}) an luon "Desert
-- Bandit" o Desert, va LurnaPickMob (:527) khong loc khoang cach nen se keo mob tu
-- nua ban do ve - do dung la loi cua vong Auto Farm All Island cu.
-- Khop kieu DAU CHUOI chu khong phai chua-o-giua: "Bandit [Lv. 5]" van khop "Bandit",
-- con "Desert Bandit" thi khong (vi "bandit" khong nam o vi tri 1).
-- Cham diem cum bang LurnaBestOf (:498) - dung do co san chu khong viet lai.
function LurnaFiMobs(island)
  local list = {}
  local center = island.CFrame and island.CFrame.Position or nil
  local near = tonumber(LurnaFiCfg.NEAR) or 1200
  local want = {}
  for _, m in ipairs(island.Mobs or {}) do want[string.lower(tostring(m))] = true end
  pcall(function()
    for _, v in ipairs(workspace.Enemies:GetChildren()) do
      if v:IsA("Model") and Attack.Alive(v) and not v:GetAttribute("IsBoat") then
        local low = string.lower(v.Name)
        local hit = want[low] or false
        if not hit then
          for w in pairs(want) do
            if string.find(low, w, 1, true) == 1 then hit = true; break end
          end
        end
        if hit then
          local r = v:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
          if r and (not center or (r.Position - center).Magnitude <= near) then
            table.insert(list, v)
          end
        end
      end
    end
  end)
  return LurnaBestOf(list), #list
end

-- Cat trang thai cua cac engine farm khac roi TRA LAI luc dung. Bon cai deu banh mob:
-- Farm Level (_G.Level), Farm Boss (_G.FarmBoss), chinh vong Auto Farm All Island cu
-- (_G.AutoFarmIsland :7696) va Tu Lam Quest cua #22 - de ca dam cung chay la nhan vat
-- bi keo qua lai. LurnaSyncToggle (:7852) de o tren UI khong noi doi trang thai that.
function LurnaFiSeize()
  if _G.__LurnaFiSaved then return end
  -- [LURNA FIX #336] TAT #22 TRUOC KHI CHUP, khong phai sau. o:SetValue trong AddToggle
  -- (:5131) CO goi callback, nen LurnaSyncToggle("Toggle_Lurna_Nq_Run", false) chay
  -- thang vao LurnaNqRelease (:24796) - ma ham do ghi lai _G.Level va _G.FarmBoss tu
  -- ban chup CUA #22. Thu tu cu (chup -> ep false -> moi tat #22) ra ket qua nguoc y:
  --   #22 dang chay nen da tat Farm Level        -> _G.Level = false
  --   #23 chup Level = false, ep Level = false   -> chua sai
  --   #23 tat #22 -> LurnaNqRelease tra Level ve true (gia tri truoc khi #22 chay)
  --   => Farm Level BAT LAI giua luc #23 dang farm, dung cai va cham engine ma #23
  --      sinh ra de tranh; va ban chup cua #23 con giu Level = false nen luc dung #23
  --      lai di tat Farm Level cua nguoi dung - sai ca hai dau.
  -- Tat #22 xong moi chup thi _G.Level luc do da la gia tri THAT cua nguoi dung.
  -- Goi thang LurnaNqRelease sau sync la co y: LurnaSyncToggle co co chong tai nhap
  -- (:7853) nen trong mot lan sync khac no khong lam gi, con ham release tu no da
  -- idempotent (`if not s then return end`) nen goi hai lan khong hong gi.
  local hadNq = getgenv().LurnaNqRun and true or false
  if hadNq then
    getgenv().LurnaNqRun = false
    pcall(LurnaSyncToggle, "Toggle_Lurna_Nq_Run", false)
    pcall(LurnaNqRelease)
  end
  local s = {
    Level    = _G.Level          and true or false,
    FarmBoss = _G.FarmBoss       and true or false,
    Island   = _G.AutoFarmIsland and true or false,
    Nq       = hadNq,
    -- [LURNA FIX #335] xem giai thich ngay duoi
    Atk      = _G.Seriality      and true or false,
    Bring    = (getgenv().LurnaBringAll ~= false),
  }
  _G.Level, _G.FarmBoss, _G.AutoFarmIsland = false, false, false
  -- [LURNA FIX #335] Thieu hai dong nay thi #23 chi BAY LEN DAU MOB roi dung do, khong
  -- gay mot diem sat thuong nao. Ly do doc duoc trong chinh file: CA BA nguon ban
  -- RE/RegisterAttack + RE/RegisterHit deu thoat ngay khi Fast Attack dang tat -
  --   Heartbeat aura      :19320  `if not _G.Seriality then return end`
  --   FastAttackModule    :19447  cung dong dieu kien
  --   HitRegistration     :19513
  --   MainController      :19604
  -- Attack.Kill (:620) KHONG tu ban: no chi tinh anchor, goi BringEnemy, equip vu khi
  -- roi _tp len diem treo - phan ban dan la viec cua ba nguon tren. Nen bat Farm Full
  -- Dao ma quen bat Fast Attack la treo lo lung vo ich.
  -- Lam theo dung tien le da co trong file chu khong bay cach moi: LurnaFullReadyStep
  -- (:22014) goi LurnaFullDrive("Seriality", true), va LurnaKaitunPlan (:20150) cung
  -- co dong { g = "Seriality", id = "Toggle_Fast_Attack" }. Ca hai deu la orchestrator
  -- giong #23 nen #23 phai lam giong.
  -- LurnaBringAll: gom ca cum vao mot goi RegisterHit - duong tang DPS an toan nhat
  -- (LurnaFullTurbo :21997 lay dung ly do nay), khong phai ha nhip ban.
  _G.Seriality = true
  getgenv().LurnaBringAll = true
  pcall(LurnaSyncToggle, "Toggle_Auto_Farm_Level", false)
  pcall(LurnaSyncToggle, "Toggle_Auto_Farm_Boss", false)
  pcall(LurnaSyncToggle, "Toggle_Auto_Farm_All_Island", false)
  pcall(LurnaSyncToggle, "Toggle_Fast_Attack", true)
  _G.__LurnaFiSaved = s
end

function LurnaFiRelease()
  local s = _G.__LurnaFiSaved
  if not s then return end
  _G.__LurnaFiSaved = nil
  _G.Level, _G.FarmBoss, _G.AutoFarmIsland = s.Level, s.FarmBoss, s.Island
  -- [LURNA FIX #335] tra lai dung trang thai cu, ke ca khi truoc do nguoi dung DANG
  -- tat Fast Attack - khong tu y de bat sau khi minh dung.
  _G.Seriality = s.Atk
  getgenv().LurnaBringAll = s.Bring
  pcall(LurnaSyncToggle, "Toggle_Auto_Farm_Level", s.Level)
  pcall(LurnaSyncToggle, "Toggle_Auto_Farm_Boss", s.FarmBoss)
  pcall(LurnaSyncToggle, "Toggle_Auto_Farm_All_Island", s.Island)
  pcall(LurnaSyncToggle, "Toggle_Fast_Attack", s.Atk)
  -- [LURNA FIX #336] Bat lai #22 SAU CUNG. Callback cua no goi LurnaNqSeize, ham do
  -- chup _G.Level / _G.FarmBoss - nen phai de bon dong tra trang thai o tren chay xong
  -- thi #22 moi chup dung. Bat truoc la #22 chup dung mau gia tri "dang bi #23 ep".
  if s.Nq then
    getgenv().LurnaNqRun = true
    pcall(LurnaSyncToggle, "Toggle_Lurna_Nq_Run", true)
    pcall(LurnaNqSeize)
  end
end
-- MOT nhip. Khong viet vong lap long trong day: moi nhip lam dung mot viec roi tra
-- quyen lai cho vong ngoai, nho vay bam Xoa / doi dao / tat cong tac la an LIEN, khong
-- phai cho mob chet nhu vong cu (:7728 repeat ... until).
function LurnaFiStep()
  local t, err = LurnaFiTable()
  if not t then
    LurnaFiSay("KHONG_RO_BIEN", err or "-")
    return
  end
  local name = LurnaFiCur()
  if not name then
    LurnaFiSay("CHON", "danh sách trống - bấm Thêm Đảo hoặc Thêm Tất Cả")
    return
  end
  local island = t[name]
  if not island then
    LurnaFiSay("BO_DAO", name .. " không có trong biển này, chuyển đảo khác")
    LurnaFiNext()
    return
  end
  local lvl = LurnaKaitunLevel()
  local lo = LurnaFiLevel(name)
  if getgenv().LurnaFiSkip and lo > 0 and lo > lvl then
    local nxt = LurnaFiNext()
    LurnaFiSay("QUA_CAP", string.format("%s cần khoảng Lv%d, đang Lv%d -> sang %s",
      name, lo, lvl, tostring(nxt or "không còn đảo nào làm được")))
    return
  end
  local mob, cnt = LurnaFiMobs(island)
  if mob then
    _G.__LurnaFiDry = 0
    -- Gom cum roi danh, dung y nhu vong farm chuan cua hub: BringEnemy neo ca cum ve
    -- mot diem nen mot goi RegisterHit an nhieu con.
    pcall(function() BringEnemy(mob, true) end)
    pcall(function() Attack.Kill(mob, true) end)
    _G.__LurnaFiKill = (_G.__LurnaFiKill or 0) + 1
    LurnaFiSay("DANH", string.format("%s | %s | %d con quanh đảo", name, mob.Name, cnt))
    return
  end
  -- Khong con mob nao cua dao trong ban kinh.
  local hrp = LurnaHRP()
  local center = island.CFrame and island.CFrame.Position or nil
  local far = (hrp and center) and (hrp.Position - center).Magnitude or 0
  if hrp and center and far > (tonumber(LurnaFiCfg.NEAR) or 1200) then
    -- Co gate 1.5s: khong co thi moi nhip lai ghi CFrame mot lan = nhan vat rung.
    if LurnaGate("fi_tp", 1.5) then pcall(_tp, island.CFrame) end
    LurnaFiSay("DEN_DAO", string.format("đang đến %s (còn %d M)", name, math.floor(far / 3)))
    return
  end
  local now = tick()
  if (tonumber(_G.__LurnaFiDry) or 0) == 0 then _G.__LurnaFiDry = now end
  local dry = now - _G.__LurnaFiDry
  local lim = tonumber(LurnaFiCfg.DRY) or 12
  if dry >= lim then
    _G.__LurnaFiDry = 0
    local nxt = LurnaFiNext()
    LurnaFiSay("DOI_DAO", string.format("%s trống %ds -> sang %s",
      name, math.floor(dry), tostring(nxt or "không còn đảo nào làm được")))
    return
  end
  LurnaFiSay("CHO_SPAWN", string.format("%s chưa có mob, %ds nữa thì đổi đảo",
    name, math.max(0, math.floor(lim - dry))))
end
-- O danh sach: hien thu tu farm, level suy ra, dau ">" o dao dang farm.
-- CO Y nhet ca hai dong luu y vao DAY chu khong de o Description cua cong tac: ca 8
-- ham Add* cua thu vien Fluent ban nay (:5022-:6335) chi doc Title / Default /
-- Callback (AddParagraph them Content) - KHONG ham nao doc data.Description, nen chu
-- viet o do khong bao gio hien ra man hinh. Paragraph la cho duy nhat chu song duoc.
function LurnaFiListText()
  local head = "Level đảo chỉ SUY RA từ bảng LurnaMobDB (level của quest, không phải của mob) nên gần đúng.\nBật Farm Full Đảo sẽ tự tắt Farm Level / Farm Boss / Auto Farm All Island / Tự Làm Quest, và trả lại đúng trạng thái khi dừng.\n"
  local q = _G.__LurnaFiQueue
  if #q == 0 then
    local t, err = LurnaFiTable()
    if not t then return head .. tostring(err or "-") end
    return head .. string.format("Danh sách trống. Biển này có %d đảo trong bảng của hub.",
      #LurnaFiNames())
  end
  local lvl = LurnaKaitunLevel()
  local cur = tonumber(_G.__LurnaFiIdx) or 1
  local out = { head }
  for i, name in ipairs(q) do
    local lo, hi = LurnaFiLevel(name)
    local tag = (lo == 0) and "chưa rõ lv" or string.format("Lv%d-%d", lo, hi)
    table.insert(out, string.format("%s%d. %s (%s)%s",
      (i == cur) and "> " or "   ", i, name, tag,
      (lo > 0 and lo > lvl) and "  QUÁ CẤP" or ""))
  end
  return table.concat(out, "\n")
end

-- Vong chay. Nhip lay tu LurnaFarmTick (:1260) de dong bo voi ca hub.
spawn(function()
  while true do
    local w = 0.25
    local okT, tk = pcall(LurnaFarmTick)
    if okT and tonumber(tk) then w = tonumber(tk) end
    -- [Rule 1] khong bao gio nhanh hon 0.15s, ke ca khi LurnaFarmTick tra thap hon
    if w < 0.15 then w = 0.15 end
    if getgenv().LurnaFiRun then
      pcall(LurnaFiStep)
    else
      w = 0.5 -- khong lam gi thi ngu lau hon cho do ton CPU
    end
    task.wait(w)
  end
end)

-- ============================================================================
-- [LURNA FEATURE #24] CLEAR FULL MAP - quet sach mob toan ban do
-- ============================================================================
-- MUC DO KIEM CHUNG (doc that trong chinh file nay, khong bia):
--   CHAC CHAN:
--     * workspace.Enemies + GetAttribute("IsBoat")           :541
--     * Attack.Alive(model) / Attack.Kill(model, true)       :573 / :620
--     * BringEnemy(mob, force)                               :838
--     * LurnaBestOf(list, radius) cham diem cum mob          :498
--     * LurnaHRP() / _tp(cframe) / LurnaGate(key, sec)       :76 / :2509 / :1592
--     * LurnaFarmTick() tra ve nhip farm theo FPS            :1260
--     * LurnaSyncToggle(id, val) qua Fluent.Options[id]      :7852
--     * BossList theo tung sea + LurnaIsBossName(n)          :221-223 / :20289
--     * LurnaKaitunLevel() doc plr.Data.Level.Value          :25450
--     * LurnaMobDB: moi dong co CA LevelRequest CA
--       FullName = "Ten [Lv. N]"                             :2863
--       Da doi chieu 92/92 dong: so trong [Lv. N] BANG DUNG LevelRequest, khong
--       dong nao lech, va khong dong nao thieu [Lv. N]. Nen o #24 level mob la so
--       DOC DUOC chu khong phai suy dien nhu muc YEU cua #23. Level cao nhat co
--       trong bang: 2725.
--     * Fast Attack = _G.Seriality, id "Toggle_Fast_Attack"  :9499
--     * o:SetValue trong AddToggle CO goi callback           :5131
--
--   DA LOAI BO (khong lam): khong co cach nao "giet ca map tu xa". Muon mob chet
--   thi phai o gan no va gui don danh THAT qua remote - ba nguon ban deu di qua
--   LurnaAtkGate (:19133). Ghi Health = 0 phia client la vo dung va con lam ca hub
--   farm mu, dung sai lam da sua o FIX #323. Vi vay #24 la mot vong QUET: den tung
--   cum, danh, roi sang cum khac - khong phai mot lenh phep.
--
-- VI SAO KHAC #23 (Farm Full Dao):
--   #23 chi nhan mob nam trong ban kinh quanh TAM MOT DAO trong danh sach, con lai
--   bo qua het. #24 nguoc lai: khong quan tam dao nao, lay TAT CA mob dang song
--   trong workspace.Enemies roi quet cho den khi khong con con nao.
--
-- BA CAI CHAN CHET NGUOI cua kieu "quet sach map", neu khong xu ly thi vong quet
-- se dung im mai mai o mot cho:
--   1. BOSS: HP hang tram nghin, danh mot minh ca tieng khong xong -> MAC DINH BO
--      QUA boss (co cong tac de bat lai). Ten boss lay tu BossList co san.
--   2. MOB QUA CAP: mob Lv2000 mot phat mot mang -> bo qua mob cao hon level cua
--      minh cong mot khoang cho phep (slider). Khong biet level thi KHONG bo qua.
--   3. MOB KHONG THE GIET: mob ket trong da, mob server treo, mob co giap. Cu om
--      mot con la ca vong quet dung. Nen co dong ho: HP khong tut trong STUCK giay
--      thi TAM CAM dung con do BLOCK giay roi sang con khac.
--
-- KHONG lam trong day: khong hook, khong vo hieu hoa module chong gian lan nao cua
-- game, khong bia remote moi - danh bang dung Attack.Kill co san.
-- ============================================================================

getgenv().LurnaCmRun = getgenv().LurnaCmRun or false -- cong tac quet map
if getgenv().LurnaCmBoss == nil then getgenv().LurnaCmBoss = false end -- co danh boss khong
if getgenv().LurnaCmHigh == nil then getgenv().LurnaCmHigh = true end  -- bo qua mob qua cap
_G.__LurnaCmPhase = _G.__LurnaCmPhase or "TAT"
_G.__LurnaCmWhy   = _G.__LurnaCmWhy   or "-"
_G.__LurnaCmTgt   = _G.__LurnaCmTgt   or nil -- con dang om
_G.__LurnaCmHp    = _G.__LurnaCmHp    or 0   -- HP lan cuoi doc duoc cua con dang om
_G.__LurnaCmHpT   = _G.__LurnaCmHpT   or 0   -- moc HP TUT lan cuoi (de do "khong the giet")
_G.__LurnaCmKills = _G.__LurnaCmKills or 0   -- so con da thay chet
_G.__LurnaCmBlock = _G.__LurnaCmBlock or {}  -- [instance mob] = tick het han tam cam
_G.__LurnaCmSaved = _G.__LurnaCmSaved or nil -- trang thai engine khac, de tra lai
_G.__LurnaCmLeft  = _G.__LurnaCmLeft  or 0   -- so con DANH DUOC con lai
_G.__LurnaCmAll   = _G.__LurnaCmAll   or 0   -- so con dang song, ke ca con bi loc ra
_G.__LurnaCmNames = _G.__LurnaCmNames or {}  -- ten -> so luong, de liet ke
_G.__LurnaCmWhyN  = _G.__LurnaCmWhyN  or {}  -- ly do bi loc -> so luong
_G.__LurnaCmLvl   = _G.__LurnaCmLvl   or nil -- bang ten mob -> level, dung mot lan

LurnaCmCfg = {
  RADIUS = 30000, -- chi tinh mob trong ban kinh nay quanh nhan vat
  MARGIN = 100,   -- cho phep danh mob cao hon level cua minh bao nhieu
  STUCK  = 20,    -- HP khong tut bao nhieu giay thi coi la khong the giet
  BLOCK  = 90,    -- tam cam con do bao lau
}

function LurnaCmSay(phase, why)
  _G.__LurnaCmPhase = tostring(phase or "-")
  _G.__LurnaCmWhy   = tostring(why or "-")
end

-- Bang ten mob -> level, dung MOT LAN roi nho lai. Khong quet 92 dong cua LurnaMobDB
-- cho tung con mob moi nhip: mot server dong co the co hon 200 mob, thanh hon 18000
-- vong so sanh moi nhip chi de biet may con so.
function LurnaCmLvlTable()
  if _G.__LurnaCmLvl then return _G.__LurnaCmLvl end
  local t = {}
  for _, row in ipairs(LurnaMobDB or {}) do
    if row.MobName then
      -- Lay so trong FullName ("Bandit [Lv. 1]") TRUOC: do la level hien ngay tren dau
      -- mob trong game. Khong doc duoc thi lui ve LevelRequest - hai so nay bang nhau o
      -- ca 92 dong nen ket qua khong doi, nhung uu tien cai co nghia dung.
      local lv = nil
      if row.FullName then
        lv = tonumber(string.match(tostring(row.FullName), "%[Lv%.%s*(%d+)%]"))
      end
      lv = lv or tonumber(row.LevelRequest) or 0
      local k = string.lower(tostring(row.MobName))
      if (not t[k]) or lv > t[k] then t[k] = lv end
    end
  end
  _G.__LurnaCmLvl = t
  return t
end

-- Level cua mot ten mob. Tra 0 = KHONG BIET (mob cua ban update moi chang han), va luc
-- do KHONG bo qua: khong biet thi khong duoc doan bua roi bo sot ca map.
function LurnaCmLvlOf(name)
  local t = LurnaCmLvlTable()
  local low = string.lower(tostring(name or ""))
  if t[low] then return t[low] end
  -- Ten model tren map co the mang duoi ("Bandit [Lv. 5]") tuy ban game, nen thu them
  -- kieu khop DAU CHUOI. Khong dung khop chua-o-giua: nhu vay "Desert Bandit" se an
  -- level cua "Bandit" (Lv1) roi bi coi la mob de trong khi no Lv60.
  for k, v in pairs(t) do
    if #low > #k and string.find(low, k, 1, true) == 1 then return v end
  end
  return 0
end

-- Tam cam mot con: dung khi danh mai ma HP khong tut. Khoa theo CHINH INSTANCE chu
-- khong theo TEN - cam theo ten la cam luon ca dan cung loai, sai han y muon.
function LurnaCmBlockAdd(v, sec)
  if not v then return end
  _G.__LurnaCmBlock[v] = tick() + (tonumber(sec) or 90)
end

function LurnaCmBlocked(v)
  local t = _G.__LurnaCmBlock[v]
  if not t then return false end
  if tick() >= t then
    _G.__LurnaCmBlock[v] = nil
    return false
  end
  return true
end

-- Don rac. Mob chet thi Roblox xoa model, nhung khoa van nam trong bang -> bang cu
-- phinh mai theo phien choi (chinh la ro ri bo nho). Xoa ca dong het han va dong tro
-- den model da bi xoa (v.Parent == nil).
function LurnaCmBlockGc()
  local now = tick()
  for v, t in pairs(_G.__LurnaCmBlock) do
    local dead = true
    pcall(function() dead = (v.Parent == nil) end)
    if now >= t or dead then _G.__LurnaCmBlock[v] = nil end
  end
end

function LurnaCmBlockN()
  local n = 0
  for _ in pairs(_G.__LurnaCmBlock) do n = n + 1 end
  return n
end

function LurnaCmHpOf(v)
  local hum = v and v:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
  return (hum and tonumber(hum.Health)) or 0
end

-- Con nay co dang danh khong. Tra ve ca LY DO khi khong, de o trang thai noi duoc vi
-- sao map "con 30 con" ma minh khong danh con nao - im lang la nguoi dung tuong treo.
function LurnaCmOk(v, myLv, hrp)
  if not (v and v:IsA("Model")) then return false, "khong phai model" end
  if v:GetAttribute("IsBoat") then return false, "thuyen" end
  if not Attack.Alive(v) then return false, "da chet" end
  local r = v:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
  if not r then return false, "chua co HumanoidRootPart" end
  if hrp and (r.Position - hrp.Position).Magnitude > (tonumber(LurnaCmCfg.RADIUS) or 30000) then
    return false, "ngoai ban kinh"
  end
  if LurnaCmBlocked(v) then return false, "dang bi tam cam" end
  if (not getgenv().LurnaCmBoss) and LurnaIsBossName and LurnaIsBossName(v.Name) then
    return false, "boss"
  end
  if getgenv().LurnaCmHigh then
    local lv = LurnaCmLvlOf(v.Name)
    if lv > 0 and lv > (myLv + (tonumber(LurnaCmCfg.MARGIN) or 100)) then
      return false, "qua cap"
    end
  end
  return true, "ok"
end

-- Quet ca workspace.Enemies MOT luot roi tra ve bon thu cung mot lan: danh sach danh
-- duoc, tong so con dang song, bang dem theo ten, bang dem ly do bi loc. Gop lai mot
-- ham vi ca bon deu can dung mot vong for - quet bon lan la bon lan chi phi.
function LurnaCmList()
  local hrp = LurnaHRP()
  local myLv = LurnaKaitunLevel()
  local list, alive, names, why = {}, 0, {}, {}
  pcall(function()
    local en = workspace:FindFirstChild("Enemies")
    if not en then return end
    for _, v in ipairs(en:GetChildren()) do
      if v:IsA("Model") and Attack.Alive(v) and not v:GetAttribute("IsBoat") then
        alive = alive + 1
        local ok, reason = LurnaCmOk(v, myLv, hrp)
        if ok then
          table.insert(list, v)
          names[v.Name] = (names[v.Name] or 0) + 1
        else
          why[reason] = (why[reason] or 0) + 1
        end
      end
    end
  end)
  return list, alive, names, why
end

-- Chon con ke tiep. Cham diem bang LurnaBestOf (:498) - cum dong nhat truoc, roi gan
-- nhat. KHONG chon lai moi nhip: giu nguyen con dang om cho den khi no chet / bi xoa /
-- bi tam cam / roi ra ngoai ban kinh. Doi muc tieu lien tuc dung la loi da sua o FIX
-- #47 (moi frame ra mot con khac nen nhan vat bi keo qua lai, khong con nao chet).
function LurnaCmPick(list)
  local cur = _G.__LurnaCmTgt
  if cur and cur.Parent and Attack.Alive(cur) then
    if LurnaCmOk(cur, LurnaKaitunLevel(), LurnaHRP()) then return cur end
  end
  return LurnaBestOf(list)
end

-- Cat trang thai engine khac roi tra lai luc dung. Nam cai deu banh mob va deu keo
-- nhan vat di cho khac: Farm Level (_G.Level), Farm Boss (_G.FarmBoss), Auto Farm All
-- Island (_G.AutoFarmIsland), Tu Lam Quest #22, Farm Full Dao #23. Rieng Fast Attack
-- thi lam NGUOC LAI - phai BAT len, vi ca ba nguon ban dan deu thoat khi no tat
-- (xem FIX #335 o LurnaFiSeize).
--
-- Thu tu o day KHONG duoc doi (dung ly do cua FIX #336): #22 va #23 co ban chup
-- rieng cua chung, va tat chung se lam ham release cua chung GHI LAI _G.Level /
-- _G.FarmBoss / _G.Seriality. Nen phai tat het cac orchestrator TRUOC, roi moi chup -
-- luc do cac bien mang gia tri THAT cua nguoi dung. Chup truoc la chup mau gia tri
-- dang bi engine khac ep, va tra lai sai ca hai dau.
function LurnaCmSeize()
  if _G.__LurnaCmSaved then return end
  local hadFi = getgenv().LurnaFiRun and true or false
  if hadFi then
    getgenv().LurnaFiRun = false
    pcall(LurnaSyncToggle, "Toggle_Lurna_Fi_Run", false)
    pcall(LurnaFiRelease)
  end
  local hadNq = getgenv().LurnaNqRun and true or false
  if hadNq then
    getgenv().LurnaNqRun = false
    pcall(LurnaSyncToggle, "Toggle_Lurna_Nq_Run", false)
    pcall(LurnaNqRelease)
  end
  local s = {
    Level    = _G.Level          and true or false,
    FarmBoss = _G.FarmBoss       and true or false,
    Island   = _G.AutoFarmIsland and true or false,
    Nq       = hadNq,
    Fi       = hadFi,
    Atk      = _G.Seriality      and true or false,
    Bring    = (getgenv().LurnaBringAll ~= false),
  }
  _G.Level, _G.FarmBoss, _G.AutoFarmIsland = false, false, false
  _G.Seriality = true
  getgenv().LurnaBringAll = true
  pcall(LurnaSyncToggle, "Toggle_Auto_Farm_Level", false)
  pcall(LurnaSyncToggle, "Toggle_Auto_Farm_Boss", false)
  pcall(LurnaSyncToggle, "Toggle_Auto_Farm_All_Island", false)
  pcall(LurnaSyncToggle, "Toggle_Fast_Attack", true)
  _G.__LurnaCmSaved = s
end

function LurnaCmRelease()
  local s = _G.__LurnaCmSaved
  if not s then return end
  _G.__LurnaCmSaved = nil
  _G.Level, _G.FarmBoss, _G.AutoFarmIsland = s.Level, s.FarmBoss, s.Island
  _G.Seriality = s.Atk
  getgenv().LurnaBringAll = s.Bring
  pcall(LurnaSyncToggle, "Toggle_Auto_Farm_Level", s.Level)
  pcall(LurnaSyncToggle, "Toggle_Auto_Farm_Boss", s.FarmBoss)
  pcall(LurnaSyncToggle, "Toggle_Auto_Farm_All_Island", s.Island)
  pcall(LurnaSyncToggle, "Toggle_Fast_Attack", s.Atk)
  -- Bat lai hai orchestrator SAU CUNG, va #23 sau #22 - dung thu tu nguoc lai luc cat.
  -- Ham seize cua chung se chup lai _G.Level / _G.FarmBoss, nen phai de bon dong tra
  -- trang thai o tren chay xong thi chung moi chup dung gia tri.
  if s.Nq then
    getgenv().LurnaNqRun = true
    pcall(LurnaSyncToggle, "Toggle_Lurna_Nq_Run", true)
    pcall(LurnaNqSeize)
  end
  if s.Fi then
    getgenv().LurnaFiRun = true
    pcall(LurnaSyncToggle, "Toggle_Lurna_Fi_Run", true)
    pcall(LurnaFiSeize)
  end
end

-- MOT nhip. Khong viet vong lap long trong day: moi nhip lam dung mot viec roi tra
-- quyen lai cho vong ngoai, nho vay tat cong tac hay keo slider la an LIEN, khong phai
-- cho mob chet nhu vong Auto Farm All Island cu (:7728 repeat ... until).
function LurnaCmStep()
  LurnaCmBlockGc()
  -- Dem so con da giet: con dang om bien mat hoac het HP thi tinh mot con. Phai dem o
  -- day chu khong o cho Attack.Kill, vi Attack.Kill (:620) chi tinh anchor + equip vu
  -- khi + treo, no khong he biet mob co chet hay khong (xem FIX #335). Va noi that: so
  -- nay dem con BIEN MAT KHOI TAY MINH, nen mob despawn cung bi tinh - gan dung chu
  -- khong phai so giet tuyet doi.
  local old = _G.__LurnaCmTgt
  if old then
    local gone = true
    pcall(function() gone = (old.Parent == nil) or (not Attack.Alive(old)) end)
    if gone then
      _G.__LurnaCmKills = (_G.__LurnaCmKills or 0) + 1
      _G.__LurnaCmTgt = nil
    end
  end
  local list, alive, names, why = LurnaCmList()
  _G.__LurnaCmAll   = alive
  _G.__LurnaCmLeft  = #list
  _G.__LurnaCmNames = names
  _G.__LurnaCmWhyN  = why
  if #list == 0 then
    _G.__LurnaCmTgt = nil
    if alive == 0 then
      LurnaCmSay("MAP_SACH", "không còn mob nào sống trong workspace.Enemies — đang chờ spawn")
    else
      -- Con mob nhung bi loc het: noi RO do loc nao chan, khong de nguoi dung ngoi doan
      -- tai sao nhan vat dung im giua mot map day mob.
      local parts = {}
      for k, n in pairs(why) do table.insert(parts, string.format("%s:%d", tostring(k), n)) end
      table.sort(parts)
      LurnaCmSay("BI_LOC_HET", string.format("còn %d con nhưng không đánh con nào — %s",
        alive, table.concat(parts, " | ")))
    end
    return
  end
  local mob = LurnaCmPick(list)
  if not mob then
    LurnaCmSay("KHONG_CHON_DUOC",
      string.format("có %d con hợp lệ nhưng không con nào có HumanoidRootPart", #list))
    return
  end
  if _G.__LurnaCmTgt ~= mob then
    _G.__LurnaCmTgt = mob
    _G.__LurnaCmHp  = LurnaCmHpOf(mob)
    _G.__LurnaCmHpT = tick()
  end
  -- Dong ho "khong the giet": chi reset khi HP THUC SU tut. Mob hoi mau (HP tang) khong
  -- tinh la tut, nen mob hoi mau vo han cuoi cung se bi tam cam - dung y muon.
  local hp, now = LurnaCmHpOf(mob), tick()
  if hp < (tonumber(_G.__LurnaCmHp) or 0) then
    _G.__LurnaCmHp  = hp
    _G.__LurnaCmHpT = now
  end
  local stuck = now - (tonumber(_G.__LurnaCmHpT) or now)
  local lim = tonumber(LurnaCmCfg.STUCK) or 20
  if stuck >= lim then
    local blk = tonumber(LurnaCmCfg.BLOCK) or 90
    LurnaCmBlockAdd(mob, blk)
    _G.__LurnaCmTgt = nil
    LurnaCmSay("TAM_CAM", string.format("%s không tụt HP trong %ds -> tạm cấm %ds rồi sang con khác",
      mob.Name, math.floor(stuck), math.floor(blk)))
    return
  end
  -- Danh. BringEnemy neo ca cum ve mot diem nen mot goi RegisterHit an nhieu con, roi
  -- Attack.Kill lo phan equip vu khi va treo dung diem. KHONG tu _tp them lan nao: hai
  -- lenh teleport trong cung mot nhip chinh la loi rung nhan vat da sua o FIX #36.
  pcall(function() BringEnemy(mob, true) end)
  pcall(function() Attack.Kill(mob, true) end)
  local hrp, r = LurnaHRP(), mob:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
  local d = (hrp and r) and (r.Position - hrp.Position).Magnitude or 0
  LurnaCmSay("DANH", string.format("%s | HP %d | cách %d M | còn %d/%d con | đã diệt %d",
    mob.Name, math.floor(hp), math.floor(d / 3), #list, alive,
    tonumber(_G.__LurnaCmKills) or 0))
end

-- O "Con Lai Tren Map": liet ke ten mob va so luong, nhieu nhat truoc, cat o 8 dong cho
-- vua khung. CO Y nhet ca phan luu y vao DAY chu khong de o Description cua cong tac:
-- ca 8 ham Add* cua thu vien Fluent ban nay (:5022-:6335) chi doc Title / Default /
-- Callback (AddParagraph them Content) - KHONG ham nao doc data.Description, nen chu
-- viet o do khong bao gio hien ra man hinh. Paragraph la cho duy nhat chu song duoc.
function LurnaCmLeftText()
  local head = "Bật Clear Full Map sẽ tự tắt Farm Level / Farm Boss / Auto Farm All Island / Tự Làm Quest / Farm Full Đảo, tự BẬT Fast Attack (không có nó thì đánh không ra sát thương), rồi trả lại đúng trạng thái khi dừng.\nMặc định bỏ qua boss và mob quá cấp — hai thứ đó làm vòng quét đứng mãi một chỗ.\n"
  local rows = {}
  for n, c in pairs(_G.__LurnaCmNames or {}) do table.insert(rows, { n = n, c = c }) end
  table.sort(rows, function(a, b)
    if a.c ~= b.c then return a.c > b.c end
    return a.n < b.n
  end)
  local out = { head }
  if #rows == 0 then
    if (tonumber(_G.__LurnaCmAll) or 0) > 0 then
      table.insert(out, string.format("Không có con nào đánh được (map còn %d con sống).",
        tonumber(_G.__LurnaCmAll) or 0))
    else
      table.insert(out, "Chưa quét lần nào — bật công tắc để bắt đầu.")
    end
  else
    for i = 1, math.min(#rows, 8) do
      local lv = LurnaCmLvlOf(rows[i].n)
      table.insert(out, string.format("%d× %s (%s)", rows[i].c, rows[i].n,
        (lv > 0) and ("Lv" .. tostring(lv)) or "chưa rõ lv"))
    end
    if #rows > 8 then
      table.insert(out, string.format("... và %d loại nữa", #rows - 8))
    end
  end
  -- Bang ly do bi loc: chinh cai nay tra loi cau "sao no khong danh con kia".
  local parts = {}
  for k, n in pairs(_G.__LurnaCmWhyN or {}) do
    table.insert(parts, string.format("%s:%d", tostring(k), n))
  end
  if #parts > 0 then
    table.sort(parts)
    table.insert(out, "Bị lọc ra: " .. table.concat(parts, " | "))
  end
  return table.concat(out, "\n")
end

-- Vong chay. Nhip lay tu LurnaFarmTick (:1260) de dong bo voi ca hub.
spawn(function()
  while true do
    local w = 0.25
    local okT, tk = pcall(LurnaFarmTick)
    if okT and tonumber(tk) then w = tonumber(tk) end
    -- [Rule 1] khong bao gio nhanh hon 0.15s, ke ca khi LurnaFarmTick tra thap hon
    if w < 0.15 then w = 0.15 end
    if getgenv().LurnaCmRun then
      pcall(LurnaCmStep)
    else
      w = 0.5 -- khong lam gi thi ngu lau hon cho do ton CPU
    end
    task.wait(w)
  end
end)
